title: Associate Buyer - Food Prep
description:
Be part of an amazing story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Associate Buyer will elevate Macy’s competitive position by buying merchandise to drive sales and profitability across stores and online for your family of business. You will work closely with existing vendors to curate a distinguished Macy’s assortment, as well as seek out new and differentiating vendors to satisfy our customer demand. The Associate, Buyer will focus on achieving sales, gross margin, turn over and pricing execution in your assigned area of the business. You will develop and implement strategies by vendor, collaborating with planning to analyze and respond to sales trends.

An Associate Buyer is known as a trusted, collaborative, and results-oriented leader, serving as a key business partner and change agent with the ability to lead through influence. Demonstrating professional maturity and industry credibility, the ideal candidate must navigate and lead effectively through significant complexity. A crucial aspect is the candidate's comfort and effectiveness in promptly evaluating and phasing out legacy approaches that no longer align with the current strategy. Equally valued is the candidate's reputation for visionary thinking and a strong commitment to swift decision-making.

What You Will Do

  • Make all purchasing decisions independently of Buying Director that satisfies the customer demand to achieves sales, turn and margin plan.
  • Understand competitive marketplace and pursues white space opportunities that align with company strategy.
  • Competitive shop and determine the action necessary to address competitive challenges. Identify any product opportunities and provide suggestions and input in product development to vendors.
  • Support Buying Director to drive in-season business effectively by influencing promotional strategies based on current business needs.
  • Attend Market appointments prepared with strategic assortment plans and an understanding of product to support customer preferences.
  • Set the vision and determine call to action for assortment-building opportunities in partnership with Planning, Pricing and Cross Functional partners.
  • Collaborate with planning partner to develop and execute assortment strategy.
  • Develop pre-season assortment vision that ties to company key priorities and insights from Digital and Planning Director counterparts.
  • Partner with Financial Planning to ensure department-level financial targets support assortment strategy.
  • Decide on in-season changes for the department and vendors based on sales, margin, and turn forecast from Financial Planning.
  • Support the Financial Planning and Buying Director in building seasonal strategy components based on targets.
  • Provide Buying Director with category, class, and item performance analysis to assist in determining in-season item-level changes to make.
  • Maintain an industry presence that allows for connections, new business opportunities, and ideas at Macy’s. Represent and support the Macy’s brand while maintaining this presence.
  • Communicate with vendors to ensure timely collection of MDAs/markdowns/RTVs and partner with Financial Planning to ensure alignment with in-season VMT input.
  • Rely on data analytics (PE and dynamic pricing) to develop POS and Perm pricing strategy and ensure execution is as intended, hitting financial metrics and driving sales and profitability.
  • Review discount rate and sales performance in promo planner, making adjustments as needed to hit financial sales and margin goals.
  • Execute both POS pricing in promo planner, using dynamic recommends, and work with the associate buyer on permanent markdown execution in UPM.
  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.
  • In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Financial Business Acumen: Ability to understand and analyze financial aspects to make informed strategic decisions.

Retail Strategy and Tactics: In-depth knowledge of market trends, customer behaviors, and competitive landscapes..

Change Management: Comfort and effectiveness in leading teams through change ensuring successful adaptation.

Visionary Thinking: Ability to be a forward thinking and innovative leader with a vision to drive transformative strategies propelling family of business to new heights.

Communication Skills: Effective communication with candor, valuing open debate to bring the best ideas to life.

Growth Mindset: A growth-oriented mindset, coupled with the ability to coach teams in embracing growth opportunities.

Strategic Planning: Experience in driving strategies and plans supporting a compelling core and curated assortment.

Collaboration and Coordination: Skill in partnering closely with General Business Managers (GBMs) and Digital Directors for coordination and alignment across digital strategy and families of business.

Who You Are

  • Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. 3+ years of direct experience.
  • Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference; apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.
  • Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice
  • Tuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive. Macy's, Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Program Manager-Defense Systems
description:
Delivering mission-critical, electronic solutions that protect lives. Use your creativity and critical thinking to take our products from concept to customer.

At CAES, we engineer solutions for the world’s most critical missions. We serve customers in the defense and aerospace markets.

Seeking a career that offers challenging, diverse projects and opportunities? Looking for a position with a company that offers long-term professional advancement? Searching for a place that values a diverse, team-based environment? One that values YOU. Consider CAES.

The most important thing we build is TRUST

CAES is a defense, aerospace, cyber security, energy, and transportation products group. CAES manages a portfolio of specialist capabilities, generating highly differentiated solutions and products by applying electronic, mechanical, and software technologies in demanding and critical environments to meet customer needs.

We are an industry leader in the design, manufacture, support of advanced integrated RF systems for high performance Electronic Warfare, Radar/Communications, flight test and instrumentation systems. Our products are used by US and international customers in manned aircraft, UAVs, space vehicles, missiles and guided weapons applications.

Want to be part of a world-class team driving business and projects to success at CAES?

SUMMARY:

This high visibility role reports into the Program Management Office (PMO) at CAES Defense Systems Division. The Principal Program Manager will support the Defense Systems business on key programs that interfaces with our Prime Contract customers. The position will be responsible for all stages of the program life cycle with major customers, managing internal engineering and manufacturing plans, status reporting to customer for development and production orders, and ensuring on time completion of contract obligations.

Proposal Activities

  • Exercises responsibilities for the initiation, orchestration, review, approval and timely submission of program proposals.
  • Reviews and analyzes Request for Proposal (RFP) including technical, schedule, cost and contract requirements; coordinates proposal inputs with other departments.
  • Reviews Basis of Estimates (BOEs) for labor and materials supporting functions and prepares BOEs for Program Management in support of proposal preparation.
  • Participates in contract negotiations with internal contract administration staff and customers; establishes and monitors close liaison with customer representatives.

Program Execution

  • Leads development and maintenance of program plans and budgets covering the technical, financial and schedule aspects of the program.
  • Determines the allocation of funds necessary for performance of approved work and reallocations as necessary due to changing conditions.
  • Monitors and manages orders, revenue, profit, and cash to ensure programs stay on track meeting financial commitments.
  • Reviews estimates of material, equipment, labor costs, and ODC requirements to ensure completeness and accuracy. Leads preparation of periodic Estimates-at-Complete (EACs)to ensure financial goals are met.
  • Ensures establishment and maintenance of the management control system for providing visibility on all phases of program performance.
  • Defines and communicates the scope of work under the contract and monitors work activities to ensure they are within the contract funding limits.
  • Initiates corrective action when actual performance deviates or is predicted to deviate from established program plans.
  • Ensures compliance with Government, Company, customer, and industry specifications and regulations (e.g. FAR, DFAR, ITAR etc.).
  • Ensures adherence to all contractual, legal, and regulatory requirements on proposals and contracts.
  • Identifies program follow-on and other business opportunities related to assigned programs, and recommends appropriate action in plans and strategies.
  • Active Risk and Opportunity Management throughout the program lifecycle (Proposal through Contract Closeout).

Communication

  • Establishes and maintains personal, professional and technical image and relationships in the associated professions, customer communities, and within the Company in accordance with our company’s values.
  • Coordinates Company position and serves as primary representative in dealing with the customer and related contractors regarding program matters.
  • Assures that properly coordinated and timely responses are provided to all queries received by the Company in regards to assigned programs.
  • Established and maintains strong business relationships with customers to establish trust between companies, manage expectations, and identify follow-on business opportunities.
  • Communicates program progress and deviations to all level of Leaders and to applicable functional departments; recommends/implements corrective action as necessary.
  • Requests amendments to or extensions of contracts via Contracts staff.
  • Ensures the maintenance of accurate and complete contract and proposal files.

MINIMUM:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a business or technical field.
  • Minimum eight (8)+ years’ experience in program management with a concentration in the electronics/communications industry supporting U.S. DOD or foreign military governments.

PREFERRED:

  • Bachelor's Degree and eleven (11)+ years' experience in a technical, business, or financial discipline with professional level courses in contract administration.
  • Aerospace and/or defense industry experience.
  • Experience in Technology Development Programs, manufacturing technical products, and/or RF/Microwave Products.
  • PMP Certification.
  • Experience as a key advisor and managing program(s) that reflect moderate risk and complexity or deputy responsibility for a large complex program.
  • Experience managing program(s) that reflect moderate risk and complexity or deputy responsibility for large complex program(s).

“This position requires U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance in accordance with 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM.) Non-U.S. citizens are not eligible for clearance processing for this role. All applications are reviewed in compliance with national security requirements.”​

BENEFITS

Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage
  • 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
  • Employee assistance program and educational assistance
  • Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
  • Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Explore your benefits:

POSTING TIMELINE

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

ABOUT US

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

Business & Data Analysis

title: Director - Amex Offers Digital Media Data Analytics
description:
Amex Offers & Digital Media (AODM) is building an integrated Offers and Ads business designed to strengthen Membership while delivering differentiated value to advertisers. Analytics serves as the intelligence layer of this business; connecting business performance, customer behavior, advertiser opportunity, and strategic economics to enable sustainable growth.

We are seeking a highly strategic and commercially oriented Director of Strategy & GTM Analytics to shape where and how AODM grows. This leader will own the analytics agenda supporting AODM’s most important forward-looking strategic choices; connecting business strategy, commercial economics, growth opportunities, go-to-market intelligence, and AI-enabled transformation.

The Director will serve as a senior thought partner to AODM leadership and cross-functional partners across Product, Sales, GTM, Finance, Analytics, and Technology. The role will frame ambiguous business questions, develop fact-based strategic choices and business cases, evaluate trade-offs, and translate analytical insight into clear recommendations that influence investment, product, pricing, revenue, and GTM decisions.

A critical part of the mandate is incubation: identifying emerging growth opportunities and analytical capabilities, establishing the thesis and evidence required to test them, and determining whether they should scale, stop, or transition to a durable owner. This includes leadership of the AODM AI and advanced analytics agenda; connecting AI investments and emerging analytical capabilities to measurable business, customer, advertiser, and productivity outcomes.

This Director will lead a team spanning complementary areas of Growth Strategy & GTM Analytics and Strategic Analytics, AI & Revenue Strategy, creating a unified strategy organization capable of moving from strategic question to evidence, recommendation, incubation, and ultimately scaled execution.

  • Own the Strategy & GTM Analytics agenda for AODM, establishing a prioritized roadmap of strategic questions and analytical initiatives tied to the organization’s growth objectives.Shape business and portfolio strategy through rigorous analysis of Offers and Ads growth opportunities, strategic scenarios, industry dynamics, and cross-business trade-offs.
  • Lead AODM revenue strategy, and business-case development, including revenue models, pricing and monetization assessments, cost-to-serve analysis, investment cases, and economic guardrails.
  • Advance GTM and growth strategy by evaluating new propositions, strategic Card Member opportunities, enterprise and Heat Moments, commercial readiness, product adoption, Sales effectiveness, and cross-functional growth initiatives.
  • Own strategic scenario and investment modeling to help leadership evaluate product economics, monetization cases, and market scenarios, partnering with Performance Analytics and Finance on the underlying enterprise outlook.
  • Lead the AODM AI and advanced analytics strategy by defining the vision and roadmap, establishing portfolio governance, identifying high-value use cases, and connecting investments to measurable business outcomes.
  • Evaluate and incubate emerging analytical capabilities, including research, semantic foundations, AI-enabled tools, and new analytical methods, with explicit hypotheses, success criteria, economics, and paths to scaled ownership.
  • Create disciplined incubation and transition mechanisms that move successful strategic initiatives into durable operating owners rather than creating permanent bespoke work within the Strategy team.
  • Serve as a senior analytical thought partner to AODM leadership by translating complex analysis into clear choices, trade-offs, and executive recommendations.
  • Partner across Analytics, Product, Sales/GTM, Finance, and Technology to connect strategic analysis to execution and measurable outcomes.
  • Build and develop a high-performing strategy and analytics team, strengthening commercial judgment, structured problem solving, analytical rigor, executive communication, and leadership capability.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in analytics, strategy, data science, consulting, corporate strategy, or a related field, with significant experience in commercially oriented environments.
  • Proven track record of using analytics to influence strategy, investment, product, pricing, revenue, or go-to-market decisions.
  • Exceptional structured problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to frame ambiguous questions, develop hypotheses, synthesize complex evidence, and translate analysis into executive recommendations.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience with business cases, scenario modeling, revenue economics, monetization, or strategic planning.
  • Strong analytical foundation and fluency working with large and complex datasets; experience with SQL, Python, or comparable analytical tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and lead cross-functional initiatives without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex analytical concepts while preserving important nuance.
  • Experience leading, developing, and mentoring high-performing analytical or strategy teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in digital advertising, ad tech, card-linked offers, payments, loyalty, marketplaces, or other data-rich commercial ecosystems.
  • Experience with pricing, monetization, product economics, and commercial strategy.
  • Experience developing or applying AI/ML and emerging analytical capabilities to business problems.
  • Experience taking new analytical capabilities from concept to test to scale, including defining success criteria and transitioning successful capabilities into sustained ownership.
  • Familiarity with experimentation, causal inference, forecasting, and advanced analytics methodologies.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product, Sales/GTM, Finance, Data Science, and Technology organizations.•
  • Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the U.S. is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

title: Associate Director, Transformation
description:
The Innovation, Insights & Transformation (IIT) group partners closely with the AbbVie executive team to advance key strategic priorities across the organization. The work of this team plays a vital role in shaping AbbVie's continued growth and success.

The Associate Director of Transformation will support major change initiatives and drive organizational transformation to enable AbbVie’s strategic and operational objectives. Areas of focus include product development and manufacturing, organizational transformation, AI and digital acceleration, clinical trial acceleration, functional and asset strategy.

title: Surgery Scrub Technician
description:
At Sight360, we believe sight is our most important sense. It is a priceless gift that shapes how we experience the world, connect with others, and create lasting memories. That is why we are dedicated to protecting and caring for vision every day.


Job Summary

The Surgery Scrub Technician is responsible for performing the duties of a scrub technician and assists in the operative procedure by preparation of unsterile equipment and supplies.


Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Functions as a scrub technician in the operating room.
  • Assists with gowning and gloving other members of the surgical team.
  • Assists with the preparation of the operating room for surgical procedures.
  • Assists with skin preparations and with draping of patients.
  • Assists with care, preparation, maintenance, and after-care of sterile and unsterile supplies and equipment.
  • Knows and practices the principles and techniques of sterile technique.
  • Handles specimens in accordance with procedures.
  • Removes drapes at end of procedure, cleanses the patient of prep solution and applies dressing as needed.
  • Cleans instruments and equipment after use and returns them to proper area for storage processing.
  • Respects patient's right to privacy, dignity, and confidentiality.
  • Differentiates sterilization methods required for specific instruments and equipment.
  • Helps maintain supplies including participating in monthly outdates and yearly inventory count.
  • Participates as delegated in various committee functions.
  • Assists with housekeeping duties as necessary to provide a safe environment.
  • Participates in sponge, instrument, and needle counts with the circulating nurse as deemed necessary.
  • Demonstrates ability to understand and use autoclaves, sonic cleaner and washer/disinfector.
  • Attends and participates in staff meetings and in-service programs.
  • Participates in departmental conferences, orientation of new personnel and inservice programs as assigned.
  • Assists with stocking, replenishing, and preparation of supplies.
  • Updates knowledge in surgical techniques and related nursing care.
  • Recognizes legal and policy limits of individual responsibility.
  • Performs all other duties assigned by supervisor.
  • Participates in Performance Improvement activities.
  • Cleans equipment.
  • Changes work schedule as required by Nurse Manager to adjust for special needs, absences, and other unexpected occurrences.
  • Implements safety precautions and provides continual vigilance against accidents, fire, theft, vandalism, harm, and inappropriate use of supplies and equipment.
  • Handles and disposes of biohazardous waste appropriately.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Matching 401(k) plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid holidays
  • Employee discount
  • Certification reimbursement
  • Career growth opportunities


About Sight360

We’ve assembled highly capable and credentialed multidisciplinary teams across ophthalmology, optometry, and optical retail services to deliver a comprehensive, 360-degree approach to vision care. Through seamless coordination, shared medical records, and a patient-first philosophy, we strive to provide an exceptional experience at every level of care.


Our Mission

To care fully for our patients, team members, and partners who are the focus of everything we do.


Our Vision

To seamlessly unite ophthalmology, optometry, and optical retail services for the benefit of our patients.


Our Values

  • Treat everyone like family
  • Listen with purpose
  • Perform our best
  • Honor our word

Join our team and help us make a difference in the lives of our patients every day.

title: HCl Loader - 3rd Shift
description:
As a key member of our operations team, the HCl Loader is responsible for the safe and efficient loading and unloading of railcars and trucks containing raw materials and finished chemical products. You’ll operate industrial equipment, monitor safety protocols, perform minor mechanical tasks, and help maintain regulatory compliance in a high-paced manufacturing environment. This is a great opportunity for someone with a strong mechanical aptitude, commitment to safety, and looking to grow in a dynamic and essential industry!


This is for a 3rd shift position. Regular schedule is Sunday - Thursday 10pm - 6:00am.


Responsibilities:

  • Load and unload trucks and railcars with hydrochloric acid, sulfuric acid, salt, and sodium bisulfate.
  • Inspect and sample incoming/outgoing materials for quality assurance and compliance.
  • Operate pumps, valves, dilution systems, truck scales, forklifts, yard tractors, and related equipment.
  • Complete accurate documentation, including bills of lading, sampling logs, and QC records.
  • Perform routine checks and maintenance on HCl filters and other equipment.
  • Respond to and resolve minor mechanical issues (e.g., gasket leaks, equipment resets).
  • Support EH&S, OSHA, ISO, and Responsible Care procedures.
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of the work area.
  • Operate safely in outdoor conditions and confined spaces, often in full PPE.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Experience: Prior experience in chemical manufacturing or industrial loading preferred.
  • Forklift certified or able to obtain certification (Terminal Tractor and Loader training provided).
  • Must complete OSHA HAZWOPER training and maintain emergency response readiness.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy.
  • Comfortable using basic math and computer systems for data entry.
  • Good communication skills and ability to follow detailed procedures.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Must be able to pass a drug screening.

Working Conditions / Physical Requirements:

  • Work in a chemical manufacturing environment with exposure to acids, fumes, and high noise levels.
  • Operate outdoors in varying weather (heat, rain, cold) for extended periods.
  • Regularly wear PPE, including respirators and SCBA gear (medical clearance required).
  • Lift and carry items up to 55 lbs.; move drums up to 400 lbs. with equipment assistance.
  • Climb ladders and stairs (up to 140 ft), and enter confined spaces as needed.
  • Manual dexterity and color vision required for accurate equipment and material handling.
  • Must remain alert and safety-conscious in all tasks.

Benefits:

  • Company ownership through Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
  • 401(K)
  • Discretionary bonus and yearly salary increase
  • Holiday, Vacation and Sick pay
  • Medical, Dental Vision Insurance
  • Education and Employee Assistance Programs
  • Life insurance
  • Short- and long-term disability
  • Wellness Program including Fitness Facility Reimbursement

If you’re safety-focused, mechanically inclined, and ready to take on a hands-on role in a critical manufacturing environment, we want to hear from you. Apply today to become a valued part of our team and help keep our operations running safely and efficiently.

title: Assistant
description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for a proactive, organized and collaborative Assistant to join our UCB Boost Unit team, based in our Headquarters in Brussels (Anderlecht) Belgium.

About the role

You will act as a trusted partner to one or more team leaders, helping them and their teams work efficiently and stay focused on key priorities. You will anticipate business needs, coordinate complex activities and provide accurate, high-quality administrative support with discretion and sound judgement. By connecting information, meetings and team discussions, you will help identify practical solutions, maintain momentum on actions and support well-organized ways of working. This role suits someone who enjoys learning, takes ownership and remains adaptable when priorities change.

Who you’ll work with

You will be working in a team that collaborates across locations and values quality, efficiency, accuracy and cost awareness. You will partner closely with team leaders, colleagues, other assistants and internal and external contacts. You will also support new joiners, contribute to team engagement and help create an inclusive, well-connected working environment. The role has a global scope and requires close coordination with colleagues.

What you’ll do

  • Anticipate leaders’ and team needs, manage priorities and calendars, and plan key activities well in advance to support an effective and balanced workload.
  • Coordinate correspondence and information requests, assess priorities, follow up promptly and help ensure deadlines and commitments are met.
  • Organize internal and off-site meetings, events and virtual sessions, including rooms, catering, technical support, transportation, agendas and preparation materials.
  • Arrange business travel proactively, managing itineraries and bookings while adapting efficiently when plans change.
  • Join project meetings, capture decisions and actions, follow up on deliverables, and keep relevant team members informed of progress.
  • Create and update presentations, reports and team documents, using shared digital workspaces to support collaboration and efficient document management.
  • Monitor budgets, cost centres, purchase orders, invoices, year-end accruals and expense submissions, helping the team maintain cost awareness.
  • Support onboarding, team-building activities while handling confidential information with discretion.

Interested? For this role we’re looking for the following education, experience and skills

  • A bachelor’s degree, together with experience or clear potential to succeed in an administrative or team support role.
  • Fluent written and spoken English; French or Dutch language skills are an advantage.
  • Excellent planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage several priorities, projects and stakeholders independently.
  • Curiosity about AI technologies and innovative ways of working.
  • Strong attention to detail and a consistent commitment to accurate, timely and high-quality work.
  • Clear, professional communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships with leaders, colleagues, assistants and business partners.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Teams, PowerPoint, Excel and Word, plus the ability to learn new systems quickly.
  • A proactive, adaptable and solution-focused approach, with the judgement to identify potential issues before they become problems.
  • Discretion when handling confidential or sensitive matters, combined with reliability, resilience, openness to feedback and a positive team mindset.

Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless expressly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

title: Pharmacy Production Technician
location: MedWiz of Virginia DBA Virginia Pharmaceutical Ser
description:

  • Maintain organized workstations, replenish supplies, and support production targets.

title: Field Access Specialist- Upstate New York
description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for a Field Access Specialist to join us in our Market Access, Access and Reimbursement team, based in the territory of Upstate New York including Rochester, Buffalo and Syracuse, New York.

About the role

The priority of the Field Access Specialist (FAS) is to support timely and successful patient access to prescribed UCB medications by engaging with Healthcare providers to provide appropriate education to navigate payer barriers. This role is critical in bridging the gap between the prescriber’s clinical decision and actual patient treatment initiation. For a UCB Field Access Specialist (FAS), no two days are ever the same.

Who you’ll work with

The FAS provides support to all sites of care on local, regional and national payer coverage, pharmacy benefits and Payer policies for UCB Immunology medicines. FAS’s will interact with all engaged sites of care, which include private practices, group practices, Academic Medical Centers, Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs) with Dermatology departments and associated Specialty Pharmacies, Integrated Health Systems with Dermatology departments and associated Specialty Pharmacies, Private Equity and Venture Capital Backed Dermatology Groups and any other sites of care within their assigned geography. The UCB FAS is a non-promotional functional role reporting into the UCB Market Access, Access and Reimbursement Department.

What you’ll do

  • FAS supports all Dermatology accounts who prescribe UCB medicines with an enhanced focus on New Account experiences towards positive account and patient experiences. FAS educates and partners with office staff to embed functional processes inside the office and seeks continual operational improvements towards patient care.
  • FAS monitors data dashboards and maintains close communication with internal and external partners to intervene in escalated cases where an individual patient’s access to medicine is at risk. Cases are escalated via office staff, Field Alerts, CAS partners, or SP partners.
  • FAS works closely and communicates with the HUB case managers to ensure that accounts and patients are fully supported. Ensure patients are on track to receive their medicine. The FAS monitors HUB cases to ensure that authorizations, appeals, and shipments are in line with expectations and requirements and milestone deadlines are met. Identify operational issues needing attention. Partner for smooth bridge to commercial SP transition.
  • FAS partners internally with the SP NAE team to escalate situations and cases requiring intervention at the SP, while also taking swift action on SP requests for field support on patient cases. The FAS will also interact with the external SP account manager towards supporting patient care when requested by an office. FAS can educate and support IDN/Academic SPs to ensure internal processes lead to patients receiving their UCB medicine.
  • FAS communicates and collaborates with multiple internal stakeholders, including Regional Sales Leads (RSL), District Sales Leads (DSL) and several Clinical Account Specialists (CAS) daily to ensure that offices are supported. FAS also collaborates with peers on the Field Access team to solve problems or escalate payer-related issues.
  • FAS leads field-based initiatives when payer changes affect a local, regional, or national market. These changes could include positive changes that enhance patient access, or negative changes that adversely affect patients. The FAS educates accounts on the changes and what steps can be taken to ensure patients are cared for.

Interested? For this role we’re looking for the following

Minimum requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • 8+ years of experience in biopharmaceutical or related fields of: Market Access-related positions Sales, Sales Leadership, Learning and Development/Training, Medical Affairs (MSL), Thought Leader Liaison (TLL), Marketing, Patient Services, Account Management or reimbursement and/or patient access experience within a Specialty Pharmacy, Academic Medical Centers/IDNs, Hub Service Vendors, or healthcare provider settings
  • 4 years of experience in Coverage/Access, Reimbursement, or Account Management or equivalent experience in related healthcare, pharmaceutical, or payer environments
  • Must have a valid US Driver’s License and with no more than 3 moving violations in the past 2 years
  • Must reside within assigned territory.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Dermatology, Rare Diseases, Oncology, Immunology, or other therapeutic areas requiring advanced medical knowledge and complex medical treatment support.
  • Familiarity with HUB services for patient referrals, benefit verification, coverage, and affordability for specialty and biologic medications
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex healthcare systems, manage stakeholder relationships, and drive access solutions.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. and State regulatory environments, including evolving payer coverage, access, and reimbursement practices.
  • Project Management experience is a plus.
  • Knowledge of the US payer and reimbursement systems, including commercial insurers, Pharmacy Benefits Managers, Specialty Pharmacies, Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) policies, especially Medicare Parts B and D, Medicaid (fee for service and managed).

This position reasonably anticipated base salary range is $122,600-176,400k. The actual salary offered will take into account related knowledge, skills, experience and location among other factors and may fall outside the expected range.

Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

About us
UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless explicitly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. title: Domain Architect (Salesforce)
description:
Overview

Job Summary:

Connected is Allegis Group’s enterprise front-office platform, supporting Sales, Recruiting, Marketing, and Onboarding capabilities across its Operating Companies. The Domain Architect provides architectural leadership for a defined business domain, translating business and product strategy into scalable technology solutions across Salesforce and the broader Connected ecosystem. This role partners closely with Product, UX, Delivery, business stakeholders, and other architects to guide solution design, establish reusable patterns and standards, manage technical risk and debt, and ensure solutions align with enterprise strategy. The role requires deep Salesforce expertise combined with the ability to architect integrations, data solutions, and emerging AI and agentic capabilities across enterprise platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and enforce architectural standards, guardrails, and principles within Connected.
  • Provide big-picture thinking and problem-solving to guide analysis, architecture, and solution design.
  • Translate business requirements into well-architected Salesforce solutions, leveraging declarative capabilities and reusable patterns when appropriate.
  • Collaborate with Architecture, Product, and UX teams to design experiments, including AI and agentic capabilities, and validate new solutions.
  • Estimate effort and assess technical feasibility to support prioritization and planning.
  • Present solution designs to Architecture teams and the Architecture Review Board for feedback and approval.
  • Architect scalable solutions across Sales/Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Data Cloud, and Agentforce, including large data volumes, performance optimization, and MuleSoft integrations.
  • Guide best practices for Apex, LWC, and Salesforce extensibility.
  • Provide architectural leadership from concept through production, ensuring quality, scalability, and operational viability.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership and mentoring to developers.
  • Manage technology lifecycles and applications in LeanIX.
  • Serve as an architectural partner to Coalition and Product leadership, translating business priorities into scalable platform capabilities and technology roadmaps.
  • Contribute thought leadership by leveraging Salesforce innovation and industry best practices.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise, Platform, and other Domain Architects to ensure end-to-end solution integrity across regions.

Responsibilities

Essential Functions:

  • Establish domain-specific standards and near/mid-term strategies (0–18 months) in alignment with Enterprise standards.
  • Define future-state technologies and architectures (18–60 months) and provide domain expertise to evolve Enterprise strategy.
  • Apply architectural principles to meet operational requirements such as scalability, maintainability, security, and reliability.
  • Lead and participate in R&D efforts (POCs, prototypes) with Product and UX to evaluate emerging technologies.
  • Provide technical input to support Agile planning, estimation, and resource allocation.
  • Lead solution architecture for high-impact products in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ensure adherence to Enterprise Architecture standards throughout the SDLC via design and code reviews.
  • Serve as technical owner and point of contact for domain solutions.
  • Coach and mentor team members in technical skills and architecture practices.
  • Support SLAs, performance measures, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Stay current on Salesforce and domain technologies, identifying opportunities to reduce technical debt and evolve toward future state.

Qualifications

Minimum Education and/or Experience:

  • B.S. in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related major or equivalent IS / business experience.
  • Multiple Salesforce.com certifications (Developer, Advanced Developer, Architect, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, etc.)
  • 5+ years’ experience with Salesforce development and architecture of Sales/Service Cloud, APIs, Lightning, and Apex.
  • 8-10 years of IS / business experience, more specifically programming, engineering, automation, and systems analysis. Has a broad level of understanding in information systems (e.g. SOA, Master Data Management, Mobile).

Skills/Abilities:

  • Proven expertise in Salesforce architecture with delivery of enterprise-scale Sales/Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Data Cloud solutions.
  • Strong background in Apex, LWC, MuleSoft integration, and data management at scale.
  • Experience defining and governing standards, principles, and roadmaps within a domain.
  • Skilled in designing for security, compliance, performance, and large data volumes.
  • Strong communication skills, able to tailor messaging for technical, leadership and business audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, influence, and collaborate across teams.
  • Hands-on expertise in AI experimentation to accelerate outcomes.
  • Fosters a culture of innovation, reuse, and continuous improvement.
  • Identifies and develops reusable assets and accelerators.
  • Evaluates, recommends, and implements AppExchange and non-native platforms where appropriate.

Preferred/Optional:

  • Salesforce Lightning Design System / Lightning Web Components
  • GitHub, VS Code, Salesforce DX
  • MuleSoft integration experience
  • Familiarity with code quality and DevOps tools (e.g., SonarQube, Checkmarx)
  • CRM Analytics
  • Salesforce Shield
  • LeanIX or similar portfolio management tools
  • AppExchange products (e.g., Seismic, Gong)

Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to specific elections, plan, or program terms. This role is eligible for the following:

  • Medical, dental & vision

title: Propulsion Components Engineer
description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

Varda is hiring an experienced Propulsion Components Engineer to join the team that designs, builds, tests, and flies the fluid components on the W-Series satellite bus and future vehicles. The W-Series satellite incorporates a high-test hydrogen peroxide (HTP) and hydrocarbon bipropellant propulsion system with high-pressure inert gas pressurization and cold-gas attitude control. The component portfolio spans each of these fluid subsystems and includes solenoid control valves, check valves, relief valves, burst disks, fluid filters, regulators, manually operated service valves, machined fluid manifolds, and instrumentation including pressure transducers and RTDs. A successful candidate will take on a significant share of the component ownership for these mission-critical hardware articles as responsible engineer, helping expand component capabilities, improve reliability, and increase flight cadence.

Many current Varda components are purchased parts, and you will be a primary technical interface to our suppliers. Varda also intends to bring more component design in-house for current and future vehicles, and you will help lead that transition: shaping make-versus-buy decisions, executing detailed design, and standing up the capabilities to develop, qualify, produce, acceptance test, and fly Varda-owned parts. As part of a broad, multi-disciplinary engineering team, you will interface daily with propulsion systems, structures, production, thermal, avionics, and GNC engineers and technicians. You will inherit an operational, well-documented component baseline and drive improvements alongside the team. The role is hands-on: test stand development and operations, production floor support, occasional supplier visits, and issue or anomaly investigations as required. Bring your experience and passion, and let’s build something amazing. Open to Senior or Principal level candidates.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as responsible engineer for a significant portion of the bus propulsion component portfolio, from requirements and specification generation through development, qualification, production, and flight, in partnership with the broader engineering team
  • Design Varda-owned propulsion components: CAD, detailed drawings with GD&T per ASME Y14.5, tolerance analysis, seal and spring design, and supporting structural and fluid analysis
  • Specify, source, and qualify purchased components; serve as a technical lead with suppliers, review qualification and acceptance data, and drive corrective action and/or second sourcing
  • Author and execute acceptance and qualification test (ATP/QTP) campaigns per SMC-S-016; characterize component performance across the pressure and temperature envelope and feed results back into system requirements; document results with clear test reports
  • Support vehicle build, integration and test, and flight operations: disposition nonconformances and lead component issue or anomaly investigations to root cause and closure
  • Represent your components in design reviews, FMEAs, hazard analyses, and range safety interactions; contribute to the shared component knowledge base, qualification records, and lessons learned
  • Mentor engineers and help set the component design and test standards the propulsion team relies and builds on

Basic Qualifications

  • B.S. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience considered (typically 3–6+ years)
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience designing, qualifying, or owning fluid components (valves, regulators, filters, burst disks, manifolds, transducers) for spacecraft, launch vehicles, or comparable high-pressure hardware, on either the vehicle or the component-supplier side (typically 6+ years for Principal)
  • Working understanding of component design fundamentals: sealing, force balance, spring sizing, friction, flow paths, materials compatibility, material finishes, and wear
  • Mechanical design proficiency: CAD, assembly management using PLM software, detailed drawings with GD&T per ASME Y14.5, and tolerance analysis
  • Experience with component pressure and leak testing and ATP/QTP execution per SMC-S-016 or an equivalent standard, including authoring procedures and establishing pass/fail criteria
  • Hands-on experience building and testing pressurized hardware alongside technicians
  • Proven record of technical ownership: driving nonconformances and anomalies to root cause and corrective action across teams and suppliers
  • Willingness to travel to suppliers and test sites as needed (typically < 10% of time)

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • 6+ years of spacecraft or launch vehicle fluid component experience, including clean-sheet design of a valve, regulator, or similar component through qualification and flight (typically 6–10+ years for Principal)
  • Experience with low-leakage, on-orbit propulsion components and with HTP, other strong oxidizers, or high-pressure gas systems
  • Analysis skills for component design: FEA of pressure-containing parts, 1D fluid network modeling, valve dynamics, and fatigue and fracture control
  • Electromechanical and instrumentation fundamentals: solenoid valve coil and driver interfaces, and pressure transducer and RTD calibration, excitation, and error budgets
  • Supplier management for COTS and build-to-print aerospace components: source selection, audits, and data package review
  • Familiarity with AIAA S-080 and S-081 and AFSPCMAN 91-710 range safety requirements
  • Knowledge of precision manufacturing and inspection for fluid hardware: machining and deburring, welding, electropolish, precision cleaning, CMM, and NDE
  • Experience standing up testing capabilities for propulsion components (dev, qual, ATP), particularly in a high-cadence, high component throughput environment.
  • Prior experience leading a technical sub-discipline, formally or informally, and developing engineering standards within a propulsion organization
  • Exceptional technical communication skills, precision and clarity in specifications, test procedures, data package reviews, and engineering memos

Pay Range

  • Salary Range:
    • Senior (typically 3–6+ years): $140,333 – $179,314/per year
    • Principal (typically 6–10+ years): $181,913 – $232,444/per year
  • This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA
  • Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance
  • You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards

Benefits

Consider your benefits covered for launch. At Varda, we invest in benefits and perks that support your health, financial well-being, and life beyond work. Benefits vary by position, with packages designed specifically for our regular full-time employees and interns.

Regular Full-Time Positions:

  • Flexible PTO policy + 12 paid holidays

Generally clean work environment on stage with exposure to conditions such as dust, fumes, odors and noise from production and set building and breakdown. May work outside during inclement weather

title: Vice-President Corporate Partnerships
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Vice-President Corporate Partnerships based in the United States.

This is a senior development leadership opportunity focused on building and scaling a national corporate partnerships strategy for a mission-driven organization.
You will own the full partnership lifecycle, from prospect identification and cultivation through negotiation, activation, stewardship, renewal, and expansion.
The role combines strategic revenue leadership with hands-on relationship building across major corporate stakeholders and decision-makers.
You will develop diversified corporate revenue streams spanning philanthropy, sponsorships, cause marketing, workplace giving, and employee engagement.
As a key senior adviser, you will influence organizational strategy while collaborating closely with Programs, Marketing, Finance, Communications, and other teams.
The position also offers the opportunity to build and develop a corporate partnerships team and strengthen systems for sustainable national growth.
For an accomplished partnership leader motivated by meaningful social impact, this role provides significant ownership, executive visibility, and the opportunity to build long-term corporate relationships that advance mission and revenue goals.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive national corporate partnerships strategy aligned with organizational priorities, mission, strategic plans, and annual revenue objectives.

  • Establish annual and multi-year corporate revenue goals, pipeline targets, retention objectives, and partnership growth strategies.

  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified corporate prospects capable of generating significant new revenue.

  • Identify emerging industries, companies, and market opportunities that align with organizational priorities and mission.

  • Develop strategies to diversify corporate revenue through philanthropy, sponsorships, cause marketing, workplace giving, employee engagement, and other partnership models.

  • Provide regular forecasting, pipeline analysis, performance reporting, and strategic recommendations to the Chief Development Officer and senior leadership.

  • Lead the identification, qualification, cultivation, solicitation, negotiation, and closing of significant national corporate partnerships.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior corporate decision-makers across corporate social responsibility, philanthropy, community affairs, marketing, human resources, employee engagement, and related functions.

  • Create customized partnership opportunities connecting corporate priorities with programs, mission, and geographic reach.

  • Lead high-level presentations, proposals, negotiations, partnership agreements, and executive-level discussions.

  • Represent the organization at corporate meetings, conferences, industry gatherings, and external events.

  • Engage executive leadership, Board members, volunteers, and network leaders to open doors and advance high-value corporate prospects.

  • Manage a portfolio of significant national corporate relationships, developing annual relationship plans, growth strategies, engagement opportunities, stewardship activities, and renewal timelines.

  • Build multi-year partnerships designed to increase both financial investment and mission engagement.

  • Identify and execute opportunities to expand existing relationships through sponsorships, cause marketing, philanthropy, workplace giving, employee engagement, and other strategic initiatives.

  • Ensure corporate partners receive meaningful reporting and communications demonstrating the impact of their investment.

  • Lead renewal, upgrade, and expansion strategies for major corporate relationships while serving as an executive-level escalation point for complex partnerships.

  • Collaborate across Programs, Marketing and Communications, Finance, and Affiliate Services to design and deliver successful partnership activations.

  • Establish clear partnership processes covering deliverables, financial commitments, responsibilities, timelines, recognition, reporting, and expectations.

  • Coordinate complex activations involving multiple internal departments and external stakeholders.

  • Partner with Marketing and Communications on cause-marketing campaigns, sponsorship recognition, storytelling, and corporate communications.

  • Work with Finance on revenue forecasting, gift processing, budgeting, reporting, and fulfillment of contractual commitments.

  • Lead, coach, and develop partnership or fundraising professionals while building a high-performing corporate partnerships function.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

    • 7+ years of progressive experience in corporate fundraising, corporate partnerships, business development, strategic partnerships, sponsorship, or a related field.

    • Demonstrated success securing and growing significant multi-year corporate partnerships at a national level while achieving ambitious revenue targets.

    • Experience within a national nonprofit, chapter-based organization, federation, or similarly complex organization is strongly preferred.

    • Strong ability to navigate relationships involving national stakeholders with different priorities, responsibilities, and decision-making structures.

    • Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and developing fundraising or partnership professionals.

    • Strong understanding of corporate philanthropy, corporate social responsibility, cause marketing, sponsorship, employee engagement, and related partnership models.

    • Proven ability to develop, manage, and convert a substantial corporate prospect pipeline.

    • Excellent negotiation, presentation, proposal development, relationship management, and executive communication skills.

    • Strong ability to collaborate across functions and influence colleagues, leaders, and partners without relying on direct authority.

    • Strong financial acumen, including revenue forecasting, pipeline analysis, budgeting, and performance management.

    • Experience using CRM systems to manage corporate portfolios, pipelines, activities, relationships, and forecasts.

    • Exceptional written, verbal, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.

    • Strategic thinker with strong judgment, disciplined execution, and the ability to move comfortably between high-level strategy and hands-on relationship development.

    • Highly collaborative, adaptable, organized, and comfortable operating in a complex, mission-focused environment.

      • Benefits:

      • Salary range starting at $110,000.

      • Full-time remote position in the United States.

      • Regular national travel for corporate partner meetings, conferences, events, and organizational activities.

      • Work schedule primarily aligned with the Eastern Time zone.

      • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.

      • 403(b) retirement plan with employer match.

      • Disability and life insurance.

      • Generous paid time off, holidays, and floating holidays.

      • Opportunity to build and lead a national corporate partnerships function.

      • Significant executive visibility and influence over corporate revenue strategy and organizational growth.

      • Opportunity to develop high-impact partnerships combining revenue generation with meaningful social impact.

      • Collaborative, inclusive, and mission-focused working environment.

      • Reasonable accommodations available throughout the hiring process.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Golang/TypeScript/React) - Independent Contractor
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Golang/TypeScript/React) - Independent Contractor based in United Kingdom.

This is a senior engineering opportunity focused on building and evolving a data-intensive platform used by major global organizations and financial institutions.
You will work across backend microservices and modern frontend applications, combining Golang, TypeScript, and React to deliver reliable and performant products.
The role offers meaningful ownership, with engineers expected to take features from initial ideas through production and ongoing improvement.
You will contribute to technical strategy, architectural decisions, engineering standards, and the modernization of existing systems.
The engineering environment emphasizes observability, automation, performance, clean code, and continuous improvement.
You will collaborate within a distributed technical organization while engaging with Product and stakeholders across the wider business.
The position is fully remote and requires working US Eastern Time hours to maintain strong collaboration with the broader team.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, develop, test, maintain, and enhance Golang microservices and frontend applications, ensuring they remain reliable, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with product needs.
  • Build polished, performant, component-based user interfaces in React and TypeScript, following established design system principles and delivering a strong customer experience.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of features, from ideation and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement in production.
  • Contribute to technical strategy by evaluating architectural options, balancing existing systems with new technologies, and clearly communicating technical decisions and trade-offs.
  • Improve the performance, reliability, and observability of services and applications through effective engineering practices and appropriate monitoring solutions.
  • Raise engineering quality standards through clean-code practices, thoughtful code reviews, automation, process improvements, and the adoption of technologies that improve team productivity.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, Product Managers, and stakeholders across the business to understand requirements, communicate complex technical topics, and deliver solutions that create meaningful business impact.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience developing backend services and web applications with Golang, including deploying services in Docker containers.
    • Strong experience building modern, componentized frontend applications using React and TypeScript, with a focus on performance, usability, and maintainability.
    • Ability to write performant SQL and work effectively with data-intensive applications and relational databases.
    • Strong understanding of clean-code principles and idiomatic TypeScript and Go, with the ability to apply these principles during development, code reviews, and engineering standards.
    • Ability to quickly understand a new business domain and product, learn independently, and apply that knowledge to technical and product decisions.
    • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and improving technical skills, engineering practices, and ways of working.
    • Experience with concurrent application logic, such as Go goroutines, is beneficial but not essential.
    • Experience building CI/CD pipelines, particularly with GitLab CI, is a plus.
    • Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, as well as experience with AI tools used to improve engineering productivity or productionized AI solutions, is advantageous.
    • Additional experience with MaterialUI, Airflow, Python, or Terraform is welcome.
    • Experience with technologies such as Golang, TypeScript, React, MaterialUI, MariaDB, ClickHouse, GitLab, AWS, and SQL is valuable.

      • Benefits:

      • Compensation of USD 5,000–6,500 per month as an independent contractor.
      • Fully remote working environment with location flexibility.
      • US Eastern Time working hours, typically aligned with approximately 2:00 PM–10:00 PM CET or 1:00 PM–9:00 PM BST.
      • Opportunity to work on a data-intensive platform serving major international organizations and financial institutions.
      • Significant ownership over features, technical decisions, architecture, and engineering improvements.
      • Exposure to large-scale financial data collection, processing, validation, analytics, and data-driven products.
      • Collaboration within a technical organization of approximately 30 technologists, working in small, cross-functional teams alongside Product Managers and business stakeholders.
      • Opportunity to contribute to engineering standards, automation, observability, performance, and adoption of modern technologies including AI-enabled tooling.
      • Fully remote collaboration within an international, technology-focused environment.

title: OS Senior Associate - CPG
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a OS Senior Associate - CPG based in India.

This is a senior accounting role supporting a portfolio of US-based consumer packaged goods (CPG) businesses in a fully remote environment.
You will independently own complex accounting areas and play a direct role in delivering accurate, timely month-end closes.
The position requires strong CPG accounting expertise, particularly across trade spend, inventory, deductions, landed costs, and COGS.
You will work closely with US-based Client Leads and Team Leads, exercising sound accounting judgment while managing multiple client engagements.
The role combines hands-on accounting execution with opportunities to review associate work, improve processes, and share CPG best practices.
Success requires professionalism, proactive communication, reliability across time zones, and the ability to operate autonomously in a client-focused environment.

Accountabilities

  • Own complex CPG accounting areas from start to finish, including trade promotion accruals, deductions reconciliation, promotional liabilities, inventory, and COGS.

  • Perform inventory accounting across different fulfillment models, including landed cost calculations, 3PL reconciliations, obsolescence reserves, and periodic inventory counts.

  • Apply appropriate COGS structures and gross-to-net revenue accounting across retail, direct-to-consumer, Amazon, and distributor channels.

  • Manage co-packer, contract manufacturer, and supplier accruals with accurate supporting documentation.

  • Prepare and review journal entries and account reconciliations for complex balance sheet and income statement accounts.

  • Manage assigned month-end close activities end-to-end according to client calendars and established quality standards.

  • Identify and resolve accounting issues proactively, escalating complex or high-risk matters with clear context when needed.

  • Maintain organized, accurate supporting documentation and communicate close status, open items, and timing risks ahead of deadlines.

  • Review Associate-level work and provide constructive feedback that strengthens accounting quality and capability.

  • Recommend improvements to templates, documentation, and close workflows, while sharing CPG-specific knowledge and best practices with the wider team.

  • Exercise independent accounting judgment within established US GAAP policies and documented procedures, without changing accounting policy or communicating directly with clients unless specifically directed.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Commerce, or a related field is required; Chartered Accountant qualification or active pursuit is strongly preferred.

    • 3–6 years of professional accounting experience with hands-on ownership of complex accounting areas, including experience with US-based clients or within a US GAAP environment.

    • Demonstrated CPG accounting experience is essential, with practical knowledge of trade promotion accounting, inventory reconciliation, deductions, and multi-channel COGS.

    • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and practical experience applying it to journal entries, reconciliations, financial statements, and month-end close activities.

    • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online and Microsoft Excel; experience with NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Cin7, or similar accounting platforms is a strong advantage.

    • Experience in outsourced accounting, shared services, or BPO environments supporting US-based clients is highly preferred.

    • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally with US-based colleagues and clients when required.

    • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client workstreams simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and timeliness.

    • Demonstrated independence, accountability, responsiveness, and proactive communication when working across significant time-zone differences.

    • Strong coachability and openness to feedback, with the ability to quickly incorporate guidance and continuously improve work quality.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation aligned with the India market and the seniority and specialization of the role.

      • Competitive health and wellness plan.

      • Paid time off and paid holidays.

      • Fully remote work from India supporting international client engagements.

      • Company-provided technology equipment.

      • $250 technology stipend to support a productive home-office setup.

      • Opportunity to work closely with US-based accounting and finance professionals and gain exposure to diverse CPG businesses.

      • Opportunities to strengthen expertise in US GAAP, CPG accounting, and complex month-end close processes.

      • Professional development through feedback, knowledge sharing, process improvement, and collaboration with a distributed team.
