title: Chief Pilot
description:
The Chief Pilot provides leadership, regulatory oversight, and day-to-day management of its Part 135 flight operations. The Chief Pilot is a required management position under 14 CFR Part 119, reports directly to the Director of Operations, and works closely with the Director of Operations, Director of Maintenance, Training Department, Safety Manager, Cargo Manager and Department, and FAA Certificate Management Team. The Chief Pilot must be experienced Part 135 aviation and has strong leadership skills, sound operational judgment, extensive knowledge of FAA regulations, Operations Specifications, training and checking requirements, recordkeeping management, and safety management principles.

Job Responsibilities

1. Flight Operations Management

  • Exercise operational control as authorized and assigned by Kamaka Air and ensure flights are conducted safely in accordance with applicable regulations, Operations Specifications, Kamaka Air manuals, policies, and procedures.
  • Provide leadership and day-to-day oversight of Kamaka Air pilots and flight operations.
  • Maintain qualification as Pilot in Command in at least one type of aircraft operated by Kamaka Air.
  • Schedule flight crews for duty and ensure crew assignments comply with applicable qualification, currency, flight time, duty time, rest, and operational requirements.
  • Manage pilot payroll, including review and verification of pilot schedules, duty assignments, applicable pay items, and payroll information.
  • Coordinate closely with Operations Control, Maintenance, the Cargo Manager and cargo personnel, Safety, Training, and Kamaka Air leadership to support safe and efficient operations.
  • Exercise the authority and perform the duties assigned to the Chief Pilot by Kamaka Air's manuals, Operations Specifications, and applicable regulations.

2. Crew Resource Management

  • Ensure flight crewmembers remain properly trained, qualified, current, and authorized for assigned duties.
  • Maintain pilot standardization and ensure compliance with Kamaka Air manuals, policies, procedures, Operations Specifications, and applicable federal aviation regulations.
  • Oversee pilot training, checking, proficiency, and qualification programs in coordination with the Training Manager and Director of Operations.
  • Administer Kamaka Air's Second-in-Command Professional Development Program (SIC PDP) in accordance with applicable regulations, FAA requirements, Operations Specifications, and company procedures.
  • Revise the General Training Manual (GTM) as needed to maintain an effective, current, and compliant training program.
  • Participate in pilot recruiting, interviewing, selection, onboarding, evaluation, and development.
  • Conduct periodic performance reviews of pilots to assess professional standards, operational performance, regulatory compliance, standardization, and adherence to company policies and procedures.

3. Regulatory Compliance Management

  • Maintain effective working relationships with the FAA and other regulatory agencies.
  • Participate in FAA SAS activities, surveillance, inspections, audits, and certification or authorization projects.
  • Ensure flight operations records are properly maintained, including pilot training, qualification, checking, currency, duty and flight time records, and other records required by applicable regulations, Operations Specifications, and company manuals.
  • Ensure appropriate pilot records and qualification information are maintained, including compliance with Pilot Records Database (PRD) requirements.
  • Maintain all flight operations manuals, publications, and controlled documents at their current revisions and ensure they are published electronically within Kamaka Air's flight operations management software.
  • Assist with revisions to company manuals, training programs, Operations Specifications, and operational policies and procedures.
  • Administer Kamaka Air's TSA 12.5 security program and ensure applicable flight operations personnel and activities comply with program requirements.
  • Coordinate and communicate with the Hawaii Department of Transportation (HDOT) and airport operations management regarding airport planning, projects, construction activities, operational impacts, and compliance matters affecting Kamaka Air operations.

4. Safety Management

  • Support Kamaka Air's Safety Management System (SMS) and promote a positive, professional safety reporting culture.
  • Participate in safety investigations, risk assessments, corrective actions, safety promotion, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations as directed by the Director of Operations.
  • Support and participate in the implementation and administration of ASAP, LOSA, FOQA, and other applicable safety assurance programs.
  • Coordinate with internal departments and company leadership to address operational risks and support continuous safety improvement.

Perform other duties as assigned by the Director of Operations or Kamaka Air leadership.

Required Qualifications

The Chief Pilot must meet all applicable qualification requirements of 14 CFR § 119.71 for the operations conducted by Kamaka Air, including the applicable pilot certificate, ratings, and required experience.

  • Hold the pilot certificates and ratings required by 14 CFR § 119.69 and 119.71 for the Chief Pilot position and the type of Part 135 operations conducted by Kamaka Air.
  • Meet the applicable recent pilot-in-command experience requirements prescribed by 14 CFR § 119.71.
  • Be qualified to serve as Pilot in Command in Kamaka Air's operations, as applicable.
  • Possess a strong working knowledge of the 14 CFR Parts as applicable to Kamaka Air operations.
  • Have previous experience as a Training Captain in Part 135 or comparable commercial aviation operations.
  • Be proficient in Microsoft Office applications and the use of an iPad in an aviation operational environment.
  • Possess demonstrated leadership, communication, decision-making, organizational, and personnel management skills.
  • Be able to effectively interact with FAA inspectors, Kamaka Air leadership, pilots, maintenance personnel, the Cargo Manager and cargo personnel, customers, airport authorities, and other stakeholders.

Appointment to the position is subject to satisfaction of all applicable regulatory requirements and FAA acceptance as required by 14 CFR Part 119.

Preferred Experience

  • Five or more years of recent experience as a Part 135 Chief Pilot.
  • Strong working knowledge of applicable federal aviation regulations and FAA Operations Specifications (OpSpecs).
  • Extensive experience working directly with FAA inspectors and Certificate Management Teams.
  • Familiarity with and user proficiency in the FAA Safety Assurance System (SAS) Portal.
  • User proficiency with WebOPSS, including the development, revision, and management of Operations Specifications.
  • Experience with the FAA Pilot Records Database (PRD).
  • Experience with TSA 12.5 security programs and applicable air cargo security requirements.
  • Highly knowledgeable regarding FAA required Drug and Alcohol (D&A) testing programs, including applicable regulatory and administrative requirements.
  • Experience with a Hazardous Materials Will-Carry program, including associated training, manual, and operational requirements.
  • Significant experience implementing and administering an FAA-compliant Safety Management System (SMS).
  • Experience with Aviation Safety Action Programs (ASAP).
  • Experience conducting or administering Line Operations Safety Audits (LOSA).
  • Experience with Flight Operational Quality Assurance (FOQA) or comparable flight data monitoring programs.
  • Previous experience as an FAA authorized Check Pilot.
  • Experience developing, revising, and administering Part 135 manuals, training programs, policies, and procedures.
  • Experience managing pilot standardization, line checks, proficiency checks, recurrent training, and regulatory recordkeeping systems.
  • Operational experience with single and multi-engine turboprop airplanes in cargo operations.
  • Experience using aviation and workforce management software applications, including JetInsight, Fleet Manager, When I Work, and ForeFlight, or comparable systems.


Job Type: Full-time


Base pay is $150,000 plus additional salary based on knowledge and experience.


Benefits:

  • Health insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Pharmacy Insurance
  • 401(k) with company matching


Work Location: In person


Kamaka Air is committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining and inclusive culture providing equal opportunities to associates and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, marital status, genetic information, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or status as a Vietnam-era or special disabled veteran in accordance with applicable federal laws In addition, Kamaka Air complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location where Kamaka Air has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leave of absence, compensation and training.

title: Senior Full-Stack Technical Consultant
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full-Stack Technical Consultant based in India.

This is a senior technical consulting role focused on building enterprise applications and AI-powered solutions on top of SAP S/4HANA.
You will own solutions end to end, from data models and backend services to intuitive user interfaces, testing, and deployment.
The role combines modern web development, SAP technologies, cloud services, and emerging AI capabilities.
You will work directly with customers and SAP functional consultants to translate business needs into scalable and user-friendly solutions.
The position also offers opportunities to create AI agents, document-processing capabilities, and intelligent automation workflows.
As a senior member of the team, you will contribute to technical workshops, prototypes, proposals, and the development of other engineers.
Working remotely within an international environment, you will have significant opportunities to shape innovative SAP solutions across diverse industries.

Accountabilities

  • Design and develop enterprise applications using SAPUI5, Fiori elements, React, TypeScript, Node.js, and SAP CAP.

  • Build scalable OData and REST services on SAP Business Technology Platform.

  • Develop AI-powered features, document-processing solutions, and multi-step AI agents.

  • Design clean-core SAP extensions that enhance business functionality while maintaining maintainable architectures.

  • Create intuitive, high-quality user experiences aligned with modern application development practices.

  • Own solutions across the full development lifecycle, including data modeling, backend development, frontend implementation, testing, and deployment.

  • Collaborate closely with customers and SAP functional consultants to understand requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.

  • Present technical concepts, prototypes, and proposed solutions to customers and stakeholders.

  • Contribute to workshops, proof-of-concepts, and technical proposals.

  • Mentor developers, provide technical guidance, and contribute to the growth of the wider consulting team.

  • Apply AI-assisted development tools responsibly, reviewing and testing generated code to maintain quality, security, and reliability.

  • Support continuous improvement of development practices, automation, testing, and deployment processes.

    • Requirements:

    • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.

    • 5+ years of hands-on SAPUI5 and SAP Fiori development experience.

    • Strong expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, SAP CAP, OData, and REST APIs.

    • Experience with Git, automated testing, and CI/CD practices.

    • Knowledge of SAP Fiori administration and familiarity with Order-to-Cash (O2C) or Procure-to-Pay (P2P) business processes.

    • Practical experience using AI coding agents, combined with a disciplined approach to reviewing, validating, and testing AI-generated code.

    • Strong understanding of full-stack application development and modern software engineering practices.

title: Construction Project Administrator
location: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Phoenix
description:
Job Title: Construction Project Administrator

Grade: 4-C, Exempt

Department: Buildings and Properties

Supervisor: Director of Construction

Date: October 2, 2026



Purpose and Scope


To support the Diocese of Phoenix in its mission to Encounter the Living Christ, the Construction Project Administrator provides administrative support for diocesan construction projects and helps ensure compliance with diocesan policies, procedures, documentation requirements, and approval processes.


Essential Job Functions


Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


  • Creates, organizes, and maintains complete paper and electronic construction project files through project completion and closeout.
  • Maintains the Project Status and Financial Log, including current information regarding project approvals, contracts, payments, change orders, schedules, outstanding action items, and overall project status.
  • Tracks contracts, amendments, contingency usage, change orders, pay applications, invoices, and other required project documentation.
  • Administers the preparation, routing, execution, distribution, and retention of architectural, construction, and vendor contracts, including applicable American Institute of Architects contract documents.
  • Routes project documents for appropriate review, approval, and signature and distributes fully executed documents to the appropriate parties.
  • Reviews documents for completeness, accuracy, and required supporting information before submitting them to the Director for Construction for review.
  • Maintains fully executed documents and consistent project files in accordance with departmental standards.
  • Tracks preliminary notices, lien waivers, final lien releases, warranties, bonds, certificates of insurance, and other required construction and closeout documents.
  • Manages the vendor approval process for construction projects, including gathering required documentation, validating contractor licensing, and confirming compliance with diocesan insurance and related requirements.
  • Maintains detailed activity logs for assigned projects and monitors outstanding action items, pending documents, required approvals, and project deadlines.
  • Follows up with architects, contractors, vendors, parishes, schools, and other project participants regarding outstanding documents, action items, approvals, and deadlines.
  • Tracks required diocesan project approvals and assists with confirming that applicable diocesan construction policies and procedures have been completed.
  • Assists in preparing and distributing Requests for Qualifications and Requests for Proposals for architects, contractors, consultants, and vendors during the preconstruction and procurement processes.
  • Attends meetings as assigned; prepares clear and accurate minutes; documents recommendations, decisions, and action items; and coordinates the review, distribution, and retention of meeting records.
  • Assists with ensuring that meeting materials, correspondence, applications, approval packages, and other documents handled by the Buildings & Properties Office are complete, accurate, professionally prepared, and submitted by the required deadlines.
  • Maintains project financial documentation, including project budgets, sources and uses, payment records, invoices, pay applications, change orders, contract balances, and cash-flow information provided by the project team.
  • Processes invoices and pay applications for review, approval, and payment in a timely manner and tracks each item through completion.
  • Coordinates with architects, contractors, vendors, parishes, schools, and diocesan staff to assemble contract documents and supporting materials for review and authorized signature.
  • Coordinates the collection, organization, and retention of payment and performance bonds when required.
  • Administers project closeout procedures, including tracking required closeout documents, final-payment documentation, final lien releases, warranties, record documents, and other required deliverables.
  • Communicates with pastors, principals, business managers, and related support staff regarding contract documentation, project approval requirements, and diocesan construction procedures.
  • Prepares updated project status reports showing payments, change orders, contract balances, outstanding items, approvals, and schedule information for review and distribution.
  • Provides administrative support and assistance for parish, school, and diocesan construction projects as requested by the Director for Construction.
  • Provides general administrative support to the Office of Buildings & Properties, including telephone coverage and other departmental responsibilities as assigned.

title: Media Planner
location: Long Island City, NY, United States
description:
About

Bloomingdale’s makes fashion personal and fun, aspirational yet approachable. Our mission is to guide and inspire our customers to make style a source of creative energy in their lives. We will always strive to make Bloomingdale’s like no other store in the world. Everyone plays a critical role to bring our mission to life. Regardless of position, we believe all colleagues have a voice and access to share their thoughts with every level of leadership. Our colleagues are passionate, driven, entrepreneurial and collaborative. We welcome and embrace diversity of background, thought and opinion while having a lot of fun along the way.

Job Overview

The Paid Media Planner is responsible for the end-to-end planning and management of campaigns across display, paid social, programmatic video, CTV/OLV, digital audio, outdoor and print in a dynamic, high-volume retail environment. This role partners closely with internal teams and external agencies to translate business and marketing objectives into actionable media plans and guide campaigns from strategy and briefing through launch, optimization and performance reporting.

The ideal candidate balances strategic thinking with disciplined execution and is comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced retail environment.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Ownership & Planning

  • Own assigned paid media campaigns from initial briefing through launch, optimization, reporting and completion.
  • Translate business objectives into clear media recommendations in partnership with internal leadership and agency partners.
  • Develop and maintain campaign budgets, timelines, audience strategies, channel recommendations and measurement requirements.
  • Contribute to media strategies and points of view through research, ideation, data evaluation and an understanding of how channels support business goals.
  • Support competitive analysis, identify emerging partner opportunities and stay current on media industry trends and platform developments.
  • Understand how individual campaigns fit within the broader paid media strategy and business priorities.
  • Manage multiple concurrent campaigns and shifting priorities in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Identify dependencies and determine next steps without requiring continuous manager direction.

Agency Management

  • Lead day-to-day collaboration with external media agency partners, providing clear direction, evaluating recommendations, resolving open issues and ensuring deliverables are accurate, complete and on time.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Creative, Project Management, Analytics, CRM, Site, Finance and other marketing teams to support successful campaign execution.
  • Proactively communicate media requirements, specifications, deadlines and dependencies.
  • Monitor creative and other campaign inputs and follow up before deadlines are at risk.
  • Coordinate creative workflows, including briefing assets, facilitating reviews, consolidating stakeholder feedback and securing final approved assets for trafficking.
  • Raise risks early and clearly communicate potential business or campaign impact.
  • Push back constructively when timelines, assets or deliverables do not meet campaign requirements.
  • Come to meetings prepared to provide status, identify outstanding decisions and recommend next steps.

Budget & Performance Management

  • Maintain accurate campaign budgets and regularly monitor pacing and performance.
  • Identify under- or over-spending and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Review campaign performance to identify trends, opportunities and areas requiring optimization.
  • Partner with agency and analytics teams to interpret campaign reporting, identify performance drivers and translate findings into actionable optimization recommendations.
  • Understand key paid media KPIs and how performance relates to campaign and business objectives.

Operational Excellence & Quality Control

  • Maintain accurate campaign documentation, naming conventions, budgets, briefs, trackers and timelines.
  • Own campaign setup and launch readiness with internal and external partners, including asset procurement, trafficking, linking and tagging.
  • Verify campaign deliverables against approved briefs, specifications and budgets before submission or launch.
  • Conduct pre-launch quality assurance across creative assets, links, tags and tracking to resolve discrepancies before campaigns go live.
  • Coordinate media requests and in-flight changes from merchant and business partners, assessing implications for timing, budget and execution.
  • Partner with Finance and agency teams to ensure campaigns are accurately and promptly reflected in billing systems; track vendor agreements, contracts and related documentation.
  • Maintain a centralized library of partner overviews, publisher proposals, campaign examples and screenshots to support research, planning and future recommendations.
  • Maintain current campaign status, ownership, deadlines and next steps in shared trackers so stakeholders have a clear view of progress and open actions.
  • Ensure appropriate coverage and thorough handoffs during planned time away.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in paid media planning, digital media, performance marketing or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Experience managing multiple simultaneous campaigns and budgets across paid media channels.
  • Working knowledge of display, paid social, programmatic video, CTV/OLV, digital audio, outdoor, print and other paid media channels.
  • Hands-on familiarity with major advertising platforms such as Meta and Google, ad-serving tools such as Campaign Manager 360, and media management and billing tools such as Guidelines/Lumina or comparable systems.
  • Experience working with media agencies, publishers and/or platform partners.
  • Strong understanding of campaign measurement, pacing, optimization and performance reporting.
  • Strong organizational and project-management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize competing demands and operate effectively in a high-volume environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft and Google productivity suites, including Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify problems, develop recommendations and escalate appropriately.
  • Retail, e-commerce or other fast-paced consumer marketing experience preferred.

This job description is not all inclusive; additionally, Macy’s, Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy’s, Inc. – including Macy’s, Bloomingdale’s, and Bluemercury – is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

title: Manhattan University - CAREER FAIR FULL-TIME ENTRY LEVEL OPPORTUNITIES
description:
If you are a team player and ready to kick start your career in a multi-disciplined Architecture/Engineering firm, Popli Design Group (PDG) is the place for you! PDG is seeking Junior Engineers, Architectural Designers, Survey Technicians, and Construction Inspectors to add to our growing and talented teams. With offices in Buffalo, Rochester, Binghamton, Albany, and NYC/NJ, our teams will match you to the best opportunity to set you up for a successful career journey.


Transportation Design, Junior Engineers

In this role, you will assist in preparing design calculations, design details, specifications and cost estimates for bridge replacements, rehabilitations, and highways. Additionally, you will assist in the review of construction submittals, perform occasional field visits to collect data and evaluate existing conditions, and performs occasional field visits to resolve construction issues.


Bridge Inspection, Junior Engineers

In this role, you will assist the Bridge Inspection Team Leaders in conducting inspections in the field. You will actively contribute to the inspection process, helping gather data and performing necessary tasks under the guidance of experienced professionals. Additionally, you will be responsible for conducting structural analyses of bridges to determine their capacity, utilizing your engineering knowledge and analytical skills.


Transportation Construction Inspectors

In this role, you will be responsible for inspecting the progress of basic construction operations (Earthwork, Pavement, Structural Components, Scaffolding…); Verify conformance of material with Standard Specifications by carrying out field tests (Concrete, Compaction…); Interpret documented characteristics of objects and materials used in construction; Recognize unsafe construction procedures and site conditions; Inspect erosion control and protection of environmental features and utilities; and identify measured and/or tested properties and provide appropriate notification(s) and Report(s).


Civil, Junior Engineers

In this role, you will assist in the areas of development of hydraulic or water distribution models, design calculations, etc. in support of comprehensive civil/site design projects under the guidance and support of licensed Engineers; Assist in the preparation of technical engineering documents, design plans, specifications, reports, and cost estimates; and assist in the preparation of comprehensive drawing packages using Civil 3D, Microstation, etc.


Structural, Junior Engineers

In this role, you will work on assignments that include design and analysis, modelling/drafting, preparing plans and specifications, technical report writing, cost estimating, and construction observation. Projects are typically in the municipal and academic/institutional sectors and range from new construction and large additions to structural investigations, condition assessments, capacity analysis, renovation, rehabilitation and strengthening of existing structures.


Electrical, Junior Engineers

In this role, you will apply your working knowledge of electrical circuit theory and design, power distribution, signs/controls to create plans using AutoCAD and/or REVIT under the close supervision of Senior Electrical staff. Additionally, you will design sections of building’s electrical systems, for both new and renovated buildings including power and lighting.


Mechanical, Junior Engineers

In this role, you will assist in the design of HVAC, plumbing and/or fire protection systems for building facilities. Additionally, you will perform engineering evaluations and analyses, field inspections, design drawings, technical specifications and cost estimation under direct supervision of senior engineers.



About Popli Design Group (PDG)

PDG is a well-established multi-disciplinary architecture and engineering firm that has been serving clients since 1982. Our extensive portfolio of successful projects has earned us a trusted reputation among our clients.


Popli Design Group is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetics, disability or protected veteran status, and any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal law or Executive Orders.


Good faith salary range is provided, and salary package will be commensurate with experience, location, and area of study.

title: Head of Channel Partnerships, MCCF
description:
Amazon Multi-Channel Commerce and Fulfillment (MCCF) is seeking a strong leader to build and scale our channel partnerships with agencies, consultancies, and supply chain experts, leading a high-performing team of 7 Partner Managers.
Externalizing Amazon's supply chain services to reach merchants beyond our own channels is one of MCCF's biggest growth opportunities, and partners are central to unlocking it. This role owns the channel strategy for capturing that opportunity: driving upper-funnel demand for Amazon's externalized supply chain services through the partner ecosystem. Working through partners, the team generates awareness and demand among partners' merchant bases, feeds qualified leads and opportunities to our sales teams, and finds new ways to scale our shared book of business. Success is measured by partner onboarding and enablement, and by the leads and demand generated for Sales.
This is a high-visibility, strategic role in a high-growth business. The leader sets the vision for the channel, collaborates with senior leaders across Amazon, and engages directly at the C-suite level with our partners and with leading eCommerce brands to shape long-term, mutually beneficial growth. The ideal candidate is a data-driven operator who thinks big, builds trusted relationships with decision-makers and executives at prospective partners, and delivers ambitious growth targets while raising the bar on partner experience.


Key job responsibilities
Key Job Responsibilities
• Own partner onboarding, enablement, and lead generation for the sales team.
• Attract, retain, and scale top talent; mentor and coach Partner Managers.
• Set short- and long-term goals and execution plans, and build the programs and tools that improve team performance.
• Drive strategic plans for top agency, consultancy, and SI partners, prioritizing opportunities by their new-seller acquisition impact.
• Build and own executive relationships with key partners to set direction and unlock scaled growth.
• Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Dev, Finance, and Legal to execute the channel strategy.
• Represent partner and industry needs to influence product innovation and keep Amazon's value proposition differentiated.


About the team
MCCF extends Amazon's world-class shopping and logistics capabilities to merchants' own sales channels beyond Amazon. MCCF lets merchants use Amazon's fulfillment network to pick, pack, ship, and deliver orders from off-Amazon sales channels. For over 20 years, Amazon has empowered businesses to grow, and MCCF is the next step in helping merchants of all sizes grow their business — on Amazon or beyond.

title: Non-Secure Detention Worker / Transportation

title: English to Spanish (ESMX native) for Life Sciences Linguist
description:

With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. Key Responsibilities

  • Translate clinical research, regulatory and pharmacovigilance documents from English to Spanish LatAm.
  • Perform Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE) on machine-translated safety content.

Education

  • A minimum of five years of full-time professional experience in translation

Technical Skills

Native Language

Nice-to-Have

title: Youth Advocacy Initiative Coordinator

description:
ABOUT US

Resolving to make the world better for children is at the heart of Safe Shores -The DC Children’s Advocacy Center’s mission to provide survivor-centered intervention, hope, and healing for children and families affected by abuse, trauma, and violence in the District of Columbia. Our efforts are focused on working to prevent and end child abuse and neglect through promising practices, policies, and partnerships.


Working side-by-side with a passion-driven multidisciplinary team, we aim to:

  • Minimize the trauma experienced by children and adolescents who have been identified as victims of sexual or physical abuse.
  • Improve the investigation and prosecution of sexual and physical abuse cases from the point of intervention through to treatment and healing.
  • Promote inter-agency collaboration for effective decision-making and management of sexual and physical abuse cases.
  • Prevent further or future abuse of child victims.
  • Provide training professionals in the field of investigation, prosecution, and provision of services for sexually and physically abused children, adolescents, and their non-offending caretakers.

THE JOB AND YOUR ROLE

The Youth Advocacy Initiative Coordinator is an on-site role which provides administrative support and coordination of services within the Youth Advocacy Initiative (YAI). This role works to ensure the smooth daily operation of YAI services. This position is responsible for administration and operations tasks and support for Youth Advocacy services. This position may assist with other programmatic tasks as needed and directed, ensuring seamless provision of services. This position is fully trained in the SAVRAA law and required client service provision, and is part of a team that is available 24/7 and requires participation in an on-call response rotation for after-hours, holidays, and weekends. Safe Shores expects all employees to respect and be sensitive to human dignity and identity. We demonstrate this respect and sensitivity without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, familial status, family responsibilities, matriculation, political affiliation, genetic information, disability (actual or perceived), source of income, place of residence or business, military service, and any other basis protected by federal or District of Columbia law.


WHAT WE OFFER

Total Compensation: We prioritize your overall health and well-being

A salary is only part of a larger picture of compensation and rewards. The starting salary is $63,630 annually. We take total compensation seriously. We proudly provide one of the most robust benefits packages in the non-profit sector, including employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for our employees, and that’s just the tip of the iceberg. Our work is complex, and in this field, we firmly believe that we must care for ourselves to be present for our circle and those we serve. Please take a moment to read the complete list of employee benefits we offer:

  • Birthday Comp Day (Your birthday is a holiday for you!)

  • 13 days of paid vacation leave

  • Dedicated Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Employee appreciation and wellness events
  • Short- and long-term disability insurance
  • Life insurance
  • 403(b) Retirement Plan (Employer contribution after 1 year of service)

Other benefits as applicable are as follows:

  • Safe Shores offers paid sabbatical leave for employees with a tenure of five consecutive years.

WHAT YOU OFFER

You are passionate about Safe Shores’ mission, vision, and values, committed to doing what’s best and suitable for those we serve, and driven to become an outstanding asset to our community of colleagues. You have strong listening and communication skills, both oral and written, and must be able to adapt to various audiences fluidly. You have the heart of an advocate and are passionate about Safe Shores' mission. Most importantly, you have a high level of cultural competence and believe and thrive in a workplace culture committed to countering all forms of prejudice and discrimination.

title: Coffee Clerk
company: Lac du Flambeau Business Development Corporation
description:

title: Mortgage Documentation Manager I
description:
As the Internal Support Manager I, you will manage key processes designed to support business partners in a centralized environment while ensuring all compliance and regulatory needs are met. Managers of this centralized function are expected to ensure business line efficiency and to minimize risk. The Internal Support Manager I is expected to have a good working knowledge of their department as well as a strong knowledge of the business line policies that align with the internal functions in order to offer strong oversight to the functions performed. is responsible for managing post-closing mortgage servicing activities related to MERS, collateral custody, document tracking, collateral releases, and operational research. This role plays a critical part in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and timely processing of mortgage documentation while meeting regulatory requirements, investor guidelines, and internal service level expectations.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, customer-focused, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Primary responsibilities include

  • Manage the day-to-day requirements of all direct reports which include ensuring processes are followed, procedures are properly designed, and proper SLAs are set. Work is expected to be completed in the appropriate timeframe and the end product is expected to be free from errors. The manager is also expected to identify and address areas of process improvement within the group.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on projects that offer new processes in the branch or business banking network.
  • Participate in the construction of policies, and reviews of any related documents or communications.
  • Write communications in support of programs or processes internally which include procedures that govern the internal groups as well as production of guides and awareness information for branch and business banking colleagues.

  • Apply leadership skills and partnership to all levels of Consumer & Business Banking Operations Managers including Internal Support Management to keep continuity among groups and an excellent working knowledge of functionality. This includes decision making and stepping into other roles when necessary.

    MERS Administration & Exception Management

  • Create, track, and resolve assignments within the Mortgage Electronic Registration System (MERS).
  • Reconcile daily and monthly MERS exceptions and ensure resolution within required MERS timeframes.
  • Identify missing loan documentation and work with internal and external partners to resolve deficiencies.
  • Maintain accurate tracking of outstanding assignments and follow-up activities.
  • Conduct annual audits with third-party vendors and support audit-related inquiries.

  • Complete research and quality reviews to ensure compliance with state and investor requirements.

    Collateral Release & Custody Management

  • Process collateral release requests in accordance with established procedures and document custodian requirements.
  • Coordinate with document custodians to obtain released collateral documents for various business purposes and transaction types.
  • Monitor and track collateral release requests through completion and confirm receipt of documents.
  • Process collateral release amendments, corrections, and reinstatements when required.

  • Return collateral files to document custodians for loan reinstatements and ensure proper shipment and delivery confirmation.

    Document Tracking & Request Fulfillment

  • Manage collateral release and document requests received on a daily, weekly, monthly, semi-annual, ad hoc, and as-needed basis.
  • Obtain collateral document copies on behalf of business partners and ensure timely delivery.
  • Receive, track, and route collateral documents to imaging and other departments in accordance with established procedures.

  • Prepare required transmittals, shipping documentation, and FedEx packages following custodian requirements.

    Research & Operational Support

  • Research and respond to note possession inquiries and collateral-related requests.
  • Support business partners by providing guidance on collateral custody and document management processes.
  • Perform research to resolve outstanding collateral exceptions and servicing-related issues.

  • Complete routine and time-sensitive operational tasks requiring research, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

    Reporting & Relationship Management

  • Maintain accurate records, tracking tools, and operational reports.
  • Prepare and distribute monthly volume and performance scorecards.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, document custodians, vendors, and business partners.
  • Support department productivity goals, quality standards, and service level agreements.

  • Perform additional departmental and administrative duties as assigned.

Qualifications, Education, Certifications and/or Other Professional Credentials

  • Associate Degree
  • Knowledge of mortgage servicing and mortgage documentation.
  • Prior mortgage loan processing, post-closing, collateral, document custody, or servicing experience.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and complete assignments with minimal supervision.
  • Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Positive, customer-focused mindset and commitment to quality.

Hours & Work Schedule

  • Hours per Week: 40
  • Work Schedule: Monday Through Friday 8AM to 5PM

Pay Transparency

The salary range for this position is $65,000 - $91,000 per year. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience.

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. title: Software/Data Engineer
description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we need a Software/Data Engineer to join our Engineering team.

This team is the beating heart of Prima.

You’ll be joining over 300 engineers across software development, infrastructure, operations and security. Fueled by curiosity, experimentation and collaboration, you’ll help deliver scalable, impactful solutions that shape the future of insurance.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

You’ll be joining our pricing and underwriting domain to bridge the gap between machine learning/data science and engineering. You will help build, publish, and maintain our complex data products and pipelines, key elements that have a significant impact on the company’s growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Shaping the architecture of data products designed for data analytics and data science specifically focusing on use cases like forecasting, feature engineering, customer behaviour, and integration of new data sources.
  • Leading the way in data transformation by setting up best practices in areas like Data modelling, performance optimisation, Data Governance etc, ensuring that the data used within Prima is consistent, available and reliable.
  • Build reusable technology that enables teams to ingest, store, transform, and serve their own data products.
  • Engaging with data scientists and machine learning engineers to explore the product landscape and refine data requirements for enhanced data infrastructure.
  • Embrace continuous learning and experimentation to stay updated on emerging technologies, from testing open source tools to engaging in community-building activities like Meetups. Your passion for staying at the forefront of the field will drive your journey.

What We’re Looking For

  • Expert in batch, distributed data processing and near real-time streaming data pipelines with technologies like Kafka, Flink, Spark etc. Experience in Databricks is a plus.
  • Experience in Data Lake / Big Data Analytics platform implementation with cloud based solution; AWS preferred.
  • Proficient in Python programming and software engineering best practices.
  • Expertise with RDBMS, Data Warehousing, Data Modelling with relational SQL (Redshift, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases.
  • Proficiency in DevOps, CI/CD pipeline management, and expertise in infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployment industry-best practices.

Nice-to-Have

  • Hands-on experience in Data Quality and Data Governance techniques.
  • Knowledge on MLOps and Feature engineering.
  • Exposure to common data analysis and ML technologies such as on scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, XGBoost, LightGBM.
  • Exposure to tools like Apache Oozie, Apache Airflow.

€55,000 - €85,000 a year

Why you’ll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

Employees in this job class maintain irrigation systems from the point of connection to the main line and booster pumps, handle electronic valves, battery operated valves and lateral lines that feed the sprinkler heads and nozzles. Flags breaks and damages. Conducts site checks to inspect vitality of plant material.12. * Installs irrigation systems, controllers, builds concrete pads. Installs high voltage electrical connections, master valves and flow sensors.13. * Programs central control system and reports on water usage and alarms.14. * Troubleshoots and repairs repeaters and transmitters.15. * Maintains weather station.16. * Performs grounds maintenance duties as needed, which includes but is not limited to weeding, trimming, mowing, and edging.17. * Monitors progress of tasks and inspects completed work to ensure quality.18. * Frequent travel between facilities.19. Performs other duties and special projects as assigned.

High School Diploma or GED

Valid Driver's License

Employees must have the ability to perform the following physical demands for extended periods of time with or without assistance: • Standing and walking• Maneuvering around equipment• Bending, kneeling, squatting, stooping, reaching, pushing, pulling, and shoveling• Lifting of equipment up to 50 pounds• Pushing or pulling equipment weighing up to 75 pounds• Carrying a 20-pound backpack blower

Work is performed at a customer’s location on job sites in a construction environment with various tools, and mechanical, electrical and construction equipment. Transporting to work locations within the site. At times, may be required to work in confined spaces. The Senior Statistician II may work directly within a project and/or support statistical methodological advances. The accountabilities for supporting projects directly are:

  • Provide statistical expertise for complex design and interpretation for preclinical or clinical programmes, high level internal governance committees, regulatory submissions and/or commercialisation.

Essential:

title: Founding ML Engineer, Computer Vision (Object Detection)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Founding ML Engineer, Computer Vision (Object Detection) based in Canada.

As the founding machine learning engineer, you will define the technical direction for computer vision within an early-stage resale marketplace.
You will build and productionize models capable of identifying items from images with high accuracy and calibrated confidence.
Your work will directly support reliable pricing, better customer decisions, and a more trustworthy marketplace experience.
You will tackle fine-grained visual recognition problems where distinguishing between similar items is critical.
The role spans the full ML lifecycle, from research and experimentation through deployment, serving, and continuous improvement.
You will have significant autonomy and influence, setting priorities and establishing the foundations for a scalable computer vision function.
This is a fully remote opportunity within North America, suited to a senior engineer who thrives in an open-ended environment.

Accountabilities

  • Define the computer vision architecture for fine-grained item identification, leveraging foundation models and adapting them to specialized product catalogs.

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and productionize computer vision models capable of accurately identifying items from images.

  • Establish accuracy standards across different product categories and develop calibrated confidence scores that allow systems to recognize and communicate uncertainty.

  • Build evaluation frameworks that measure real-world model performance and track improvements over time.

  • Develop feedback loops that use model errors and production insights to guide labeling, dataset improvements, and future model iterations.

  • Prioritize engineering and research efforts between expanding category coverage and improving accuracy within existing categories.

  • Own the complete path from ML research and experimentation to production deployment, including model-serving latency, cost, scalability, and reliability.

  • Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to communicate model capabilities, limitations, performance, and tradeoffs.

  • Establish strong foundations for the computer vision function and provide senior technical leadership on an open-ended ML problem.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of applied computer vision experience, including experience shipping a computer vision system to production at meaningful scale.

    • Strong experience with fine-grained or instance-level classification, particularly in scenarios where distinguishing visually similar items is important.

    • Advanced proficiency with PyTorch or TensorFlow and hands-on production experience fine-tuning and deploying vision transformers or convolutional neural networks (CNNs).

    • Experience developing robust evaluation frameworks for measuring real-world model performance, accuracy, and improvement.

    • Strong understanding of the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle, including experimentation, model training, evaluation, deployment, and production monitoring.

    • Ability to operate as the senior technical owner of an ambiguous problem without an established playbook.

    • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts, model limitations, and engineering tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders.

    • Experience with active learning, human-in-the-loop labeling, low-latency model APIs, or early-stage startup environments is a strong plus.

    • Demonstrated curiosity, autonomy, and willingness to take ownership of both strategic technical decisions and hands-on implementation.

      • Benefits:

      • Annual salary range of $200,000–$260,000.

      • Fully remote work within North America.

      • Founding-level ownership over the computer vision and machine learning function.

      • Significant influence over technical architecture, ML strategy, and engineering priorities.

      • Opportunity to take models from research through production and see their direct impact on a real-world marketplace.

      • High-autonomy environment with the opportunity to solve challenging computer vision problems at an early-stage company.

title: Victim Advocate
description:
Horizon Health and Wellness, Inc. has offered quality healthcare services to central and southern Arizona for over 40 years. Our mission is to enhance the quality of life of the individuals, families and communities we serve, and empower them to attain their optimum potential. Our most important organizational philosophy is Kindness Matters. It is how we do our business and an essential component in all of our interactions with our patients and with each other.

The Victim Advocate serves as a critical connection between victims, law enforcement, the criminal justice system, and community resources. This position provides trauma-informed support, helps victims understand and exercise their rights, assists with navigating the criminal justice process, and connects individuals and families with appropriate community services.

What You'll Do:

  • Provide compassionate, trauma-informed support and advocacy to victims of crime and individuals experiencing crisis.
  • Assess victim needs and connect individuals with appropriate community, social, medical, legal, and emergency resources.
  • Assess client needs, when appropriate, by completing a thorough intake process for behavioral health services.
  • May respond to crime scenes or hospitals outside of normal business hours.
  • Explain victims' rights, available protections, and the criminal justice process, and assist with related documentation and court proceedings.
  • Coordinate with law enforcement, prosecutors, courts, and community service providers to ensure victims receive appropriate support and follow-up.
  • Accompany and assist victims at hospitals, shelters, courts, forensic interview facilities, and other service locations as needed.
  • Maintain accurate, confidential case records and documentation, including referrals, services, and case-related information.
  • Provide ongoing communication and case follow-up while helping victims navigate available services and resources.
  • Support community outreach, education, training, and victim-assistance programs.
  • Build and maintain relationships with community organizations and service providers and identify opportunities to improve victim services.

This position is grant-funded and is contingent upon the continued availability of grant funding. Employment is not guaranteed beyond the term of the grant and may be subject to modification or termination if funding is reduced or discontinued.

title: Asset Protection Detective, Northridge Fashion Center - Flex
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an Asset Protection Detective, you will help protect company assets, reduce shortage, and support a safe, customer-focused shopping environment. Using surveillance, investigative tools, and strong partnerships with store teams and law enforcement, you will identify and respond to theft, recover merchandise, and help protect our customers, colleagues, and business.

Why This Role Matters

Asset Protection Detectives play an important role in reducing loss while maintaining a safe and welcoming store environment. Through training, observation, investigation, and de-escalation, this role helps protect company assets, support colleagues, and ensure customers can shop with confidence.

How Our Asset Protection Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They greet teammates with a warm hello. Before they get started, they review updates and department information so they're fully informed and ready to engage with confidence.

  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.

  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

What To Expect

  • Use surveillance techniques, investigative tools, and reporting systems to help identify theft, dishonest activity, and shortage trends.

  • Partner with Asset Protection leaders, store teams, and law enforcement to support investigations and protect company assets.

  • Apply de-escalation tools and sound judgment to help maintain a safe environment for customers and colleagues.

  • Prepare clear documentation, statements, and evidence to support investigations, audits, and legal proceedings.

  • Support team readiness by training colleagues on protocols that help protect company assets.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Help protect customers, colleagues, and company assets by identifying, investigating, and responding to theft and dishonest activity.

  • Use surveillance techniques to support the apprehension of shoplifters and dishonest employees, while following company policies and legal requirements.

  • Recover stolen merchandise and provide statements, evidence, and documentation to support investigations.

  • Prepare timely and accurate reports related to theft incidents, investigations, audits, and assigned activities.

  • Build strong partnerships with store colleagues, Asset Protection leaders, and law enforcement to support investigations and shortage reduction.

  • Maintain compliance with company policies and legal standards related to apprehensions, searches, and evidence preservation.

  • Testify in court for criminal and civil cases, as needed.

  • Respond to alarm calls, support special assignments, and facilitate first aid for customers and colleagues when needed.

  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Skills That Matter

Must Have

  • Ability to observe, identify, and respond to suspicious activity in a retail environment.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with customers, colleagues, leaders, and law enforcement.

  • Ability to use sound judgment, de-escalation tools, and company procedures to support a safe environment.

  • Ability to handle proprietary, sensitive, and confidential information with discretion and integrity.

  • For jobs in New York, a current New York State Security Guard License is required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in retail, customer service, asset protection, security, investigations, or law enforcement.

  • Ability to prepare accurate reports, statements, and documentation related to incidents and investigations.

  • Experience using surveillance systems, reporting tools, or investigative technology.

  • Ability to train or coach colleagues on asset protection protocols, shortage reduction, or safety practices.

Physical Activities You Will Perform

  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

  • Position requires prolonged periods of standing/walking around store or department.

  • May occasionally involve reaching above eye level, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.

  • Must be able to apprehend shoplifters.

  • Ability to sustain long periods of time enclosed in surveillance areas.

  • Frequently lift/move up to 30lbs.

  • Requires close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: RTH FSQA Technician - 1st Shift - Days Off: Saturday & Sunday
description:

Ensures the Food Safety and quality of all product labeled, portioned, cooked, MAP, packaged, and shipped from Home Chef Tempo by working alongside production to conduct on-the-line checks of product against recipe specifications and quality standards.

Detailed Responsibilities

Verification of CCPs & CQPs

  • Conduct inspections at RTH production to ensure Food Safety & Quality requirements are met & recorded in the appropriate form
  • Verification of the accuracy of ingredients being used for production based on culinary recipe
  • Verification cook & chill temperature limits have been met & documented appropriately
  • Ensure post-lethality exposed product is properly stored to prevent cross contamination
  • Conduct finished product inspections to ensure product is released according to Food Safety & Quality requirements
  • Verification of chemical titration prior to each use
  • Ensure accuracy of labeling for finished products
  • Conduct on-line verification checks including but not limited to: Metal Detection, Oxygen Analysis, pH, and seal integrity
  • Escalate deviations immediately and assisting with product disposition as needed

Conducting Audits of Production Areas & Pre-requisite programs

  • Conduct continuous GMP inspections & corrections with proper documentation
  • Inspection of equipment & processing area to ensure sanitation & conditions are compliant with Food Safety & Quality standards
  • Conduct frequent environmental monitoring sampling
  • Enforce Food Defense protocol as needed
  • Other internal audits as needed

Other Responsibilities

  • Training
    • Assist in training of new employees on Food Safety & Quality practices
  • Issue Escalation
    • Promptly notifies leadership when Food Safety & Quality issues or HACCP/HACQP deviations arise

title: Staff Firmware Engineer
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing, and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

The Safety Firmware Team builds the next generation of intelligent video and AI-driven safety solutions, bringing high-performance camera systems and real-time edge computing into Samsara's fleet and industrial products. We deliver low-latency, high-quality video processing, voice powered AI Agents and advanced computer vision models at the edge, and we ship them as complete products that run from the device to the cloud.

This role is for a hands-on technical leader who goes deep on firmware but is just as comfortable across the full stack: embedded systems, Go backend services, and web and mobile surfaces. You are AI-native in how you work, you move fast, and you own outcomes end-to-end. You think like a product and systems owner, you move easily across teams, and you want to shape Samsara's edge AI strategy, mentor engineers, and ship work that makes a real difference.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US and Canada.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will help keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and, most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You want to build for scale: With over 2.3 million IoT devices deployed to customers worldwide, you'll work across new and mature technologies, from the device to the cloud, that drive innovation for the world's physical operations.
  • You want to own the whole outcome: You take a vague customer problem all the way to a shipped, measured feature, and you don't wait for a spec or a hand-off to get there.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals, and every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user. You'll join customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to make sure our work translates into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Our engineering teams blend independent effort with close collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win, together.

In this role, you will:

  • Own outcomes end-to-end, from a vague customer problem to a shipped, measured feature, across the full stack: firmware, Go backend services, and web and mobile surfaces
  • Drive technology choices, implement embedded and firmware solutions, and establish architectural patterns with a broad and lasting impact on Samsara's products, from the device to the cloud
  • Leverage voice as the new interface, powering AI Agents as well as humans communicating.
  • Design for the whole system: device constraints, connectivity, cloud services, and fleet-scale rollout
  • Identify opportunities and start strategic conversations that influence the direction of our technology and engineering culture
  • Ensure the accuracy of the AI algorithms we run at the edge, and that they operate within device constraints
  • Build with AI agents by default, and raise the AI fluency of the engineers around you
  • Partner closely with the Hardware team to define and build next-generation devices that support company objectives, and work just as fluently with Backend, Web, Mobile, Product, and Customer Success teams
  • Lead teams in delivering products and capabilities that contribute to Samsara's products and revenue
  • Solve the hardest technical problems and help products reach the market quickly, with high quality
  • Act as a multiplier for the team, raising the impact and output of every team member
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years of experience designing, developing, and deploying software, with deep expertise in embedded systems and firmware, including at least 2 years in a technical leadership or architecture role
  • Deep expertise in at least one embedded domain (for example multimedia, connectivity, drivers and kernel, power, or real-time systems)
  • Has shipped across the stack: firmware, Go backend services, and web or mobile surfaces, not just embedded
  • Strong programming skills in C/C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • Product and systems thinking: has shipped products, not just components; ties technical decisions to customer outcomes; and reasons about the whole system, including device constraints, connectivity, cloud, and fleet-scale rollout
  • High agency and execution speed: owns outcomes end-to-end, from a vague customer problem to a shipped, measured feature, without waiting for a spec or hand-off
  • Already uses AI tools in day-to-day engineering work, builds with AI agents by default, can speak concretely to what share of their code is AI-generated, and raises the AI fluency of the team around them
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and deliver complex, high-impact projects with multiple dependencies
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, equally credible in a kernel driver review and a backend design review, with the ability to move across teams and influence cross-functional stakeholders
  • A track record of building systems that do more with less hardware, and comfort operating under scarce compute, data, or hardware budgets, in any industry

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Expertise in multimedia frameworks, video codecs, and camera systems
  • Played a prominent role in shaping the engineering culture of a rapidly scaling, large, global engineering team
  • Expertise in developing and managing software for large-scale embedded systems deployed on 1M+ devices
  • Experience deploying CV/ML models on edge devices in real-world applications
  • Background in another scarce-resource industry (robotics, drones, consumer electronics, automotive). A strong "do more with less" track record matters more than pedigree in this exact industry

Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
