title: Staff Board Assembly Engineer (Advanced SMT Process Development)
description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.




THE ROLE:

We are seeking a senior-level manufacturing technology expert to drive advanced SMT and board assembly process development for advanced computing platforms. This is a technology development role responsible for defining assembly strategies, influencing product design, and enabling manufacturability for high-complexity PCB assemblies—particularly large BGA packages with significant warpage and coplanarity challenges.

This role offers the opportunity to define manufacturing capability for future platforms, influence product architecture, and solve board-assembly problems that do not have textbook answers. Success is measured by enabling designs that others consider too complex to manufacture reliably.

THE PERSON:

You will work at the intersection of package engineering, PCB design, mechanical and thermal integration, reliability, and global manufacturing, setting standards and best practices deployed across multiple manufacturing partners worldwide.

What Success Looks Like

  • Establishes robust, high-yield SMT assembly processes for thermally and mechanically demanding PCB assemblies
  • Translates warpage, coplanarity, and thermal behavior into manufacturable design rules and process windows
  • Develops scalable guidelines, BKMs, and training across internal teams and EMS partners
  • Solves non-conventional assembly challenges that exceed standard SMT capability

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Advanced SMT Process Development

  • Lead end-to-end SMT process development, for Printing / stencil, Placement, Reflow, Post-reflow process
  • Define robust process windows balancing yield, reliability, and scalability
  • Drive structured experimentation (DOE) to resolve complex yield issues
  • Develop and validate assembly flows for manufacturing readiness

Large BGA Assembly, Warpage and Coplanarity Mitigation

  • Serve as technical owner for assembly of large, mechanically challenging BGA packages and complex board constructions.
  • Develop measurement and correlation methodologies for warpage/coplanarity across room temperature, reflow, and post-assembly conditions.
  • Translate empirical data into actionable controls: stencil strategy, placement approach, reflow profile optimization, and board support concepts.
  • Define practical coplanarity and interface-gap limits based on real manufacturing capability.

Stencil, Paste Deposition, and Defect Reduction

  • Define stencil design guidelines for mixed-technology assemblies (thickness selection, aperture optimization, via-in-pad approaches, paste volume control).
  • Drive strategies to reduce defects including insufficient solder, head-in-pillow, bridging, and voiding.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to evaluate solder paste materials, flux systems, and stencil fabrication technologies.

Placement Strategy and Equipment Capability

  • Define placement process requirements for challenging components: placement force/speed, nozzle and vacuum strategy, and fixturing/support concepts.
  • Develop fixture and board support concepts for large packages
  • Work directly with equipment vendors and manufacturing partners to qualify placement capability and drive tool enhancements when required.

Reflow Technology and Thermal Profiling

  • Drive reflow strategies for assemblies with high thermal mass and uneven heat distribution.
  • Develop profiling methodologies to control thermal gradients across boards and complex component populations.
  • Lead evaluation and deployment of advanced reflow technologies (e.g., vacuum and inert-atmosphere reflow) to improve solder joint integrity and void performance.
  • Define requirements for custom or modified equipment when standard solutions are insufficient.

Thermal Mechanical Solution Robustness and Post-SMT Processes

  • Define and qualify edge bonding and underfill strategies to improve mechanical shock, vibration, and board-level reliability.
  • Develop manufacturable processes for mechanical and thermal hardware integration (heatsinks, clamping, thermal interface materials).
  • Evaluate mechanical stress transfer to solder joints and ensure processes are repeatable and auditable.

BGA Rework and Repair Strategy

  • Develop controlled rework methodologies for complex BGA assemblies, including safe removal/replacement processes.
  • Ensure reworked assemblies meet full quality and reliability requirements through defined acceptance criteria and verification methods.

DFM Leadership and Assembly Guidelines

  • Lead DFM reviews for advanced PCB designs: land patterns, via-in-pad structures, solder mask strategy, component keep-outs, and routing considerations.
  • Provide clear, data-driven feedback to influence design decisions early in development.
  • Author and maintain board-level assembly design guidelines for internal teams and external manufacturing partners.

Cross-Functional and Supplier Collaboration

  • Act as a technical bridge across design engineering, reliability, mechanical/thermal, quality, and global manufacturing teams.
  • Drive technical engagements with contract manufacturers, material suppliers, and equipment vendors.
  • Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for complex yield and reliability issues using engineering rigor and data.

Assembly Technology Innovation

  • Drive development of advanced solutions:
  • Micro spring / spacer technologies
  • Copper spacer block tolerancing
  • Low-temperature solder (LTS) evaluation
  • Vacuum reflow process integration
  • Removable lid concepts for warpage mitigation
  • Define and execute DOE frameworks for new technologies

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Extensive hands-on SMT process development experience for high-complexity PCB assemblies.
  • Demonstrated ownership of large BGA assembly challenges, including warpage, coplanarity, thermal behavior during reflow, and post-assembly stability.
  • Proven track record of developing processes that transition successfully from engineering builds to high-volume manufacturing.
  • Experience working directly with global manufacturing partners and equipment vendors to qualify capability and drive improvements.
  • Strong background in structured problem solving (DOE, statistics, root-cause analysis) for yield and reliability issues.
  • Experience with advanced reflow capabilities (vacuum/inert atmosphere) and void reduction strategies.
  • Experience developing board-level mechanical robustness processes (edge bond/underfill) for demanding environments.
  • Experience defining and implementing rework strategies for complex assemblies while maintaining reliability requirements.
  • Experience with large BGA (>70mm) and high warpage (>400–500 µm class)
  • Experience or knowledge on Reliability Qualification (Board Level) for high-complexity PCB assemblies for temp cycling, random/sine vibration, mechanical shock and failure analysis.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep knowledge of SMT processes: printing/stencil, placement, reflow, and post-reflow stabilization.
  • Strong understanding of BGA solder joint formation, defect mechanisms, and reliability drivers.
  • Practical experience with warpage measurement methods and thermal profiling approaches.
  • Working familiarity with relevant industry standards (e.g., IPC and J-STD) and the ability to apply them pragmatically.
  • Working knowledge of package and board warpage measurement using Shadow Morrie, DIC, inspection measurement system for X-ray, C-SAM, T-SAM etc

Leadership and Communication

  • Ability to operate as a technical authority without direct people management and influence cross-functional decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including authoring technical guidelines and presenting complex topics to diverse audiences.
  • Comfortable challenging assumptions and driving alignment through data and engineering judgment.

Software/Tools Skills

  • Statistical & DOE Tools: Minitab, JMP, or equivalent for Design of Experiments and statistical analysis.
  • CAD Tools: Mentor Graphics, Cadence Allegro or Pentalogix for PCB DFM and layout review.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with experience in manufacture Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related discipline.

Singapore

Job Description

Welcome to the Department of Health.

We’d be delighted to have you join our team.

If you envision yourself in this role and are ready to start an exciting career with us, apply today.

What you will be doing:
Come join our team and play a key role in advancing Alaska's Medicaid program, with a focus on licensed behavioral health services.

In this position, you will be responsible for providing outreach, communication, training, technical support, and all licensing activities pertaining to residential childcare facilities (RCCF) and adult mental health residential homes (AMHR). You will work closely with providers and stakeholders to ensure compliance with state statutes and regulatory standards that govern residential care facilities and ensure background check processing of RCCF and AMHR licensed providers under the authority of the Department of Health.

Additionally, you will be responsible for investigating reports of abuse and neglect, complaints against licensed RCCF and AMHR providers, and conducting licensure activities for all RCCF homes. You will assist with reviewing referrals for the Complex Behavior Collaborative (CBC) program and Preadmission Screening and Resident Review (PASSR). title: Regional Director, Athletics Strategy & Operations
company: Boys & Girls Clubs of the Greater Triad
description:
The Boys & Girls Clubs of the Greater Triad is looking to hire a Regional Director, Athletics Strategy & Operations to support our local youth. Interested in a career that makes an immediate impact on our youth, apply today!

Position Snapshot

Title: Regional Director, Athletics Strategy & Operations

Department: Athletics (BGCTriad Athletics League)

Reports to: President & CEO

Team: Executive Team

Direct Reports: Athletic Directors of each city/designated territory; High Point/Asheboro, Greensboro, Winston-Salem, etc.

Classification: Full-time, exempt Location: Regional (Greater Triad); frequent travel across region

Career Pathway: Structured pathway to Vice President, Athletics


Position Summary

The Regional Director, Athletics Strategy & Operations is the architect, operator, and public face of the BGCTriad Athletics League. This role exists to do one thing exceptionally well: disrupt the pay-to-play system across the Triad.


Across our region, travel leagues, select programs, and elite opportunities have become the domain of families who can afford them. Thousands of young people have the talent, the drive, and the competitive spirit, but not the registration fee and the ability to cover associated costs (equipment, travel, etc.). The BGCTriad Athletics League is our answer: the region's first high-quality, no-cost competitive league. Same quality, same coaching, same competitive experience, regardless of address or income. Not a consolation prize. A premier league.


As a member of the Executive Leadership Team, this leader sets the regional athletics vision, leads the market-specific Athletic Directors, builds the sponsorship engine that keeps the league free to every family, and carries our message into boardrooms, conferences, and community gyms with equal confidence. Athletics is the front door. Academic excellence is the destination. This role owns the front door.


Why This Role, Why Now

  • Scale: The league launched in FY2026/2027 with a target of 450 athletes in Year one and 7,500 by Year five.
  • Reach: The Beyond Sports NC partnership extends in-school reach across 43 Triad schools, creating a direct pipeline from classroom to Club. This collaborative relationship is becoming a full partnership.
  • Portfolio: Basketball, soccer, volleyball, flag football, golf, cheer, esports, clinics, and seasonal camps, with baseball/softball and track & field by 2030.
  • Self-sustaining model: The league does not draw on BGCTriad's core operating budget. It is funded through sponsorships and partnerships, with annual sponsorship potential of $800K–$1.5M by 2030.
  • Economic impact: Athletics is projected to create 120–180 regional jobs (coaches, officials, administrators, event staff) by 2030.


As Future Ready Triad grows, the city-level Athletic Director role becomes market-specific. This role provides the regional strategy, standards, and leadership that make those markets operate as one league.


Key Responsibilities

1. Executive Leadership & Regional Vision

  • Serve on the Executive Leadership Team. Shape organization-wide strategy, budget priorities, and Future Ready Triad expansion decisions through an athletics lens.
  • Own the multi-year athletics strategy: sport portfolio, market sequencing, facility partnerships, and the league's long-term sustainability model.
  • Translate the vision of a no-cost premier league into clear annual goals, operating plans, and accountability measures for every market.
  • Advise the President & CEO on athletics strategy, risk, and opportunity. Prepare board-ready reporting for the monthly board packet.

2. League Architecture & Operations

  • Build and run the BGCTriad Athletics League as one regional system: unified rules, divisions, scheduling, officiating, playoffs, championships, and branding.
  • Set regional standards for program quality, coaching, game-day operations, uniforms, equipment, and facility use.
  • Lead the integration of the Beyond Sports NC partnership. Turn the 43-school footprint into a reliable feeder pipeline into Club membership.
  • Lead the annual sport calendar and the phased addition of new sports and markets, including baseball/softball and track & field by 2030.
  • Ensure every athlete in the league is also connected to the Club's academic interventions, mentoring, and life-skills programming. Athletics is the front door, never the whole house.

3. People Leadership: City Athletic Directors & Staff

  • Directly supervise, coach, and evaluate the market-specific Athletic Directors. Hold each market accountable to shared regional standards while leaving room for local strengths.
  • Build the athletics talent pipeline: recruit, develop, and retain coaches, officials, league administrators, and event staff, including Club alumni returning as paid staff.
  • Establish coaching certification, positive-coaching and trauma-informed training, and performance evaluation systems across the region.
  • Build a culture of discipline, belonging, and excellence where staff see themselves as youth developers first.

4. Sponsorship, Partnerships & Revenue

  • Own the athletics revenue plan. Build a sponsorship portfolio that keeps the league free to every family and fully independent of the core operating budget.
  • Develop, pitch, and close sponsorships: league naming rights, division and tournament sponsors, apparel and equipment partners, media partners, and in-kind support.
  • Grow strategic relationships with regional sports partners, including Carolina Core MLS Next, High Point Rockers, Greensboro Grasshoppers, Greensboro Swarm, Greensboro Gargoyles, and the Greensboro Sports Foundation.
  • Partner with the Senior Director, Advancement Strategies & Systems to align athletics sponsorships with the regional campaign, cultivate donors who care about youth sports, and steward partners well.
  • Pursue grants and national partnership opportunities through Boys & Girls Clubs of America and its national sports partners.

5. External Voice & Public Leadership

  • Serve as BGCTriad's lead public voice for athletics. Speak with confidence and credibility at conferences, sponsor meetings, civic forums, media interviews, and community events.
  • Make the case against pay-to-play with data, stories, and a clear alternative. Position BGCTriad as the regional leader on youth sports access.
  • Represent BGCTriad with school districts, parks and recreation departments, municipalities, sports commissions, and youth sports coalitions.
  • Partner with Communications on the league brand, media strategy, and storytelling.

6. Data, Impact & Accountability

  • Partner with the VP of Programs & Impact and the data team to track participation, retention, academic linkage, and youth outcomes through MyClubHub and NYOI.
  • Help build an athletics dashboard covering enrollment by market, cost per athlete, sponsorship revenue, academic connection, and staff and coach metrics.
  • Use continuous quality improvement to evaluate programs and report results to the executive team, Board, Advisory Councils, sponsors, and the community.

7. Safety, Risk & Compliance

  • Partner with the VP of Safety & Sites to ensure all athletics operations meet or exceed BGCA safety requirements and state and local regulations.
  • Set regional standards for background checks, concussion and injury protocols, emergency action plans, transportation, and facility agreements.
  • Ensure accurate records of waivers, certifications, incidents, and facility safety audits across every market.

8. Financial Stewardship

  • Develop and manage the regional athletics budget, including market-level budgets managed by City Athletic Directors.
  • Maintain cost-per-athlete discipline and a sustainable ratio of sponsorship revenue to operating expense as the league scales.


Qualifications & Competencies

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Sports Management, Business, Education, Nonprofit Management, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in youth sports, athletics administration, recreation, or sports business, including at least 5 years in senior leadership.
  • Proven record of building or scaling multi-site athletic programs or leagues, with responsibility for managers who lead their own teams.
  • Demonstrated success selling and closing sponsorships or corporate partnerships, with a track record of six-figure deals.
  • Polished, confident public speaker who can command a conference stage, a sponsor pitch, and a parent meeting with equal credibility.
  • Experience building and managing budgets of significant size and complexity.
  • Strong working knowledge of youth protection, athletic safety, and risk management standards.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in Sports Management, Business Administration, Nonprofit Leadership, or a related field.
  • Existing relationships across the Triad's sports, corporate, civic, and education communities.
  • Experience with the Aspen Institute Project Play framework, sports-based youth development, or access-and-equity models in youth sports.
  • Experience with Boys & Girls Clubs of America, a national youth-serving organization, a professional or collegiate sports organization, or a sports commission.
  • Familiarity with league management platforms, CRM systems (Salesforce-based preferred), and data dashboards

Leadership Competencies

  • Visionary Builder: Sees the league that does not yet exist and builds the systems, people, and partnerships to make it real.
  • Revenue Driver: Thinks like a sports business executive. Understands sponsor value, activation, and renewal.
  • Public Champion: Tells the pay-to-play story with data and heart. Moves rooms.
  • Leader of Leaders: Develops market-specific Athletic Directors into strong market leaders. Holds a high bar with care.
  • Mission-Anchored: Keeps the connection between athletics and academic excellence at the center of every decision.
  • Disciplined Operator: Executes with strategic velocity. Plans, measures, adjusts, and delivers.
  • Relational Partner: Builds trust with sponsors, schools, municipalities, families, and fellow executives.
  • Safety-First: Treats physical, emotional, and psychological safety as non-negotiable.


What Success Looks Like

The targets come from the Future Ready Triad plan. Bracketed figures will be set with the President & CEO during onboarding.


First 90 days: Assess every market and existing market Athletic Director; Deliver a regional athletics operating plan and FY 2026/2027 league calendar; Build a sponsor prospect pipeline of qualified partners.

Year 1: League launched with 450 athletes. Beyond Sports NC feeder pipeline active. Unified league standards, coaching certification, and safety protocols in place in every market. $200K in closed sponsorship revenue (some in collaboration with Advancement department). Athletics dashboard live in MyClubHub.

Year 3: 2,500 athletes across all active markets. Secure a named league sponsor and multi-year apparel partner. Measurable academic connection for league athletes. City Athletic Directors leading strong, stable markets.

Year 5: 7,500 athletes. $800K–$1.5M in annual athletics sponsorship. League fully selfsustaining. 120–180 athletics jobs created. BGCTriad recognized as the region's leading alternative to pay-to-play.


Pathway to Vice President, Athletics

This role is designed to grow into Vice President, Athletics as the league and the organization scale. Advancement is based on performance, not tenure. It will be reviewed against these milestones:

  1. The league is operating across three or more markets under unified regional standards.
  2. Athletics sponsorship revenue is sustaining the league without drawing on the core operating budget.
  3. City Athletic Directors are developed into strong market leaders, with succession depth in place.
  4. Athlete enrollment, retention, and academic-connection outcomes are on track with Future Ready Triad targets.
  5. The leader is a recognized regional and statewide voice on youth sports access.


At the VP level, the role would carry expanded authority over the athletics enterprise, including facilities strategy, major partnerships, and a larger regional team.

Working Conditions & Physical Requirements

  • Regular evening and weekend work during league seasons, tournaments, and events.
  • Frequent local travel across Triad Club sites, schools, and partner venues. Occasional overnight travel for conferences and BGCA convening.
  • Ability to work in gyms, fields, and outdoor settings in varied weather.
  • Ability to lift up to 25 pounds and stand or walk for extended periods during events.
  • Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and a satisfactory driving record.
  • Must pass a comprehensive background check and meet all BGCA child safety requirements.


Equal Opportunity Statement

Boys & Girls Clubs of the Greater Triad is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: IoT Engineer
description:
Help build connected technology that is changing the way farmers manage livestock

What if the IoT systems you engineered didn't just live in the cloud or a lab, but operated out in the real world?

At eShepherd, we're building connected technology for agriculture, and we're looking for an IoT Engineer to help develop the systems that connect devices, data and applications.

You'll work across the full IoT ecosystem, from device connectivity and data collection through to cloud services and APIs, helping us build secure, scalable and reliable solutions.

If you enjoy solving complicated technical problems, working across hardware and software, and seeing technology you've helped create come to life, this could be a brilliant next move.

Why this role?

This isn't an IoT role where you'll work on one small piece of a much bigger system.

You'll have the opportunity to work across device connectivity, embedded technology, cloud platforms, APIs, data processing, security and system reliability, collaborating with engineering and product teams to create connected solutions from concept through to deployment.

You'll also help investigate complex IoT problems, improve system performance and explore emerging technology that could strengthen future products.

What you'll be doing

You'll:

  • Design and develop end-to-end IoT solutions connecting devices, data, cloud services and APIs

  • Work closely with hardware and software engineers to integrate IoT components into products

  • Build secure, scalable IoT architectures

  • Implement IoT communication protocols and standards

  • Develop data processing and analytics pipelines

  • Test, debug and troubleshoot complex IoT systems

  • Help improve reliability and performance

  • Evaluate new hardware, software and emerging IoT technologies

  • Contribute to technical documentation, code reviews and knowledge sharing.

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone with proven IoT development experience who understands how the different layers of a connected product come together.

Ideally, you'll have:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics Engineering or a related discipline

  • Experience designing and developing IoT applications from concept through to deployment

  • Strong programming capability in languages such as Python, C, JavaScript or Bash

  • Knowledge of technologies and protocols such as MQTT, CoAP, LoRaWAN, cellular IoT and edge computing

  • Experience with AWS, Azure or Google Cloud

  • Strong Linux capability

  • Knowledge of networking, security protocols and data encryption

  • Experience with sensors, actuators, microcontrollers and embedded systems

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Experience with LoRa gateways, data analytics, machine learning or data visualisation would be an added bonus.

Benefits we offer

  • Competitive salary + performance-based incentives

  • Career growth opportunities as eShepherd continues to scale globally

  • Modern tools, technology and equipment to help you do your best work

  • Supportive, collaborative team culture focused on practical problem-solving

  • KiwiSaver contributions

  • Boost App membership + staff discounts across NZ

  • Life & Disability Insurance

  • Free parking at our Hamilton site

  • Subsidised on-site café + great local eateries nearby

  • Employee Assistance Programme

Ready to build something meaningful?

If you're an engineer who loves understanding how things connect, why they fail and how they can work better, we'd love to hear from you.

Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and the role may be filled before the closing date.

title: Full-Stack Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Full-Stack Data Engineer

Job Location: Zapopan, Jalisco, Mexico

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

We are looking for a passionate Full Stack Data Engineer who will help strengthen our data engineering capability with modern software engineering practices. This individual will build robust, maintainable, and scalable data solutions across the data lifecycle, while also contributing to the team’s wider engineering standards, tooling, and ways of working.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who is equally comfortable developing data pipelines, Python services, and automation for deployment and operations, and who can partner effectively with architects, analysts, product teams, and other engineers to deliver reliable data products.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and support scalable data pipelines, data products, and data applications that serve business and analytics needs.

  • Apply software engineering best practices to data engineering, including modular design, version control, code review, automated testing, documentation, and maintainable architecture.

  • Develop Python-based solutions for data processing, orchestration, integration, automation, and supporting application components where required.

  • Own and improve DevOps/DataOps practices for data solutions, including CI/CD, environment promotion, release automation, observability, incident response, and production support.

  • Deliver robust, cost-effective, and automated solutions to address recurring business questions and analytical demands.

  • Design and implement data solutions aligned with enterprise standards, architecture roadmaps, and platform best practices, working closely with Data Architects and Solution Architects.

  • Test and quality assure data and analytics solutions to ensure they are fit for release, including code assurance, unit testing, integration testing, data validation, performance tuning, and release management.

  • Support operational excellence through proactive monitoring, root-cause analysis, issue resolution, and continuous improvement of SLAs and service reliability.

  • Promote engineering consistency across the team by disseminating best practices, coaching peers, contributing reusable patterns, and helping improve standards, tooling, and ways of working.

  • Evaluate and adopt new technologies relevant to data engineering, software engineering, and platform automation, including proof-of-value assessments and contribution to business cases.

  • Contribute to estimates, delivery planning, and solution design for new data initiatives and enhancements.

  • Ensure business data assets are delivered as trusted, discoverable, and reusable data products/services for broader enterprise consumption, in alignment with strategic data principles.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions, define acceptance criteria, and establish appropriate operational and service expectations.

  • Maintain ongoing professional development in modern data, cloud, and engineering practices to help keep AstraZeneca current with a changing technology landscape.

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong software engineering background, with hands-on experience building production-grade solutions using sound engineering principles such as modular design, testing, code review, and maintainability.

  • Strong Python engineering skills, including building reusable packages, APIs, automation scripts, data processing components, and integration services.

  • Hands-on experience designing and operating solutions in Snowflake, including virtual warehouse configuration, resource monitors, governance, and performance tuning.

  • Expert SQL for analytics and transformation, with strong skills in query optimization, pruning, caching behavior, and result set reuse.

  • Experience building robust pipelines into Snowflake with tools such as dbt, Airflow, dataops.live, Fivetran, AWS Glue, or AWS Lambda, with strong understanding of staging patterns, incremental loads, CDC, retries, error handling, and observability.

  • Practical experience with data modeling, including dimensional and normalized approaches, and strong understanding of schema design, standardization, clustering keys, micro-partitioning, and workload/performance strategies.

  • Experience with dbt modeling layers, materializations, testing, project configuration, documentation standards, and data contracts.

  • Experience implementing automated testing and quality controls for data solutions, including unit, integration, and data validation testing.

  • Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, and deployment automation for data and application components.

  • Experience with DevOps/DataOps practices, including environment management, release management, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and production support.

  • Experience integrating Python-based data engineering solutions with serverless and cloud-native services, such as AWS Lambda and AWS Glue.

  • Demonstrated track record delivering solutions on modern data platforms such as Snowflake or Redshift, and integrating them with downstream analytics or visualization tools.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including diagnosing and resolving production issues in complex data environments.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions and data products with clear ownership, SLAs, and acceptance criteria.

  • Strong understanding of FAIR data principles and data product best practices, including discoverability, metadata, lineage, interoperability, access controls, versioning, and consumer-oriented design.

  • Effective working independently and within cross-functional, cross-cultural teams, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Demonstrable passion for learning and for improving engineering practices across a team.

Desired Skills

  • Experience using Starburst/Trino for distributed SQL across heterogeneous data sources.

  • Familiarity with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and highly automated platform or pipeline delivery patterns.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code and environment provisioning in cloud-based data platforms.

  • Familiarity with metadata and catalog tooling such as Collibra to improve lineage, standards adoption, reuse, and observability.

  • Experience using PySpark for large-scale data processing and transformation in distributed environments.

  • Experience building lightweight application or service layers that complement data pipelines, such as APIs, internal tools, or operational utilities.

  • Experience mentoring peers and helping establish engineering standards across a team or community of practice.

Summary

The Full Stack Data Engineer is responsible for the design, development, deployment, and operational support of scalable data products and data applications in a DevOps/DataOps delivery model. This role combines strong data engineering expertise with a solid software engineering background, especially in Python, cloud-native development, and engineering automation.

The role is expected not only to build reliable data solutions, but also to raise engineering maturity across the team by disseminating best practices in software design, testing, CI/CD, observability, reuse, and operational excellence.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer based in Spain.

Join a fast-growing European technology environment focused on protecting businesses from modern web threats and securing web traffic at scale.
As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you’ll take ownership of infrastructure automation, deployment pipelines, and the systems powering critical services across multiple data centers.
You’ll work hands-on with Kubernetes, Ansible, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, Linux, and modern observability tooling to build reliable and scalable infrastructure.
The role spans the full development lifecycle, from infrastructure-as-code and automated deployments to production operations, monitoring, and incident response.
You’ll collaborate closely with product and engineering teams while helping solve complex challenges around scalability, availability, security, and performance.
The environment values technical ownership, continuous learning, thoughtful collaboration, and the confidence to challenge established approaches.
This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a remote-first engineering organization where infrastructure quality is treated with the same importance as product quality.

Accountabilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions using Ansible and Terraform, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and automation.

  • Plan, organize, monitor, and continuously improve infrastructure performance across multiple environments and data centers.

  • Maintain, operate, and optimize existing infrastructure, deployment systems, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Build and improve automated deployment processes for applications across testing and production environments.

  • Develop and maintain toolchains, workflows, and automation that reduce manual operational work and improve engineering efficiency.

  • Set up and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, and tracing to ensure system visibility and reliability.

  • Participate in incident analysis, troubleshooting, and root-cause resolution for infrastructure and deployment issues.

  • Help ensure infrastructure meets appropriate security, reliability, and compliance standards.

  • Document infrastructure, operational procedures, improvements, and technical decisions.

  • Collaborate continuously with product and engineering teams to understand requirements and deliver robust infrastructure solutions.

  • Contribute to decisions around scalability, availability, performance, and architecture, while constructively challenging approaches when necessary.

  • Maintain high standards for the quality, maintainability, and reliability of infrastructure code.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of professional DevOps experience, including substantial hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Git, and infrastructure automation.

    • Deep expertise with Ansible, particularly in complex environments, combined with practical experience using Terraform.

    • Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, and virtualization.

    • Strong hands-on experience with Grafana, Prometheus, and Alertmanager for monitoring and observability.

    • Experience with Linux software packaging and distribution formats, including DEB, RPM, and Docker.

    • Strong scripting skills, particularly with Bash.

    • Experience with web security and an understanding of web traffic distribution and related infrastructure concepts.

    • Experience working with SQL and object storage, including data handling and related infrastructure workflows.

    • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, GitLab, and CI/CD practices.

    • Experience with Golang is a significant advantage.

    • A strong understanding of infrastructure-as-code principles and end-to-end automated deployment pipelines.

    • Curiosity, enthusiasm, and a genuine desire to continuously learn and improve.

    • Strong ownership and decision-making skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and build solutions as part of a team.

    • Good time-management and asynchronous communication skills suited to a remote-first engineering environment.

    • Ability to work independently while contributing constructively to a collaborative, expert-driven team.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote: Work remotely within Europe and enjoy the flexibility of a remote-first engineering environment.

      • International environment: Collaborate with distributed teams working across multiple countries and data centers.

      • Technical ownership: Take meaningful responsibility for infrastructure, automation, reliability, and operational excellence.

      • Modern technology stack: Work with technologies including Linux, GitLab, Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, RabbitMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, and ClickHouse.

      • Learning opportunities: Work on challenging infrastructure and web-security problems while continuously expanding your technical expertise.

      • Collaborative culture: Join an expert-focused environment built around professional collaboration rather than internal competition.

      • Impact and autonomy: Contribute directly to infrastructure decisions and help shape scalable, highly available systems.

      • Inclusive workplace: The organization actively encourages applications from diverse backgrounds and is committed to creating an inclusive working environment.

title: Director - Product Management
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director - Product Management based in the United States.

This is a senior product leadership opportunity focused on shaping differentiated solutions for defense and intelligence markets.
You will define product strategy across Earth observation data, geospatial analytics, AI/ML, contextual data, and mission workflows.
The role is highly customer-facing, requiring close engagement with government users, acquisition stakeholders, commercial customers, technical teams, and industry partners.
You will translate complex mission needs into scalable products, clear roadmaps, strong requirements, and compelling commercial offerings.
A major focus will be identifying reusable capabilities, making evidence-based investment decisions, and balancing customer value, market opportunity, revenue potential, and technical feasibility.
You will operate at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Federal, Growth, Sales, Analytics, and Partnerships, driving alignment without creating unnecessary process.
For an experienced product leader with deep U.S. Government defense and intelligence expertise, this role offers substantial influence over strategy, commercialization, and mission-focused technology adoption.

Accountabilities

  • Define and continuously refine product strategy, roadmaps, investment priorities, and product direction for defense and intelligence offerings.

  • Lead continuous market and customer discovery with U.S. Government users, mission owners, buyers, program offices, acquisition stakeholders, partners, and industry influencers.

  • Translate mission problems, customer feedback, and operational workflows into clear product requirements, desired outcomes, priorities, and measurable success criteria.

  • Identify common customer and mission requirements and turn them into scalable products, reusable capabilities, and configurable workflows.

  • Distinguish between strategic product investments, reusable customer-driven capabilities, and one-off custom development opportunities.

  • Make evidence-based recommendations on what to build, improve, package, partner for, or deprioritize based on customer value, market size, differentiation, revenue potential, strategic fit, and technical feasibility.

  • Convert recurring mission and customer needs into differentiated offerings that can be repeatedly commercialized and delivered.

  • Partner with Federal, Growth, and Business Development teams to understand funded demand, shape opportunities, support capture activities, and create product proof points that enable revenue growth.

  • Develop and evolve pricing, packaging, licensing, and value propositions based on customer willingness to pay, acquisition pathways, budget structures, competitive dynamics, and product economics.

  • Drive the product substance behind customer-facing materials, product briefs, demonstrations, presentations, proposals, use cases, and sales enablement content.

  • Establish disciplined customer validation processes to assess problems, value propositions, workflow fit, usability, adoption potential, and willingness to pay before and after major investments.

  • Build a strong operating relationship with Engineering by providing customer context, priorities, requirements, and desired outcomes while allowing technical teams to own architecture and delivery execution.

  • Work closely with Sales and Market leadership to ensure customer and capture needs inform product decisions without allowing individual opportunities to dictate long-term product strategy.

  • Monitor competitors and substitutes across commercial Earth observation, GEOINT, analytics, AI/ML, workflow, and data-fusion markets and translate market developments into product strategy.

  • Communicate product strategy, customer evidence, investment decisions, risks, and performance to senior leadership.

  • Drive alignment across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Growth, Programs, Partnerships, and Federal leadership.

  • Define and monitor outcome-oriented product metrics including customer validation, adoption, usage, time-to-value, product reuse, pipeline influence, revenue contribution, and lifecycle performance.

  • Operate with urgency and responsiveness, proactively identifying customer, market, product, and execution issues before they become escalations.

  • Maintain accountability through the full product lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through validation, commercialization, and customer adoption.

    • Requirements:

    • 10+ years of product management, product strategy, or closely related product leadership experience, including meaningful experience at Senior Product Manager, Group Product Manager, Principal, Director, or comparable level.

    • Demonstrated experience taking data-intensive, analytics, geospatial, ISR, AI/ML, or workflow products from discovery through commercialization and adoption.

    • Strong knowledge of U.S. Government defense and intelligence mission environments, including user and operator workflows and government buying behavior.

    • Must be a U.S. Citizen.

    • Must hold a minimum active Secret clearance; active TS/SCI is strongly preferred.

    • Strong understanding of U.S. Government mission needs, budgets, spending cycles, acquisition pathways, and adoption of commercial GEOINT and Earth observation capabilities.

    • Experience working directly with customers and users to conduct discovery, validate problems, test concepts, and translate insights into product decisions.

    • Strong commercial judgment, including experience with pricing, packaging, market segmentation, product positioning, and revenue-oriented product strategy.

    • Ability to translate complex technical, geospatial, and mission concepts into concise product requirements and executive-level recommendations.

    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop customer-facing product materials and represent products in external meetings.

    • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to lead across matrixed organizations without relying on direct authority.

    • Ability to balance customer needs, market signals, economics, mission impact, strategic priorities, and technical feasibility when making product decisions.

    • Comfortable operating in an environment where Product owns market solutions, product strategy, priorities, requirements, and outcomes while Market teams lead capture and revenue execution and Engineering owns technical delivery.

    • Highly responsive, proactive, evidence-driven, and comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

    • Preferred experience with GEOINT, remote sensing, commercial electro-optical imagery, spectral data, SAR, or multi-source geospatial analytics.

    • Preferred experience working with U.S. intelligence community agencies, COCOMs, Military Services, NRO, NGA, or other civil, defense, or intelligence organizations.

    • Experience with international defense markets such as Canada, Europe, or Australia is a plus.

    • Knowledge of federal acquisition, appropriations, PPBE and budget cycles, OTAs, CSOs, IDIQs, data purchases, software licensing, and other commercial technology adoption pathways is highly desirable.

    • Experience with product-led capture, market shaping, customer advocacy, or emerging commercial technology adoption is a plus.

    • Prior military, intelligence community, or federal service experience with direct exposure to analyst, operator, or mission workflows is advantageous.

    • Washington Metropolitan Area location is preferred.

      • Benefits:

      • Full-time remote position within the United States.

      • Washington Metropolitan Area location preferred.

      • Senior product leadership role with significant ownership of defense and intelligence product strategy.

      • Opportunity to shape products combining Earth observation, geospatial analytics, AI/ML, contextual data, and mission workflows.

      • Direct engagement with U.S. Government users, acquisition stakeholders, senior leaders, industry partners, and commercial customers.

      • High visibility across Product, Engineering, Federal, Growth, Analytics, Sales, Programs, and Partnerships.

      • Opportunity to influence pricing, packaging, commercialization, product investment, and revenue strategy.

      • Significant autonomy and influence within a fast-moving, evidence-driven product organization.

      • Opportunity to develop scalable technology solutions addressing complex defense and intelligence missions.

title: Senior Delivery Consultant - Mainframe, AWS Professional Services
description:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in leading large-scale portfolio assessment and application disposition for enterprise data centre exit programmes spanning multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure through discovery tooling and application owner interviews, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS — assigning R-strategies (Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retire, Retain, Relocate) and designing wave plans that respect dependency groupings, capacity constraints, and regulatory frozen zones. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on migration best practices, risk mitigation, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the end-to-end migration assessment process, ensuring adherence to AWS well-architected principles, optimizing wave sequencing, and managing risks throughout the programme lifecycle.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
As an experienced mainframe modernisation professional, you will be responsible for:

- Leading the assessment and discovery of customer mainframe estates, including application portfolio analysis, dependency mapping, and modernisation readiness evaluation
- Designing and implementing modernisation solutions on AWS — including replatforming, refactoring to cloud-native services, and automated code transformation approaches
- Providing deep technical guidance on mainframe technologies (COBOL, PL/I, JCL, CICS, IMS, DB2, VSAM) and their AWS equivalents throughout project delivery
- Collaborating with customer architects, development teams, and business stakeholders to define migration waves, prioritise workloads, and manage cutover risk
- Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on mainframe modernisation trends, including AI-assisted code transformation, automated testing strategies, and incremental migration patterns
- Sharing knowledge within the organisation through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts such as modernisation playbooks, assessment frameworks, and reference architectures

About the team
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

The position may require up to 50% travel to customer sites.

title: Project Coordinator II
description:
Project Coordinator – Parsippany, NJ

Full-Time | In-Office Position I Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM

Pella is seeking a Project Coordinator for our Parsippany, NJ office. The Project Coordinator (PC) position is generally assigned to a specific segment of business, either Retail Sales, Trade Sales, or Commercial Sales. The PC is primarily responsible for coordinating the order entry, purchasing, scheduling, releasing, delivery, and possible installation of customer orders in a timely manner. Responsible for ensuring that each detail in the customer’s order is addressed by managing orders from the point of contract through final resolution, which may include post installation and/or service issues. Works closely with sales teams, order fulfillment teams, and 3rd party providers to achieve and provide excellent customer satisfaction. Must be able to work well in a team environment. Assigned tasks may vary based on business necessity. The ideal candidate will have experience working with sales teams on customer orders and have strong organizational and communication skills.

The target pay range for this role is $25 - $30/hr., with eligibility to receive other supplemental earnings such as over-time. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, experience, specific work geography, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. As a member of the Pella Family of Brands team, you will be eligible for company sponsored benefits that include healthcare, dental, vision, paid time off, 9 paid holidays, company paid life insurance, a generous 401(k) plan, tuition assistance, and much more. Relocation is not offered for this position.

Responsibilities/Accountabilities:

  • External and internal customer contact
  • Reviewing and booking orders from the sales team
  • Purchasing product from vendors and our corporate manufacturing facilities
  • Recording key dates and activities related to orders
  • Scheduling and releasing completed product
  • Scheduling of Value Add and Pre-finish
  • Coordinating delivery of customer orders
  • Collects customer payments following installation or delivery as needed
  • Managing recovery process for shortages and damaged product
  • Ordering parts and/or scheduling service appointments as needed
  • Processes factory credits to Pella Corporation and provides follow up/revision to pending or denied credits
  • Resource for PQM /ADM and product offering questions
  • May assist with physical inventory and help resolve inventory discrepancies

  • Promotes and facilitates continuous improvement activities in the department

Retail Segment Specific:

  • Coordination and management of installation permits
  • Collecting and verifying Lead Safe Install paperwork when applicable
  • Scheduling installation of Pella products
  • Scheduling installation recovery appointments

  • Approving and processing payments for sub-contracted installation companies

Trade and Commercial Segment Specific:

  • Quoting and bidding of Pella products as needed
  • Regularly communicates with Sales Representatives, internal and external customers in order to ensure timely and accurate fulfillment of orders
  • Manages orders in OMS including scheduling value add and coordinating and communicating the estimated ship date

  • Communicates with customers, contractors and sales department to coordinate product delivery details along with verification of addresses, phone numbers and directions


Skills/Knowledge:

  • Provide superb customer service
  • Works collaboratively with Pella team members and customers
  • Enjoys working in fast-paced environment with a high sense of urgency
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Seeks out internal experts and utilizes their knowledge
  • Adaptable to changing processes and priorities
  • Focused on details and follow through
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and ability to learn internal software programs and applications

Qualifications
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The qualifications, physical demands and work environment characteristics listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required to successfully perform the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience
Must have High School Diploma or GED. AA or Technical degree preferred, 0-2 year’s customer service, or general business experience preferred. Prior knowledge of general construction applications and terminology and/or window and door applications or components is desirable but not required.

Computer Skills
Proficiency with Microsoft® Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint software applications. Will be expected to develop proficiency in Pella proprietary software (i.e. PQM, POETS, OMS, etc.).

Communication Skills
Excellent verbal and written English language skills are required as well as good public relations, public speaking, and customer service skills. Ability to read, interpret, understand and explain documents such as sales processes, product specifications or warranty manuals. Ability to effectively present information to others, gather information from others, and respond appropriately to questions from customers, coworkers and managers. Must display excellent phone and email etiquette. Must be able to present appropriate attitude for the situation when interacting with customers or coworkers.

Professional Skills
Must be a team player and exhibit a strong desire to learn and promote self-growth. Must be pro-active, self-disciplined, self-motivated, and have a demonstrated ability to follow projects through to completion. Attention to detail is required. Must be able to demonstrate organizational skills, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines. Must be able to develop trust, respect, and confidence of customers, coworkers and managers. Must present in a clean and neat physical appearance. Must be able to investigate issues and resolve conflict in the best interests of the business and our customers.

Mathematical Skills
Ability to subtract two digit numbers and to multiply and divide with 10s and 100s. Ability to perform calculations using units of money, time, measurement, etc. Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as proportions, percentages, area, length, width, height, and depth. Ability to apply basic concepts of algebra, geometry and general business math.

Physical Demands
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, type or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit, stoop, or crouch. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Time commitment required of this position will vary based on business needs.

Work Environment
Work environment with this job primarily includes the typical office environment. The noise level of this job is typically moderate. Employees in office positions may occasionally enter warehouse work areas.

title: Senior Software Engineer - South Bank, QLD
description:
At Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG) our purpose is to 'open up the world for those who want to see'. Every day, we give people all around the world the opportunity to experience something amazing – travel!

As a Senior Software Engineer you will design, build, test, and deploy scalable digital solutions that deliver real value to customers. You'll be joining the MyAccount team, responsible for customer account and profile management across 4 FCTG brands — covering login, account details, and preferences for around 700,000 members globally. The stack is TypeScript, React, and Next.js on the frontend, a Fastify API backend, and Auth0 for authentication.

Day to day:

  • Drive continuous improvement by reducing technical debt, enhancing documentation, and identifying opportunities to improve processes, quality, and team effectiveness

You'll be perfect for the role if you have:

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, including proven experience as a Senior Full Stack Engineer delivering end-to-end solutions across front-end and back-end technologies
  • Hands-on experience with Auth0, including passwordless authentication flows (e.g. Universal Login email-code/magic-link passwordless, SMS-based MFA/OTP)
  • Demonstrated understanding of Agile principles, practices, and software delivery methodologies
  • Strong knowledge of modern software engineering principles, secure coding practices, and solution design
  • Proven experience leading, coaching, and developing engineering teams while building strong stakeholder relationships
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to manage competing priorities, identify risks and opportunities, and deliver business outcomes
  • Experience with modern architectural patterns such as microservices, event-driven architecture, and serverless solutions; experience within travel, retail, or internet-scale environments is highly regarded

title: Leasing Specialist / Agent
description:
General Description


Under direction of the Community Manager, the Leasing Specialist is responsible for assisting in all operations of the leasing office. The Leasing Specialist should work to minimize vacancy, quickly lease apartments, meet all occupancy goals, promote good working resident and public relations, assure program compliance and perform clerical duties as required Leasing Specialist maybe required to direct maintenance personnel to ensure that property is maintained at all times in good physical condition.


Location

  • Tamarack Station located at 1801 Davis Street in Camden, NJ 08104.

Schedule

  • Full-Time
  • 40 hours per week
  • 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM
  • Monday - Friday

Job Description

  • Adhere to all Company personnel directives as per the manual of policies and procedures.
  • Answer the telephone and convert prospect calls to appointments for a tour.
  • Greet prospects, qualify their needs and wants, tour prospective residents and present features and benefits of the community. Complete guest card and invite the prospect to lease an apartment. Ask them to complete and application and leave a deposit.
  • Coordinate all marketing of vacant units including required social media postings
  • Work effectively with local housing authority, if applicable, to ensure timely leasing and recertifying of applicants/residents for the tax credit units. Must meet required deadlines for processing required paperwork for all recertifications.
  • Ensure complete implementation and compliance with Tax Credit/DHCR/Section 8, and any other pertinent housing program requirements and directives as appropriate.
  • Collect rents and handle delinquent accounts in a timely and efficient manner
  • Receive and assist with processing residents’ service requests.
  • Perform move-in inspections and generate applicable work orders as required.
  • Perform clerical functions, data entry, organizing all filing, other tasks as needed.
  • Adhere to all appropriate Company accounting directives.
  • Prepare all reports as required and directed and meet required deadlines.
  • Handle all details of move-ins and move-outs, giving special attention to apartment inspection check lists.
  • Ensure that residents are provided with a clean, safe and well-maintained community. Perform any necessary touch up cleaning that may be needed when you first arrive (all common areas, entry and model).
  • Work effectively with staff, residents, applicants and visitors.
  • Report accidents and emergency situations to the Community Manager immediately.
  • Ensure that all maintenance requests are handled on a timely basis, and that residents are notified if parts must be ordered or if there is any other type of delay. Ensure that appropriate written records are kept of all maintenance work completed.
  • Physical attendance at assigned work location during scheduled hours is essential.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.
  • Work assigned hours as required and requested, which may include an occasional evening or a weekend day to meet prospective applicants in order to meet occupancy goals.

Experience

  • 2+ years’ prior apartment leasing experience preferred.
  • Experience in Low Income Tax Credit (LIHTC), HUD-Section 8, HOME RD or other compliance programs including Fair Housing compliance needed.
  • Yardi, Boston Poston or other property management software experience preferred.
  • Prior customer service experience helpful to interact with residents, visitors, team members.
  • Ability to keep accurate, organized files and records.
  • Data entry skills to enter data into system programs.
  • Math aptitude; understanding of debits, credits, basic accounting.
  • Bilingual (Spanish, other) helpful.

Education

  • Minimum High School diploma/GED equivalent required. Some college helpful.
  • Certifications COS, TCS desired or willing to obtain.

title: Solutions Consultant, Digital Assets
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Consultant, Digital Assets based in Germany.

This is a client-facing consulting role focused on helping financial institutions navigate the rapidly evolving digital asset and regulatory landscape.
You will work directly with banks, CASPs, custodians, and regulators across Europe, acting as a trusted technical and advisory partner.
The role combines solution consulting, regulatory expertise, client discovery, and hands-on delivery of strategic engagements.
You will translate complex compliance, risk, and technology challenges into clearly scoped solutions, proposals, and actionable recommendations.
Your insights from client engagements will directly influence product development, commercial strategy, and future solutions.
The position offers significant autonomy, international exposure, and the opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders across financial services and Web3.
This is an ideal opportunity for a consultant or financial services professional who thrives in forward-deployed environments and enjoys solving complex client problems.

Accountabilities

  • Spend extended periods working on-site with compliance, risk, innovation, and regulatory teams at banks, CASPs, custodians, and other financial institutions across Europe.

  • Lead discovery sessions with clients and prospects to understand their workflows, technology environments, pain points, regulatory obligations, and underlying business needs.

  • Document client requirements and insights clearly and accurately, using the client's terminology and context to ensure findings can inform product and commercial decisions.

  • Translate client discoveries into actionable input for Product and Business Development teams, helping shape product roadmaps and go-to-market strategies.

  • Partner with Business Development during client meetings and regulatory discussions, taking ownership of solution design, technical follow-up, and engagement delivery.

  • Present products and services to senior compliance, risk, regulatory, and executive audiences in a clear, credible, and consultative manner.

  • Convert client challenges into well-defined proposals with clear scope, deliverables, timelines, and expected outcomes.

  • Lead advisory engagements including licensing-readiness reviews, regulatory gap analyses, technical due diligence, digital asset strategy assessments, workshops, and client reports.

  • Represent the organization at relevant industry conferences, events, and regulator meetings across the region.

  • Coordinate effectively with international teams across Europe, North America, and Asia and manage collaboration across multiple time zones.

    • Requirements

    • 3+ years of experience in a client-facing consulting, solutions consulting, business development, compliance, risk, regulatory, or similar role.

    • Experience working with or within banks, CASPs, custodians, or other regulated financial institutions, with a practical understanding of how compliance and risk functions operate day to day.

    • Strong knowledge of financial services regulatory compliance and related technology.

    • Professional-level writing and presentation skills, with the ability to create client-ready reports and communicate effectively with senior compliance, risk, regulatory, and executive stakeholders.

    • Demonstrated ability to independently manage client relationships and consulting engagements from discovery through delivery with limited supervision.

    • Comfortable working in a forward-deployed environment and spending several weeks at a time on client sites.

    • Willingness and ability to travel regularly across Europe, with occasional travel outside the region.

    • Strong consulting, problem-solving, stakeholder-management, and communication skills.

    • Knowledge of European digital asset regulatory frameworks such as MiCA, FCA, BaFin, or AMF is highly advantageous.

    • Experience with VASP licensing, regulatory examinations, compliance remediation, or regulatory-readiness programs is a plus.

    • Familiarity with compliance, risk, surveillance, or regulatory technology platforms is beneficial.

    • Big Four or financial services consulting experience is advantageous.

    • Additional European language skills and established relationships with compliance, risk, innovation, or regulatory leaders across European financial institutions are valuable.

    • Ability to operate effectively across international teams and changing client environments.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote position based in Europe.

      • High-impact, client-facing role within the digital asset and financial services ecosystem.

      • Opportunity to work directly with banks, CASPs, custodians, regulators, and senior industry stakeholders.

      • Significant autonomy and ownership over client engagements and solution delivery.

      • Exposure to emerging digital asset regulations and evolving financial technology.

      • Opportunity to influence product roadmaps and commercial strategies through direct client insights.

      • International collaboration across Europe, North America, and Asia.

      • Opportunity to represent the organization at industry events and regulatory meetings.

      • Flexible working environment combined with substantial travel and on-site client exposure.

      • Contract-based opportunity with the potential to work on complex, strategically important consulting engagements.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Gerente de Planejamento Financeiro | Cartões based in Brazil.

As Gerente de Planejamento Financeiro, you will lead the financial planning agenda for three strategic business verticals: Cards, Banking, and Insurance. You will operate at the intersection of rigorous financial analysis, business strategy, and executive stakeholder management. The role will be responsible for long-term planning, budgeting, forecasting, performance management, and efficient capital allocation. You will act as a strategic Financial Business Partner, supporting decisions around profitability, new products, portfolio performance, and business viability. A deep understanding of credit card economics will be essential to building accurate and defensible P&L perspectives. You will also lead and develop a team while driving automation, data, and AI initiatives to increase analytical efficiency.

Accountabilities

  • Act as a strategic Financial Business Partner for the Cards, Banking, and Insurance businesses, supporting data-driven decision-making and evaluating the economic feasibility of new products and features.

  • Lead monthly, annual, and long-term financial planning cycles, establishing analytical standards, operating cadences, and continuous reforecasting processes.

  • Manage business performance through Real vs. Budget vs. Forecast analyses, business-unit closing processes, and executive reporting for senior leadership, directors, and board-level stakeholders.

  • Build, parameterize, and continuously improve financial projection models, with strong focus on credit card unit economics.

  • Analyze key card profitability drivers, including product P&L, interchange revenue, net interest income (NII), funding costs, delinquency, credit provisions, and cohort/vintage performance.

  • Partner closely with Credit and Collections teams to reconcile risk and revenue perspectives and establish a consistent, robust view of product P&L.

  • Drive automation, data utilization, and practical applications of AI to improve team efficiency and increase capacity for high-value strategic analysis.

  • Lead, coach, and develop the direct team, strengthening technical capabilities and raising the quality of financial analysis and business partnership.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience in FP&A or Strategic Finance within banks, fintechs, credit card issuers, or payment companies managing their own credit portfolios.

    • Deep practical and conceptual knowledge of credit card financial dynamics, including NII, funding costs, interchange, fees, revolving credit, credit risk, PDD/provisions, and cohort/vintage analysis.

    • Advanced financial modeling skills using Excel or Google Sheets, with the ability to accurately and robustly represent complex business dynamics.

    • Fluent English, both written and spoken, with confidence in executive presentations and communication with external stakeholders.

    • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to navigate senior audiences and communicate with technical authority.
