title: Java Backend Developer
description:
Als Java Backend Developer speel je een cruciale rol in het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren van backend-oplossingen voor onze applicaties. Je bent niet alleen medeverantwoordelijk voor het schrijven van hoogwaardige code, maar ook voor het optimaliseren van de infrastructuur en het stroomlijnen van het ontwikkelproces.

De ICT afdeling, team Victorie bij Beeld & Geluid, houdt toezicht op de volledige IT-infrastructuur. Dit varieert van het interactieve museum tot een state-of-the-art media assetmanagement- en archiveringssysteem dat alle content van de Nederlandse publieke omroepen duurzaam bewaart en beschikbaar stelt. Ook de digitalisering straat, met high-end filmscanning- en editing apparatuur, valt onder onze verantwoordelijkheid.

  • Locatie: Hilversum
  • Uren: 40 uur per week
  • Salaris: € 4.445,53 - € 6.350,65

Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn in de eerste plaats een van de grootste en meest vooruitstrevende media-archieven ter wereld. We bewaren diverse soorten media, zoals radio- en televisieprogramma’s, video(games), geschreven pers, politieke prenten, podcasts, websites en objecten. Als betrouwbaar media-instituut bewaren we onze dagelijks groeiende mediacollectie als erfgoed voor de eeuwigheid en brengen we deze collectie tot leven.

Maar we zijn meer dan een archief! We zijn ook een verrassende, inspirerende, creatieve en toegankelijke ontmoetingsplek voor iedereen. Van individuele bezoekers tot professionele mediamakers; iedereen is welkom en verbinden zit in ons dna. We organiseren talloze publieksactiviteiten, debatten en lezingen voor jong en oud. Scholen bieden we een breed pakket aan workshops en we stimuleren academisch en journalistiek onderzoek.

Met zo’n 500 bevlogen collega’s, waarin we onze zeer waardevolle vrijwilligers en stagiairs natuurlijk meetellen, dragen we iedere dag vanuit ons veelkleurige pand in Hilversum bij aan een open, vrije, inclusieve en mediawijze samenleving.

Wie ben je?

  • Je hebt minstens 5 jaar aantoonbare ervaring met Java 17, Spring (Boot), Hibernate, Elasticsearch, SQL, IntelliJ IDEA, TDD;
  • Je bent aantoonbaar in staat om vanaf scratch een oplossing voor uiteenlopende problemen te ontwerpen;
  • Je bent geïnteresseerd in DevOps-methodologieën;
  • We vinden het een grote pre wanneer je Scrum ervaring hebt;
  • Je bent bekend met cloudplatforms zoals (AWS/Azure/) en containerisatie (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Je beschikt over een groot probleemoplossend vermogen en je hebt aandacht voor details bij het schrijven van code en het implementeren van oplossingen;
  • Je hebt uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en je bent een teamspeler;

Ons aanbod

Je eerste contract is een jaarcontract. Als we blij zijn met elkaar verlengen we met veel plezier, tot het einde van het project. Het bruto maandsalaris (op fulltime basis) is minimaal € 4.445,43 en maximaal € 6.350,65 (schaal 11 CAO Beeld & Geluid).

Hoe leuk werken bij Beeld & Geluid ook is, we hechten ook veel waarde aan vrije tijd. Per jaar heb je daarom maar liefst 25 vakantiedagen en 24 atv-dagen (op fulltime basis). Krijg je die niet op? Dan kun je ook je vakantiedagen inzetten voor andere leuke dingen, zoals de aanschaf van een (elektrische) fiets, laptop of het verwezenlijken van een droomreis. Hiervoor maken we gebruik van een cafetariamodel.

Wij geloven dat de échte magie op de werkvloer ontstaat: dáár gebeurt het! Daarom ontmoeten we elkaar graag op kantoor en is het uitgangspunt dat je minimaal 50% van je tijd op kantoor werkt. Natuurlijk kijken we altijd met een schuin oog naar de dynamiek van je functie en je persoonlijke omstandigheden: maatwerk is altijd bespreekbaar, net zoals een vaste thuiswerkdag per week. Je ontvangt een onkostenvergoeding voor thuiswerken en voor woon-werkverkeer, afhankelijk vanuit waar je werkt!

Ook interessant

De ICT afdeling, team Victorie bij Beeld & Geluid, houdt toezicht op de volledige IT-infrastructuur.

Kimley-Horn is seeking a Sr. Transmission Engineer to help expand our Power Delivery team in Pasadena, CA. title: Senior Motion Graphics Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Motion Graphics Designer based in Brazil.

This role offers the opportunity to directly influence the growth of mobile games through high-quality, performance-driven creative content.
You will create motion graphics, gameplay-focused ads, editorial videos, and high-volume creative variations for paid media campaigns.
Working at the intersection of design, storytelling, video production, and performance marketing, you will turn creative concepts and campaign insights into compelling short-form content.
Your work will help develop stronger hooks, communicate gameplay effectively, and create modular assets that can be tested, optimized, and scaled across advertising platforms.
You will collaborate closely with creative leadership, user acquisition, design, and other stakeholders to align creative output with campaign objectives.
The role combines hands-on production with continuous experimentation, requiring strong creative judgment and an understanding of performance data.
You will work in a remote, collaborative environment with significant ownership, access to modern AI tools, and opportunities to expand your creative and strategic impact.

Accountabilities

  • Design and animate high-quality motion graphics for user acquisition, social media, and digital marketing campaigns using typography, transitions, visual effects, gameplay assets, UI elements, and graphic design.

  • Edit gameplay captures, promotional footage, AI-generated content, voiceovers, music, and sound effects into engaging short-form advertising videos.

  • Apply strong editorial principles, including pacing, timing, rhythm, composition, and visual storytelling, to create compelling narratives and effective opening hooks.

  • Develop new creative concepts as well as high-volume variations of existing ads, systematically testing hooks, messaging, gameplay moments, pacing, and visual treatments.

  • Produce performance-driven video advertising creatives for platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, AppLovin, Moloco, and other digital advertising channels.

  • Apply user acquisition and performance marketing best practices to improve creative effectiveness and campaign outcomes.

  • Build organized, modular After Effects projects and reusable creative templates that enable rapid iteration and scalable production.

  • Adapt creative assets across multiple aspect ratios, formats, placements, and platform requirements while maintaining visual consistency and production quality.

  • Maintain well-organized project files, naming conventions, source assets, and final deliverables to support efficient collaboration and scalable workflows.

  • Integrate AI tools into ideation, asset creation, editing, production, iteration, and creative adaptation while applying strong creative judgment to maintain quality and consistency.

  • Monitor mobile advertising trends, competitor creatives, emerging creative technologies, social formats, and user acquisition best practices.

  • Partner closely with creative leadership, user acquisition, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to align creative work with campaign objectives and share performance insights.

  • Use campaign performance data and creative testing results to continuously refine future concepts and production strategies.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of professional experience in motion graphics, video editing, digital advertising, performance marketing creative, or a related field, with experience producing user acquisition creatives for mobile games.

    • Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in motion design, editorial storytelling, gameplay advertising, and short-form video production.

    • Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects and strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe Photoshop, with working knowledge of Adobe Illustrator.

    • Strong understanding of animation principles, typography, composition, visual hierarchy, compositing, pacing, rhythm, storytelling, music editing, sound design, and audio synchronization.

    • Proven ability to combine gameplay footage, UI elements, typography, visual effects, sound, and graphic design into polished, performance-focused advertising creatives.

    • Experience developing original creative concepts as well as high-volume iterations based on user acquisition testing methodologies and performance insights.

    • Strong understanding of hook strategies, creative optimization, and performance marketing workflows.

    • Experience creating organized, modular project files and reusable templates for efficient production and rapid creative iteration.

    • Familiarity with paid media platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, AppLovin, and Moloco, as well as their creative requirements and advertising ecosystems.

    • Understanding of performance metrics such as CTR, CPI, ROAS, conversion, retention, and hook performance.

    • Experience using AI tools such as Adobe Firefly, Photoshop AI, ChatGPT, Claude, or comparable technologies to enhance creative workflows.

    • Excellent communication, organization, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

    • Ability to independently manage creative projects from concept through final delivery while maintaining high standards for quality and performance.

    • Experience creating user acquisition creative for match-3, puzzle, casual, or hybrid-casual mobile games is a strong advantage.

    • Experience with App Store screenshots, promotional graphics, App Store Optimization (ASO) assets, or other mobile game marketing materials is a plus.

    • Familiarity with Unity or other gameplay capture tools, Cinema 4D, Blender, or comparable 3D software is beneficial.

    • Experience with motion graphics plugins such as Trapcode, Saber, Element 3D, or similar tools is advantageous.

    • Familiarity with generative AI platforms such as Runway, Midjourney, and other emerging creative technologies is a plus.

    • Experience working directly with User Acquisition teams and applying campaign performance data, creative testing results, and user behavior insights to improve creative development is highly desirable.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote work from anywhere in Latin America, including Brazil.

      • Flexible work structure that allows you to organize your day around your location while collaborating with global teams.

      • Meaningful ownership and the opportunity to directly influence growth initiatives and game performance.

      • Access to company-provided AI tools and paid subscriptions to support creative experimentation, production, and productivity.

      • Flexible time off to support a healthy work-life balance.

      • Opportunity to work with modern creative technologies and performance-driven production workflows.

title: Employment Security Program Coordinator 2: Collector/Telework
description:
Description



This position has the opportunity to Telework.


The ideal candidate for the Employment Security Program Coordinator 2 – Collector role is a confident, solutions-oriented professional who excels at making sound financial decisions that directly support the integrity of Washington’s benefit funds.

They will demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively within a team-oriented environment, while maintaining a strong commitment to continuous learning and remaining calm under pressure. The candidate should be highly self-motivated, detail-oriented, and an excellent communicator, capable of conveying complex information clearly and effectively. They should display compassionate professionalism, understanding that behind every debt is a person or business navigating life’s complexities. Flexibility in assuming a variety of responsibilities as organizational needs arise and workloads change is essential.

As an ES Program Coordinator-2, Collector within the Employment Security Department Collections Unit, you will perform journey-level debt collection duties in the recovery of benefit program overpayments owed by individuals, and delinquent taxes or other balances owed by employers.


This candidate thrives in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment where communication and resilience are essential. They are skilled at navigating difficult conversations, including interactions with frustrated or hostile customers, and they maintain professionalism while gathering financial information, explaining program requirements, and guiding individuals toward repayment solutions. They are adept at interpreting laws and policies, responding to inquiries from a wide range of stakeholders, and using tools such as skip tracing, legal documentation, and multiple systems to locate assets and recover debt.

They are also adaptable, thorough, and committed to continuous improvement. They manage a diverse workload, conduct research on bankruptcy and account status, and coordinate with internal partners to ensure appropriate actions are taken on each case. They demonstrate strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and public-facing communication skills, along with the ability to link daily work to the agency’s mission of supporting economic security. Their blend of financial recovery expertise, customer service strength, and operational versatility makes them a valuable contributor to the Financial Recovery Unit.

Duties


You will locate claimants, employers, and/or their assets to recover debt due, using skip tracing. You will interview claimants and employers to gather financial information and personal facts. Based on the information, you decide whether the debt is collectable or not and what actions to take. You will have written delegated authority to decide to write off accounts receivable or provide financial counselling.

Some of what you'll be doing:

  • Respond to inquiries from clients, employers, attorneys, escrow companies, bankruptcy trustees, Superior Court personnel, etc.
  • Research and review accounts for continued collection actions.
  • Investigate and respond to debt collection inquiries.
  • Interview claimants and employers to gather financial information and relevant facts.
  • Issue Bankruptcy Stipulation Requests to the Attorney General’s Office to contest the discharge of debt.
  • Execute legal documents to enforce recovery by garnishing wages, levying bank accounts, and conducting other collection actions as authorized by law.
  • Work with customers to determine their ability to pay, negotiate payment terms, and establish and maintain partial payment agreements.



To request a detailed position description, click here.

Qualifications


  • 7 years of professional or technical experience in employment and training or unemployment insurance programs
  • OR 1 year of experience as an Employment Security Program Coordinator 1
  • OR 1 year of experience as a WorkSource Specialist 3 or equivalent
  • OR An associate's degree in public or business administration, political science, or closely related field AND 5 years of professional or technical experience in employment and training or unemployment insurance programs
  • OR A bachelor's degree in public or business administration, political science, or closely related field AND 3 years of professional or technical experience in employment and training or unemployment insurance programs

Required equity competencies:
  • The ability to take action to learn and grow


  • The ability to take action to meet the needs of others


The required experience includes:

  • Presentation & Public Relations Skills: Ability to communicate program details effectively to diverse audiences.
  • Financial Recovery & Trust Fund Management: Skills in recovering funds and ensuring fiscal integrity
  • Adaptability & Flexibility: Readiness to handle diverse tasks and emerging responsibilities
  • Critical Thinking & Analysis: Ability to assess proposals and evaluate program operations; Decision-Making: Proficiency in recommending alternative courses of action.
  • Flexibility & Adaptability: Ability to perform diverse tasks at various levels; Knowledge of Lower-Level Functions: Comprehensive expertise to support operations
  • Versatility: Ability to take on additional tasks effectively; Problem-Solving: Skills to address unexpected challenges


Preferred Qualifications:

Demonstrated understanding and application of debt collection concepts, theories, and practices to include but not limited to:

  • Skip tracing to locate people and assets, negotiating and settling debts due
  • Investigating ability to pay
  • Using motivational techniques to obtain payment
  • Balancing a large workload of assigned accounts

title: Strategic Site Partner, Oncology
description:
Strong partnerships are what get new medicines to patients faster. At AbbVie, we're building long-term partnerships with the investigators and institutions running our solid tumour and haematology trials and are looking for a Strategic Site Partner (SSP) to serve as the key driver and main point of contract for our key partner sites.

This isn't a monitoring role, and it isn't tied to one study. You'll look after the whole partnership between AbbVie and each of your key sites, working across studies and programs to unlock capacity, remove barriers and speed up trial delivery. You'll engage with internal leaders to maximally leverage aligned collaborations cross-functionally with the goal of enabling alliances to deliver results and secure AbbVie as a partner of choice.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provides input and develop the site-specific engagement strategy for assigned sites.
  • Builds and manages relationships with assigned investigative sites through a white-glove service. approach while meeting with Institution Leadership, Principal Investigator and clinical site staff both on-site and remotely.
  • Raises the bar to proactively anticipate a site’s needs and drives timely mitigation strategies.
  • Maintains a solution-oriented mindset to facilitate resolution of complex operational issues.
  • Remains informed of best practices and innovations that have resulted in efficiencies across the business and/or industry and put actions in place that support the organization in removing identified barriers.
  • Identifies areas to drive efficiencies and/or accelerate clinical trial execution. Drives consistency across studies and programs.
  • Oversees overall performance metrics across studies, conducts review of site’s operations for quality. Evaluates and addresses aligned KPIs with site.
  • Reviews and shares upcoming study forecasts and current clinical study needs regarding the studies in which the site is participating for strategic resource planning with the site.
  • Reviews interests and study capacity with site and communicates back to internal AbbVie stakeholders.
  • Identifies and recommends opportunities for internal improvements, implements improvements to maximize process efficiency/accelerate trial delivery at the site.
  • Reviews cross business portfolio forecasts of studies to provide direction for investigative sites.
  • Escalates risk to relevant stakeholders, resolves identified operational issues that span across studies/programs.
  • Seeks to align AbbVie and the site's operations to execute clinical trials efficiently.
  • Provides operational and holistic focus on site needs to ensure optimal delivery of clinical trials.
  • Generates, expands and enhances operational effectiveness and consistency within AbbVie and at the investigative sites.
  • Works closely with internal stakeholders to facilitate, manage and oversee the scientific and operational relationships cross functionally across AbbVie to ensure a productive working environment.
  • Provides cross-functional partners an open and continuous channel of communication to ensure investigative sites perspectives are heard and well represented internally.
  • Report any adverse event within 24 hours as per AbbVie’s policies and procedures.
  • Proactively participate in AbbVie’s WHS programs, adhere to policies and promote a safe work environment at all times.
  • Adhere to AbbVie’s codes of conduct and compliance processes, including timely training and maintaining ethics and integrity.
  • Other ad hoc duties such as administrative duties, as requested.
  • Bachelors or higher required in health care or scientific field preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years applicable work experience in clinical research demonstrating a high level of core, technical, and leadership competencies through driving strategy. Prior relationship management experience preferred.
  • Broad understanding of global pharmaceutical and biotech industries with a solid understanding of drug discovery and development processes. Expertise in drug development, operations, strategic and tactical planning,
  • Strong communication skills with advanced interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate persuasively with clarity, collaboratively, and cross functionally.
  • Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills; ability to establish good working relationships with external and internal stakeholders as well as management.
  • Seamless collaborator with demonstrated ability to influence without authority – easily builds relationships across locations and gains cross-functional alignment.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to evaluate complex issues from multiple perspectives and drive smart decision making.
  • Demonstrated leadership, influence skills, creativity, problem solving and ability to manage complexity in addressing issues.
  • Demonstration of success in a fast‐paced environment managing multiple priorities, comfortable to manage risk and ambiguity, changing course when needed.
  • Must possess excellent oral and written communication skills.

Flexibility and Availability: In line with Australia’s 'Right to Disconnect' legislation, we recognise and respect employees' right to refuse contact outside of their working hours, unless such refusal is deemed unreasonable. As we operate in an international, matrixed environment, there may be occasions where your role requires participation in business meetings outside of standard hours. We value and support flexibility and appreciate your willingness to occasionally accommodate these requests to ensure effective collaboration and communication within our global team.

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer, and dedicated to fostering an inclusive, flexible, and supportive workplace that values and respects every individual. We are committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives, and embracing diversity and inclusion. It is AbbVie’s policy to employ qualified persons of the greatest ability. We ensure a fair and inclusive recruitment process without discrimination against any employee or applicant because of, and not limited to, race, religion, age, physical or mental disability, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or marital status. Our hiring process is flexible and accessible, so if you have any specific requests or accessibility requirement, please feel comfortable to let our team know by emailing CareersANZ@abbvie.com or speaking with your Recruiter and we'll make any necessary adjustments to accommodate your needs.

WAYS WE WORK

  • All For One Abbvie; We weigh all decisions against the common good. We inspire, share and create as a team. We solve problems for all rather than serving our immediate team.
  • Decide Smart & Sure; We make intelligent decisions to create the best outcomes. We act quickly, embrace experimentation, and learn what doesn’t work and get on to what does.
  • Agile & Accountable; We streamline and eliminate unnecessary obstacles. We plan but adapt as we go. We delegate and make tough decisions to ensure focus on results, staying keenly aware of the urgency in all we do.
  • Clear & Courageous; Open, honest, candid dialogue is core to our work and how we act with each other. We share information freely and continuously to find solutions. We admit mistakes. We grow stronger by putting the courage of our conviction to the test.
  • Make Possibilities Real; We question with endless curiosity. We’re never satisfied with good enough—patients depend on us to deliver more. We challenge ourselves to find creative, constructive solutions to turn possibilities into reality.

CODE OF CONDUCT & BUSINESS INTEGRITY STATEMENT

  • AbbVie is committed to observing high integrity and ethical standards in all its business dealings with our customers, with each other, business partners and suppliers.
  • AbbVie as a responsible corporate citizen will adhere to these standards, as well as to local, national and international laws.
  • All AbbVie employees are responsible for maintaining the Company’s reputation for conduct in accordance with the highest level of business integrity, ethics and compliance with the law.
  • Soliciting and/or accepting/attempting/offering bribes or any illegal gratification is therefore cause for immediate dismissal.
  • AbbVie is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives, serving our community, and embracing diversity and inclusion.

Our Approach to AI in Hiring

At Mile 2, applications are reviewed by real people—not filtered out by bots. Authenticity matters more than keyword tricks.

We know you're probably using AI tools to help draft or polish your resumes, and that’s fine! We're using AI to write this blurb about AI! But we expect you to make it your own. Whether on farm, in the lab, or behind the scenes, every one of us plays a part in helping New Zealand farmers succeed.

About the Role:

Our Sample Processing Operators are responsible for processing the herd test milk samples using automated equipment. The results of tests are delivered back to our clients, so accuracy and efficiency is paramount in the role.

At LIC, we're looking for motivated people to join our Herd Testing team as Sample Processing Operators. No experience? No problem. This is an entry-level role with full training provided, so all you need is a positive attitude, willingness to learn, and a great work ethic.

This is a seasonal position, working until May 2027. Please note: During our peak season (Oct to mid May) you will need to be able to work rotational shifts. This will mean Saturday and evening work.

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A 'can-do' attitude and are tech savvy

  • Good communication skills

  • Motivated & professional

  • Punctuality & excellent time management skills

  • A keen eye for detail

  • Enjoy working as part of a team

  • Reasonable fitness, as lifting & standing is required

  • Flexibility and are willing to learn a wide range of tasks.

You'll be joining a friendly and supportive team environment and get to play a part in driving the future of dairy in NZ. At LIC we are leading the way, and we would love to welcome you to our Herd Testing team.

title: Technical Consultant (TAM) - AMAZON Web Services, Korea , Partner/FSI
description:
As a TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive customer adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, RDS database, Network, ECS/EKS, IoT, Security/Governance, and much more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs and risk management. You will provide advocacy and strategic technical direction to help plan and build solutions using standard methodologies, and enthusiastically keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will empower you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS.

We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in IT architecting and operations such as OS/middle-ware/DB/Network administration, Customer center system/application management and more. The TAM is our centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers, so if you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!

TAM 으로서 여러분은 고객이 EC2, RDS 데이터베이스, Network, ECS/EKS, IoT, 보안/거버넌스 등 다양한 AWS 서비스를 도입 및 사용할 수 있도록 전략의 수립 및 이행을 지원하게 됩니다. 기술적 및 고객 응대 역량을 발휘하여 고객사 환경 내에서 AWS를 효과적으로 대표하고 사고/장애, 트레이드 오프 및 리스크 관리에 대하여 시니어 리더십과의 논의를 주도합니다. 표준적인 방법론을 활용하여 솔루션 기획, 빌드에 있어 전략/기술적 방향성 및 변론을 제공하고, 고객의 AWS 운영 환경을 양호하게 유지하기 위해 적극적으로 개입합니다. 고객과 긴밀한 협력 관계를 구축하여 고객의 비즈니스/운영상의 필요와 기술적 해결 과제를 파악하고 AWS에서 최대한의 가치를 실현할 수 있도록 보조합니다.

우리 팀에서는 IT 아키텍팅 및 운영 (OS/미들웨어/DB/네트워크 관리, 고객센터 시스템/어플리케이션 관리 등 유관 분야) 에 해박한 배경지식을 지닌 후보자를 찾고 있습니다. Enterprise Support 가 고객에게 가치를 제공함에 있어 TAM으로서 중점적 역할을 맡아 혁신의 최전선에서 함께 하고싶은 분이라면 누구나 환영입니다.

Key job responsibilities
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:

* Provide field support to resolve inquiries from Enterprise customers regarding AWS service or Cloud.
* Complete analysis and present periodic reviews of operational performance to customer
* Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions, metrics, detailed prelaunch planning
* Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy whilst reducing cost and complexity
* Foster trusting relationships with customers, understanding their business needs and technical challenges
* Lead technical discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, and risk management
* Work directly with AWS global engineering and service teams to resolve customer issue.


여러분은 다음과 같은 직무를 수행하며 매일 새롭고 가슴 뛰는 도전을 하게 될 것입니다:

* 현장 지원을 통해 AWS 서비스 및 클라우드 관련한 기업 고객의 요청/문의 해결
* 운영상의 퍼포먼스에 대한 완전한 분석 및 주기적 검토 결과를 고객에게 제공
* 서비스 중단, 지표 및 구체적인 론칭 전 계획에 대한 자세한 검토 수행
* 비용 및 복잡성을 낮추는 동시에 AWS 환경이 운영상 양호한 상태를 유지하도록 보장
* 고객과 신뢰관계를 구축하고 고객의 비즈니스 니즈 및 기술적 해결과제를 파악
* 사고/장애, 트레이드 오프 및 리스크 관리와 관련하여 시니어 리더십과 기술적 논의를 주도
* AWS 글로벌 엔지니어링 및 서비스 팀과 직접 협력하여 고객 이슈 해결

A day in the life
* Educational Program
- You will be given a Ramp-up period for 90 days when you onboard. During this period, you will learn skills and process needed for customer support and also aws cloud service/solution thru various education and practice
- Our team encourage knowledge and experience sharing, such as customer support experience and technical knowledge sessions
- AWS has various personal development programs. English language program in AWS enhance employees’ business English skills to facilitate working with global engineering and service teams

* Career Opportunity
- You can actively communicate and collaborate working with global engineering teams within AWS
- AWS provide internal international relocation opportunity, which enables employee to work in the different AWS region

* Work and Life Harmony
- Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

* Mentorship & Career Growth
- Our team supports individuals’ career growth with various programs, such as mentorship and educational seminars. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment of sharing knowledge and experience through mentorship. Our team care about individuals’ career growth and strive to assign projects to develop into a better-rounded professionals.

* 교육 프로그램
- 온보딩 시 90일간의 집중 교육 기간을 거치게 됩니다. 이 기간 동안 고객 지원에 필요한 스킬 및 프로세스와 aws 클라우드 서비스 및 솔루션에 대해 다양한 교육 및 실습을 통해 배울 수 있습니다.
- 우리 팀에서는 고객 지원 경험이나 기술 지식 세션 등 지식 및 경험 공유를 권장하고 있습니다.
- AWS에서는 다양한 자기 개발 프로그램을 제공합니다. AWS가 제공하는 영어 교육 프로그램은 직원들이 글로벌 엔지니어링 및 서비스 팀과 협업하는 데 필요한 비즈니스 영어 역량을 향상시킵니다.

* 커리어 기회
- AWS의 글로벌 엔지니어링 팀과 적극적으로 커뮤니케이션 및 협업 할 수 있습니다.
- 다른 AWS 리전에서도 근무해 볼 수 있도록 내부적으로 해외 발령 기회를 제공합니다.

* 일과 삶의 조화
- 우리 팀은 일과 삶의 균형을 중시합니다. 중요한 것은 단순히 집에서 혹은 회사에서 얼마나 많은 시간을 보냈는지가 아니라, 일과 삶 두 측면에 모두 에너지를 분배할 수 있도록 흐름을 만드는 것입니다. 우리는 행복하고 만족스러운 삶을 위해서는 개인적 삶과 일 간의 적절한 균형이 필수적이라 믿으며, 근무시간의 유연성을 제공하고 각자가 자신에게 맞는 일과 삶의 균형점을 찾아가도록 권장합니다.

* 멘토링 & 커리어 성장
- 우리 팀에서는 멘토링, 교육 세미나 등 다양한 프로그램을 통해 개개인의 커리어 성장을 지원합니다. 다양한 경험, 근속 기간을 지닌 분들이 함께 일하고 있으며 멘토링을 통해 지식과 경험을 공유할 수 있는 환경을 구축해 나가고 있습니다. 우리 팀에서는 개개인의 커리어 성장을 중시하며 프로젝트 할당을 통해 각자가 다방면에 걸친 전문가로 성장할 수 있도록 노력하고 있습니다.

About the team
* The role is within the Korea Enterprise Support team. Enterprise Support team is one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS. AWS Enterprise Support team is looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises that are beginning or in the middle of their digital transformation journey.

* 해당 직무는 Korea Enterprise Support 팀 소속입니다. Enterprise Support팀은 아마존 웹 서비스(AWS) 내에서 가장 빠르게 성장하고 있는 조직 중 하나로 산업 부문이나 규모를 막론하고 모든 고객사가 AWS로부터 최선의 가치와 서비스를 제공받을 수 있도록 지원합니다. AWS Enterprise Support 팀에서는 컴퓨트, 스토리지, 데이터베이스, 데이터 애널리틱스, 애플리케이션 레벨 서비스, 네트워킹, 서버리스 등 다양한 테크놀로지 영역 전반에서 고객의 혁신을 함께할 Technical Account Manager (TAM)을 채용 중입니다. TAM은 세일즈 직무가 아니며, 주요한 기술 고문이 될 수 있는 기회로서 스타트업에서 대기업에 이르기까지 디지털 전환의 여정을 이제 막 시작한, 또는 이어 나가고 있는 다양한 규모의 고객에게 ‘고객의 목소리’가 되어줄 수 있습니다.

title: BI Developer
description:
Overview

Job Summary:

The Allegis Corporate Services (ACS) Business Intelligence (BI) Developer will play a key role in delivering analytical applications such as dashboards, reports, and ad-hoc tools to the organization. This strategic position involves developing innovative visualizations and enterprise-wide insights within the ACS Business Intelligence & Analytics department using a modern data stack.

Responsibilities include enhancement and maintenance of the current BI platform and creating new capabilities with advanced data transformation and visualization tools. The ideal candidate will be proficient in cloud data warehouses like Snowflake and experienced in modular data model creation for reporting. The BI Developer should be able to work independently and understand their work's broader impact on the organization.

Responsibilities

Essential Functions:

  • Contribute to BI solutions through the full delivery lifecycle, including requirements discovery, source assessment, data modeling, visualization, testing, deployment, monitoring, documentation, stakeholder communication, and production support.
  • Build scalable, reusable, and well-documented data models using Snowflake SQL.
  • Ensure high data quality through automated validation and discrepancy resolution.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions using a modern data stack.
  • Develop, maintain, and document QA processes, incorporating automated testing.
  • Integrate agentic AI into daily workflows to optimize analytics and reporting results.
  • Code, test, and support BI systems, ensuring seamless cloud integration and performance.
  • Create interactive visualizations from multiple data sources that are intuitive, trusted, and designed to drive business action through clear insight and strong user experience.
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends and generate predictive insights.
  • Create and maintain documentation for processes, tools, and content areas.

Qualifications

Minimum Education and/or Experience:

  • BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Math, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Two or more years of experience developing BI, analytics, data, or reporting solutions, or demonstrated equivalent capability through relevant work, projects, or technical experience.
  • Experience using modern AI-assisted development tools, such as Snowflake Cortex, Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, and Microsoft Copilot, to accelerate data analysis, code development, documentation, and visualization workflows.
  • Knowledge of the staffing industry and economic/market trends is a plus.

Skills/Abilities:

  • Experience with Snowflake
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational data concepts, including joins, filters, aggregation, data grain, and basic data-quality validation.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted coding and Agentic AI for data analysis and visualization.
  • Strong analytical skills to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Working knowledge of Python; strong knowledge is a plus.
  • Experience in an Agile/SCRUM environment.
  • Excellent technical, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to identify and automate test scenarios for system and user testing.
  • Skilled in troubleshooting code and data quality issues with diagnostic and monitoring tools.
  • Effective proactive communication of project status, issues, and resolutions to stakeholders.

Benefits Overview:

Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to specific elections, plan, or program terms. This role is eligible for the following:

  • Medical, dental & vision
  • Hospital plans
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan – Pre-tax and Roth post-tax contributions available
  • Life Insurance (Company paid Basic Life and AD&D as well as voluntary Life & AD&D for the employee and dependents)
  • Company paid Short and long-term disability
  • Health & Dependent Care Spending Accounts (HSA & DCFSA)
  • Transportation benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Tuition Assistance
  • Time Off/Leave (PTO, Allegis Group Paid Family Leave, Parental Leave)
Salary Range:
  • $87,100-$137,000
  • The position is bonus eligible

Individual compensation offered for this position within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, geographic location, internal equity, and other pertinent job-related factors.

Office Requirements:

  • Required in office 4 days a week out of our headquarters in Hanover, MD

Core Competencies:

  • Building Relationships
  • Develop People
  • Lead Change
  • Inspire Others
  • Think Critically
  • Communicate Clearly
  • Create Accountability

title: SAP Data Integratie Engineer
description:
De energietransitie is onmogelijk zonder jou als SAP Data integratie engineer

Als SAP Data Integratie Engineer speel jij een sleutelrol in het IT landschap klaarmaken voor de toekomst. Alliander wil daarom een toekomstbestendig digitaal- en data fundament neerzetten. Hiervoor zijn up-to-date, flexibele, efficiënte en robuuste systemen nodig als basis voor de benodigde bedrijfstransformaties en optimalisatie van bedrijfsprocessen. We werken hiervoor in een Agile Scrum omgeving met veel ruimte voor innovatie, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en een goede samenwerking.

En als SAP Data Integratie Engineer werk jij hieraan mee. Zo ben jij bezig met het:

  • Beheren van het SAP Datasphere- en SAP Analytics Cloud-landschap: administratie en beveiliging (identity- en toegangsbeheer)
  • Inrichten en bewaken van dataflows vanuit de SAP-bronsystemen (SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA) naar SAP Datasphere, inclusief de connectiviteit met bron- en doelsystemen
  • Beheren van dataproducten en datamodellen en borgen dat deze geschikt zijn voor consumptie in SAP Analytics Cloud en in downstream platformen
  • Monitoren van performance, capaciteit en verbruik van het landschap en van de gezondheid van de dataflows, inclusief alerting
  • Beheren van de lifecycle van content van ontwikkeling tot productie met SAP Cloud ALM
  • Plannen van onderhoudsvensters en opvolgen van incidenten, inclusief supportcases bij SAP en andere leveranciers
  • Volgen van de roadmap van SAP Business Data Cloud en in gebruik nemen van nieuwe functionaliteit, waaronder SAP Business AI en Joule
  • Onderhouden van documentatie en governance: catalogus, runbooks en kennisoverdracht

Hiervoor werk je op verschillende systemen, namelijk: SAP-bronsystemen (SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba), SAP SLT, SAP HANA Cloud, SAP Datasphere en SAP Analytics Cloud (SAP Business Data Cloud), SAP BTP en SAP Cloud ALM.

Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander

Wist je dat we bij Alliander uit verschillende bedrijven bestaan? Samen met Liander, Qirion, Qterra, Dep en Entrnce ontwikkelen én beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners van Nederland. En met de huidige energietransitie is dat hard werken. Dat doen we met de hulp van ruim 8.000 vakmensen. Dankzij deze talenten hebben wij het volste vertrouwen in de energietoekomst van Nederland. Samen met jou maken wij dat mogelijk.

Een mindset waarin alleen het beste goed genoeg is kan alleen als jij genoeg energie hebt. En de juiste werkomgeving geeft jou dat. Het moet dus wat opleveren. De afdeling Business Platforms bestaat uit slimme en betrokken specialisten.

Wij werken volgens de Agile Way of Work binnen Alliander en passen het Scrum framework toe met bijbehorende rituelen binnen zowel onze ART als ons eigen team. Daarnaast werken we in een hybride vorm, wat een fijne afwisseling geeft in het thuiswerken en op kantoor zijn.

We zijn werkzaam in de regio's Arnhem, Duiven, Amsterdam of Haarlem. Werken in de IT betekent dat je nooit uitgeleerd bent. In het Chapter staat de medewerker centraal en wordt er actief met jou gekeken naar je ambities op lange- en korte termijn! Door deze chapter structuur heb je toegang tot vele collega's met dezelfde affiniteit en passie.

Jij maakt het net energieker

Het digitaliseren van de energietransitie. Dat doe je vanuit je eigen kracht en talent. En dat doe je bij ons. Draag jij daaraan bij met jouw kritische kijk op zaken? Mooi! Zeker als je dit aanvult met:

  • Hbo of wo werk- en denkniveau;
  • Een sterk probleemoplossend en analytisch vermogen;
  • Meer dan 3 jaar ervaring met het beheren van SAP data- en analyticsplatformen (SAP Datasphere/BW, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP HANA) in cloudomgevingen;
  • Ervaring met identity- en toegangsbeheer op SAP cloudplatformen is een pré;
  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal;

Heb jij daarnaast een Agile mindset, ben je enthousiast, proactief, communicatief vaardig en een teamspeler? Dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een gesprek!

Voor jou net beter geregeld

Daarvoor krijg jij op basis van een 40-urige werkweek:

- een salaris van € 5.416,38 tot € 7.737,69 bruto per maand (schaal 10).- jaarlijks een individueel keuze budget (IKB) van 18% (fulltime) of 12,8% (parttime) van je bruto jaarsalaris. Dit is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag. Je kunt dit bedrag uit laten betalen, maar je kunt er bijvoorbeeld ook extra vrije dagen voor kopen. Jij kiest wat bij jou past.- 24,5 vakantiedagen per jaar, ruim aan te vullen vanuit je IKB.- een eindejaarsuitkering in december van 6% van je jaarsalaris.- elk jaar een DI-budget van € 700,- voor jouw duurzame inzetbaarheid. Kies bijvoorbeeld voor een vergoeding van jouw sport ………...

Natuurlijk hebben we nog veel meer! Lees meer over Alliander en al jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden.

title: Data Domain Product Lead
description:
Make your mark for patients

Data Domain Product Lead

We are looking for a Data Domain Product Lead who is strategic, collaborative, and outcome-oriented to join us in our Patient Evidence team, based in Anderlecht, Belgium; or Slough, United Kingdom.

About the role

You will own and maximize the business value of a strategic data domain, ensuring its data is governed, reusable, connected, and fit for business, analytics, and artificial intelligence use cases. You will define the domain vision, priorities, roadmap, and adoption strategy with business, data, architecture, and technology partners. You will help transform fragmented information into a trusted enterprise product that supports operational excellence, decision-making, regulatory compliance, and technology-enabled outcomes. Your focus will be to connect business meaning, reusable data products, and measurable value.

Who you'll work with

You will be working in a team that connects business strategy with data delivery. You will collaborate with business process owners, domain experts, data strategy and architecture colleagues, data governance teams, digital technology teams, and enterprise architecture. Together, you will align priorities, translate business needs into scalable data capabilities, support adoption and reuse, and ensure investments deliver measurable outcomes across global business functions.

What you'll do

  • Define and maintain the vision, strategy, roadmap, outcomes, and success measures for the assigned data domain.
  • Prioritize capabilities and investments according to business value, risk, strategic objectives, and measurable outcomes.
  • Drive adoption and reuse across functions, reducing duplication and increasing the enterprise value of domain data.
  • Establish clear business ownership, accountability, and decision rights, while supporting data quality, governance, and compliant use.
  • Align domain concepts with enterprise standards and promote consistent business meaning across teams, processes, and use cases.
  • Build alignment across business, technology, analytics, and data teams, facilitating prioritization decisions and communicating progress to leaders.
  • Identify analytics and artificial intelligence opportunities and ensure data products are discoverable, accessible, reusable, and ready for advanced use.
  • Track adoption, value realization, data quality, accessibility, and business impact to guide continuous improvement.

Interested? For this role we're looking for the following education, experience and skills

  • Bachelor's degree in business, data, analytics, life sciences, information management, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.
  • Significant experience in data products, data management, business ownership, or product management roles.
  • Five to seven years of experience in the relevant data domain.
  • Experience translating business strategy into data and digital capabilities that deliver measurable value.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and aligning diverse stakeholders in a complex, collaborative organization.
  • Understanding of data governance, data quality, information about data, shared business meaning, and interoperability concepts.
  • Experience with analytics, artificial intelligence, or digital transformation initiatives; pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences experience is preferred.
  • Strong product mindset, stakeholder influence, strategic thinking, accountability, and ability to make pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations.

Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

About us
UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

title: Director of Evaluations
description:
The Student Success division at the University of South Florida, is comprised of 60 departments, providing students with academic support, engagement opportunities, health & wellness services and enhancement of the educational experience. The Office of Admissions is responsible for recruitment, admission, and enrollment of domestic and international undergraduate and graduate students at the University of South Florida.

The Director of Evaluations provides strategic leadership and oversight for the comprehensive review and decision-making processes associated with undergraduate admissions at the University of South Florida. Reporting to the Assistant Vice President for Admissions, the Director is responsible for the administration of first-year and transfer application evaluation and decisioning processes to ensure compliance with university policies, Florida Board of Governors regulations, and applicable state and federal laws.

The Director oversees the review of applications for admission, supervises professional and support staff responsible for credential evaluation and admissions decisions, and ensures efficient, accurate, and student-centered processing of undergraduate applications. The position also provides leadership for document management, Florida Residency, and specialized admissions processes, including Special Talent admissions (e.g., athletics, arts programs, ROTC, and other designated populations), and coordinates the undergraduate admission appeals process through the Faculty Admissions Committee.

The Director plays a critical role in advancing institutional enrollment goals while maintaining the integrity, consistency, and transparency of the admissions process.

The University of South Florida is a top-ranked research university serving approximately 50,000 students from across the globe at campuses in Tampa, St. Petersburg and USF Health. In 2025, U.S. News & World Report recognized USF with its highest overall ranking in university history, as a top 50 public university for the seventh consecutive year and as one of the top 15 best values among all public universities in the nation. U.S. News also ranks the USF Health Morsani College of Medicine in the highest tier, placing it as one of the top 16 medical schools in the nation and inside the top 10 among public universities. USF is a member of the Association of American Universities (AAU), a group that includes only the top 3% of universities in the U.S. With an all-time high of $750 million in research funding in 2025 and as a top 20 public university for producing U.S. patents, USF uses innovation to transform lives and shape a better future. The university generates an annual economic impact of nearly $10 billion for the state of Florida. USF’s Division I athletics teams compete in the American Conference. Learn more at .

Leadership and Management

• Provide leadership, direction, supervision, and professional development for the Evaluations team responsible for undergraduate application review and admissions decisioning.
• Establish performance expectations and monitor productivity, quality assurance, and service standards to ensure timely processing of applications.
• Foster a collaborative, student-centered culture focused on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
• Develop staffing plans and allocate resources to effectively manage fluctuations in application volume.

Undergraduate Admissions Evaluation and Decisioning

• Direct and oversee the review and evaluation of undergraduate applications for first-year and transfer admission.
• Ensure consistent application of university admissions policies, Board of Governors regulations, state statutes, and institutional guidelines.
• Monitor application processing timelines and implement strategies to improve efficiency while maintaining accuracy.
• Review complex admissions cases and provide guidance on policy interpretation and decision-making.

Special Talent Admissions

• Oversee all undergraduate Special Talent admissions processes (CAA), including but not limited to:

o NCAA student-athletes:
o Students pursuing majors in the arts requiring auditions or portfolio review;
o ROTC-affiliated applicants;
o Other designated special populations approved by university policy.

• Collaborate with Athletics Eligibility and Compliance, academic colleges, ROTC leadership, and other campus partners to facilitate the timely review of Special Talent candidates.
• Ensure that Special Talent admissions decisions comply with institutional policies and Board of Governors regulations.

Faculty Admissions Committee and Appeals

• Serve as the primary administrative liaison to the Faculty Admissions Committee.
• Coordinate the undergraduate admissions appeals process, including the preparation of appeal materials, scheduling of committee meetings, and communication of committee decisions.
• Ensure that appeals are reviewed in accordance with established policies and procedures.
• Provide data, analysis, and recommendations to support committee deliberations.

Document Management

• Provide leadership and oversight for the receipt, indexing, imaging, verification, and processing of admissions-related documents, including but not limited to transcripts, test scores, residency documentation, conduct records, and supporting admissions materials.
• Establish and maintain procedures to ensure the accurate and timely processing of application credentials in accordance with university service standards.
• Monitor document workflows and processing timelines to support efficient admissions decision-making and exceptional customer service.
• Collaborate with Strategic Enrollment Operations to implement and optimize document imaging systems, workflow automation, and business processes related to credential management.
• Ensure the integrity, security, retention, and appropriate handling of student records in compliance with institutional policies, FERPA, and applicable state and federal regulations.
• Develop quality assurance measures to maintain the accuracy and completeness of admissions records and supporting documentation.
• Coordinate the resolution of complex document-related issues and serve as a resource to staff regarding credential authenticity and interpretation.

Florida Residency Classification and Reclassification

• Oversee the initial classification of applicants for tuition purposes in accordance with Florida Statute 1009.21, Board of Governors regulations, and university policies governing residency for tuition purposes.
• Provide leadership and guidance regarding the review and evaluation of residency documentation submitted by dependent and independent students seeking classification as Florida residents for tuition purposes.
• Direct the review and adjudication of requests for residency reclassification submitted by newly admitted and currently enrolled students.
• Ensure the consistent interpretation and application of residency regulations while maintaining compliance with state reporting requirements and audit expectations.
• Develop procedures, training materials, and quality assurance practices related to residency determinations and reclassification decisions.
• Serve as a subject matter expert and institutional resource regarding residency policies, statutory requirements, and supporting documentation standards.

• Collaborate with the Assistant Vice President of Admissions, Financial Aid, the Registrar's Office, General Counsel, and other university stakeholders to address complex residency cases and ensure alignment across institutional processes.
• Monitor changes to state statutes, Board of Governors regulations, and guidance related to residency classification and recommend procedural updates as necessary.
• Review appeals and exceptional residency cases requiring advanced policy interpretation and administrative judgment.

Policy Development and Compliance

• Monitor changes in admissions-related regulations, legislation, and best practices and recommend policy modifications as appropriate.
• Develop, document, and maintain evaluation procedures and decision-making guidelines.
• Ensure compliance with federal and state laws, including FERPA and applicable Board of Governors regulations.
• Participate in institutional audits and provide documentation related to admissions practices and decisions.

Strategic Planning and Collaboration

• Collaborate with Strategic Enrollment Operations to optimize admissions workflows, implement technology enhancements, and improve business processes.
• Partner with Recruitment, Registrar, Athletics, and the academic colleges to support institutional enrollment objectives.
• Utilize admissions data and trends to identify opportunities for process improvement.

Reporting and Data Analysis

• Assist senior leadership with providing data to help guide the development and management of the Admissions GRID to achieve both academic profile and headcount goals.
• Analyze operational metrics related to application review, processing efficiency, and decision timelines.
• Support institutional reporting requirements and respond to requests for admissions related data.
• Experience utilizing student information systems and/or customer relationship management systems.
• Excellent communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Higher Education Administration, student Affairs, Business Administration, Public Administration, or related field.
  • Five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in undergraduate admissions or enrollment management..
  • Experience interpreting and applying admissions policies and procedures
  • Supervisory experience managing professional staff
  • Experience with student information systems and/or CRM systems.

Degree Equivalency Clause: Four years of direct experience for a bachelor’s degree.
• Senate Bill 1310- The Florida Senate (https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2023/1310) is conditional upon meeting all employment eligibility requirements in the U.S.
• SB 1310: Substitution of Work Experience for Postsecondary Education Requirements
• A public employer may include a postsecondary degree as a baseline requirement only as an alternative to the number of years of direct experience required, not to exceed:
• (a) Two years of direct experience for an associate degree;
• (b) Four years of direct experience for a bachelor’s degree;
• (c) Six years of direct experience for a master’s degree;
• (d) Seven years of direct experience for a professional degree; or
• (e) Nine years of direct experience for a doctoral degree
• Related work experience may not substitute for any required licensure, certification, or registration required for the position of employment as established by the public employer and indicated in the advertised description of the position of employment.
• Minimum Qualifications that require a high school diploma are exempt from SB 1310.

## Coordinator Revenue Services

Applications closing on 30 October 2026, 09:00 AM

- Reference number4081617
- Job TypeFull Time
- PackageCompetitive starting salary of $109,779 plus 13% superannuation

Public Sector People are proud to partner with Livingstone Shire Council to recruit an experienced Coordinator Revenue Services.

This is an opportunity to step into a key leadership role within Council’s Financial Services team, overseeing the day-to-day operations of Revenue Services and leading a team of five.

Reporting to the Manager Financial Services, you will bring strong revenue and accounting expertise together with people leadership, stakeholder management and a continuous improvement mindset.

The role will play an important part in ensuring Council’s revenue operations are accurate, compliant and effective, while supporting the team through ongoing development, process improvement and knowledge sharing.

Relocation support is available for eligible candidates including up to $4,000 in relocation reimbursement and up to $2,000 in temporary accommodation support, subject to Council approval and conditions.

**The Opportunity**

As Coordinator Revenue Services, you will lead, develop and manage the Revenue team, ensuring high performance, operational effectiveness and a consistent approach to service delivery.

You will oversee Council’s revenue systems, rating structures and processes, while providing specialist advice across revenue, rates, fees and charges, debt recovery and related financial matters.

This is a hands-on leadership role where your ability to support and develop your team will be just as important as your technical revenue expertise.

Key responsibilities will include:

- Leading, developing and managing the Revenue Services team to deliver high performance and continuous improvement
- Overseeing revenue systems, rating structures and processes to ensure accurate billing, collection and legislative compliance
- Providing expert revenue and financial advice to internal stakeholders and the community
- Supporting the development and review of revenue policies, procedures and processes
- Contributing to budgeting, financial reporting, strategic financial planning, audits, reconciliations and internal controls
- Managing Council’s revenue accounts, fees and charges registers and associated processes
- Identifying opportunities to improve revenue practices, systems and service delivery
- Supporting effective resource management across the Revenue Services function
- Building strong working relationships across Financial Services, Council and the broader community
- Supporting the development of team capability, knowledge sharing and succession planning
- Ensuring accurate records, sound governance and compliance with relevant legislation and Council policies

**About You**

You will be an experienced revenue or accounting professional who understands the complexities of revenue management and is confident leading a team in a local government or similar environment.

You’ll bring strong technical capability, but equally important will be your ability to lead people, build relationships and identify practical opportunities to improve the way revenue services are delivered.

You’ll bring:

- Demonstrated experience in revenue accounting, rating legislation, debt recovery and/or related financial services
- Strong understanding of rates, fees and charges and revenue processes
- Proven people leadership and team management capability
- Strong analytical, conceptual and problem-solving skills
- The ability to interpret legislation, financial standards and Council policies and translate these into practical outcomes
- Strong communication, consultation, negotiation and stakeholder management skills
- Experience developing and improving policies, procedures and operational processes
- Strong financial systems capability and sound organisational and time management skills
- The ability to provide practical financial advice and work collaboratively across a range of stakeholders
- A proactive approach to continuous improvement and team development
- A strong commitment to professional and ethical conduct

You will also hold:

- Tertiary qualifications in Business, Accounting or a related discipline
- Substantial experience in a revenue management or accounting-focused position
- Strong experience across financial and revenue management systems, with TechOne and Pathway experience highly regarded
- A current C Class driver licence

Previous experience within a local government environment will be highly regarded, particularly experience across rates, revenue, recovery and property-related functions.

This is an opportunity for an experienced revenue professional to take on a leadership role where you can make a genuine impact, both through the technical work you deliver and the team you lead.

If you are an experienced revenue or accounting professional looking for a leadership opportunity within local government, we would like to hear from you.

Elle Muller

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Payments & Fintech
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer - Payments & Fintech based in Germany.

This is a high-impact backend engineering role focused on rebuilding and scaling the financial systems at the heart of a rapidly growing global platform.
You will own the architecture and implementation of a canonical payments, subscriptions, billing, and entitlement platform from the ground up.
The role combines deep backend engineering with complex financial workflows spanning multiple payment gateways, legal entities, and currencies.
You will work closely with Finance, Operations, and technical leadership to ensure every payment, entitlement, refund, and financial record is accurate and traceable.
Your work will directly improve revenue integrity, accounting accuracy, customer entitlements, and business reporting.
You will also lead a careful migration from legacy systems to a reliable, auditable platform without disrupting live customers or financial operations.
This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex money-system problems where correctness, reliability, and data integrity are critical.

Accountabilities

  • Design and implement a canonical billing and entitlement ledger using an append-only, journals-as-truth architecture and PostgreSQL, ensuring every entitlement can be traced to a valid paid order.

  • Own the complete subscription lifecycle, including purchases, renewals, resubscriptions, upgrades, downgrades, plan changes, trials, cancellations, lapses, proration, and dunning across multiple payment gateways.

  • Build reliable payment gateway ingestion pipelines with idempotent and replay-safe webhook processing, normalization, dead-letter handling, and daily reconciliation between gateway records and internal books.

  • Implement robust handling of refunds, chargebacks, disputes, credits, and partial or zero-value settlements while preventing double counting and ensuring accurate allocation of payment amounts.

  • Create trustworthy financial and entitlement data pipelines supporting accounting close, revenue recognition, indirect tax requirements, exchange reporting, and conversion and retention analytics.

  • Own the customer-facing billing experience, including checkout and account management functionality, ensuring the frontend experience remains fully aligned with the underlying financial ledger.

  • Lead the migration of the live business from legacy account and billing models, including historical data backfills, parallel operation, reconciliation, validation, and controlled regional cutovers.

  • Establish engineering practices that prioritize financial correctness, auditability, observability, reliability, and safe operation under concurrency and scale.

    • Requirements

    • 6–10 years of backend engineering experience, with deep expertise in Go and strong relational database design and SQL skills.

    • Proven experience building or rebuilding payment, subscription, billing, and ledger systems end-to-end, including gateway integrations, idempotent webhooks, renewals, upgrades, proration, cancellation, dunning, refunds, and disputes.

    • Strong understanding of financial systems surrounding payment ledgers, including reconciliation, revenue recognition, taxation, financial reporting, and append-only or event-sourced ledger architectures.

    • Experience designing systems where derived state is based on authoritative financial records and where transactions must remain accurate and auditable under concurrency.

    • Background working on B2B products involving complex billing, metering, plans, add-ons, multi-tenant environments, or partner billing.

    • Advanced SQL skills and the ability to independently investigate financial discrepancies and trace issues directly through underlying data.

    • Working knowledge of TypeScript, React, and modern frontend development, with the ability to build and maintain customer-facing billing and checkout experiences.

    • Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency, or international billing is highly valuable, including familiarity with EU VAT/OSS, GST/IGST, or comparable tax frameworks.

    • Experience with AWS Cognito, identity systems at scale, legacy data migrations, financial reconciliation, finance-close workflows, or trusted revenue-reporting pipelines is a plus.

    • Fintech or trading-industry experience is advantageous but not essential; strong payments and billing expertise is the priority.

    • Strong ownership, analytical thinking, attention to detail, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate closely with finance, operations, and technical leadership.

    • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where financial correctness and system reliability have a direct impact on the business.

      • Benefits

      • Full-time employment.

      • Remote opportunity for Europe-based candidates.

      • Minimal travel requirements.

      • Opportunity to take ownership of a business-critical financial platform.

      • Direct collaboration with senior technical, finance, and operations stakeholders.

      • Significant impact on payment reliability, revenue integrity, customer entitlements, and financial reporting.

      • Opportunity to work on complex payment, subscription, ledger, and migration challenges at international scale.

      • ASAP start date.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Finance & Strategy
description:
About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to be the dedicated analytics partner to Chime’s Investor Relations and Corporate Strategy teams. As a public company, Chime reports its performance to the investor community every quarter, and that story has to rest on data that is accurate, consistent, and well understood. You’ll build a holistic view of how the business is performing, use internal data to help Chime communicate its progress through earnings and public disclosures, and bring analytical rigor to high-priority, high-visibility projects that shape Chime’s strategic direction.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll work with teams across Chime, from Finance and Product to Marketing, Risk, and Operations, to understand what drives performance in every part of the business and how to measure it. It is not an experimentation-focused role: the work centers on business performance, financial and operating metrics, and strategic analysis rather than A/B testing. You’ll thrive here if you pair a high bar for precision with the agility to move quickly as priorities shift.

In this role, you can expect to

  • Build a holistic, company-wide view of Chime’s performance, connecting member growth, engagement, and product usage to the financial and operating metrics that matter most to the business.
  • Partner with Investor Relations to turn internal data into how Chime communicates its progress to investors, supporting quarterly earnings materials, shareholder communications, and public disclosures.
  • Be an arbiter of truth with data, making sure the metrics Chime shares externally are precisely defined, consistent across sources, and able to withstand scrutiny.
  • Explain why metrics move. Spot trends and inflection points early, dig into the underlying drivers, and turn findings into clear narratives for senior leaders.
  • Partner with Corporate Strategy on high-priority, high-visibility projects with strategic impact for Chime, bringing structure and data to ambiguous, open-ended questions.
  • Work across every part of Chime, partnering with Finance, Product, Marketing, Risk, Operations, and other Analytics teams to understand how each area operates and how its performance should be measured.
  • Deliver high-stakes analyses on tight timelines, such as during earnings cycles, without compromising accuracy.
  • Build durable, reusable data models and reporting so recurring questions get answered consistently and efficiently.

To thrive in this role, you have

  • 5+ years of relevant experience, including hands-on work in data-focused roles delivering analyses for an executive audience.
  • Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, or a similar analytical role before moving into data (highly valued).
  • Strong financial acumen: fluency in financial statements, unit economics, and the KPIs investors use to evaluate business performance. Familiarity with public company reporting, earnings, and disclosures is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for accuracy. You reconcile numbers across sources, pressure-test your own work, and understand the stakes of getting it right.
  • Agility and comfort with ambiguity. You reprioritize quickly, perform well under tight deadlines, and bring structure to open-ended problems.
  • Expert-level SQL and proficiency in Python for analysis.
  • Strong business intuition and the ability to think holistically about how a company creates value (FinTech or financial services experience a plus).
  • Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with experience distilling complex analyses into clear, concise narratives for senior leaders. Experience with Hex is a plus.
  • A track record of building trusted relationships and working cross-functionally with many teams at once.
  • Experience building data models in dbt, and fluency with AI coding and analytics tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor).

title: Reliability Engineer
description:
The Reliability Engineer (RE) is responsible for driving continuous equipment reliability improvements by providing and coordinating technical support, and by managing the reliability improvement processes for the site, with the aim of reducing the risk levels to the business.
Within the role, the RE will direct and provide leadership for key equipment assets that will ensure asset reliability is maintained at the highest levels, and will drive for reliability of work processes, procedures and operating practices.
The RE will define, design, develop, and monitor the site’s critical asset register to provide standardized processes and procedures for the proper operation and care of key production, utility and supporting assets.

Responsibilities

  • Support the site’s Maintenance Excellence Program (MEP) by targeting critical equipment assets for optimization and continuous improvement activities. Train employees on reliability processes, train supervision on the impact that the operators and technicians can have on reliability.
  • Guide efforts to ensure reliability and maintainability of equipment, processes, utilities, facilities, controls and safety systems.
  • Develop engineering solutions to repetitive failures, and apply knowledge in methods and processes to prevent, or reduce the likelihood or frequency of failures in site systems.
  • Analyze failure history to determine the reliability characteristics of key systems, and from this analysis, develop long-term solutions to recurring issues.
  • Develop and enforce an Asset Operations Plan that will ensure optimum utilization and operating efficiency of facility’s assets, and development of an Asset Maintenance Plan to ensure adequate levels of sustaining effective maintenance for each plant asset on the asset register.
  • Responsible for adherence to Life Cycle Asset Management (LCAM) process throughout the entire life cycle of new assets.
  • Conduct root cause failure analysis (RCFA) by understanding and applying failure data analysis techniques, perform analyses of asset and production equipment performance to include asset utilization, overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), Mean Time between Failure (MTBF) and remaining useful life as guiding parameters.
  • Generate asset management plan that includes creation of value-added preventative maintenance tasks, and determine the most effective utilization of predictive and other non-destructive testing methods to identify inherent reliability problems.
  • Work with Project Engineering to review maintenance and installation plans for new equipment, and provide reliability and maintainability specifications for changes, to ensure the reliability and maintainability of new and modified installations. Participate in design and installation specifications, factory and site acceptance testing, and commissioning plans to assure adherence to functional specifications.
  • Define an approach to risk management that will anticipate reliability-related, and non-reliability-related risks, that could have adverse operational impact.
  • A Bachelors qualification in Engineering or a relevant discipline, or Trade qualification plus 4-6 years engineering experience.
  • 3+ years relevant work experience.
  • Strong IT Skills, and proficient in the use of computer-based Maintenance Management system.
  • Previous demonstrated experience of six sigma methodology would be beneficial.
  • Strong communication skills both verbal and written are required for the execution of this role, and strong interpersonal skills.
  • Detailed evaluation of a number of viable solutions to each problem at a time, requires proven problem solving skills under pressure.
  • Requires innovative thinking, where new and untested solutions are proposed, demonstrated and implemented on a regular basis.
  • Requires a very high level of attention to detail and mental concentration, to ensure accuracy and total compliance with procedures at all times.
