title: Sr. Data Infra Engineer
description:
Als Data Infra Engineer werk je niet alleen aan data-oplossingen, maar ook aan het cloudplatform waarop deze oplossingen draaien. Je combineert diepgaande kennis van data engineering met ervaring op het gebied van Azure infrastructuur, security en DevOps. Hierdoor draag je bij aan een robuust, schaalbaar en veilig data platform voor de statistiekprocessen van DNB.

Samen met architecten, DevOps engineers, product owners en andere data engineers bouw je aan een generiek cloud data platform. Je werkt zowel aan data transformatie packages als aan de onderliggende infrastructuur, zodat kennis en verantwoordelijkheid binnen het team breed gedragen worden. Wij zoeken geen specialist die uitsluitend data pipelines ontwikkelt en ook geen pure infra engineer. We zoeken een engineer die beiden werelden begrijpt en die kan bijdragen aan zowel de data-oplossingen alsmede ook enthousiast wordt van het werken aan ons onderliggende Azure platform. Daarmee help je ons kennis breder te beleggen binnen het team en gezamenlijk verantwoordelijkheid te dragen voor een betrouwbaar en toekomstvast data platform.

Daarnaast coach je collega's op het gebied van data engineering, infra-as-codeen software development, voer je code reviews uit en draag je actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van het team.Je werkt volgens de principes van Scrum/Agile. Verder bieden wij flexibele werktijden waar 4x9 ook mogelijk is, waarvan 2 vaste kantoordagen onderdeel zijn.

Niet geschikt voor zzp'ers

Wat ga je precies doen?

  • DevOps / productie-volwassenheid: Implementatie van CI/CD, IaC (bijv. Bicep/Terraform), runtime monitoring, logging en incident-afhandeling.
  • Architectuur & ontwerp: bijdragen aan onze data architectuur: vertalen van businessbehoeften naar duurzame datastructuren, integratiepatronen en gegevensstromen.
  • Infrastructure-as-code: Ontwerpen en implementeren van Infrastructure as Code met Bicep en continue verbeteren van van Azure networking, private endpoints en security-configuraties
  • Cloud-native patronen: bouwen van verschillende patronenevent-driven, API-first, schaalbaarheid en robuust foutafhandelings-ontwerp.
  • Data Engineering: Ontwikkelen, optimaliseren en onderhouden van schaalbare ELT-processen met pySpark of andere parallelisatie tools in modulaire python packages

Eisen

  • Je bent beschikbaar van 15-10-2026 OF 01-11-2026 voor 12 maanden, 32 OF 36 uur per week, met optie op verlenging (2x 12 maanden)
  • Minimaal HBO denk- en werkniveau
  • Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in een Python developer of Data Engineer rol.
  • Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring met aantoonbare project referenties als data of software engineer.
  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante programmeerervaring in Python (PySpark, Pandas, UV) gebaseerde projecten.
  • Minimaal 4 jaar relevante werkervaring met Cloud (het liefst Azure).
  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werk ervaring met Databricks.
  • Antoonbare ervaring met Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform of vergelijkbaar).

Wensen

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring met Azureinfrastructure as code
  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring met Azurefunctions
  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring met werken binnen agile teams (ook projectmatig werken is jou eigen)
  • Ervaring met het bewaken van technische consistentie en codekwaliteit over meerdere teams of domeinen.
  • AZ-400 (of gelijkwaardig niveau) als sterke pré
  • DP203 als relevante certificering voor softwaregedreven data engineering
  • Azure DP-750 Databricks enginering
  • Azure AZ-104 Azure Administrator

title: Model Finisher - SLA
description:
Be yourself at Protolabs
Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a diverse team that feels they are valued in the workplace. So do you feel you do not meet every single requirement but still intrigued? We encourage you to still apply! You can help make our company even better. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, age, mental or physical ability, or any way you represent yourself. We strongly believe diversity makes for more successful teams.
Why Protolabs?
We are the leaders in digital manufacturing. We hire doers, makers, and creative thinkers who tackle our roles with an entrepreneurial spirit. Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds. We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do. It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home.

Join our team as a

Model Finisher!

Shift: Monday-Thursday (9 am - 6:30 pm)

In this hands-on role, you'll play a vital part in transforming cutting-edge 3D printed components into production-ready parts that exceed customer expectations. Using a variety of tools, techniques, and quality processes, you'll perform precision finishing work, inspect part quality, and help ensure every order meets our high standards for accuracy and craftsmanship. If you enjoy working with advanced manufacturing technology, take pride in attention to detail, and thrive in a fast-paced environment where continuous improvement is encouraged, this is an exciting opportunity to make a direct impact on the products we deliver around the world.

What You Will Do:

  • Perform finishing processes for additive manufactured parts in accordance with Protolabs procedures and customer specifications, which may include: hand finishing, part cleaning and counting, measuring, sanding, grit blasting, polishing, and build breakouts.

  • Use of tools, such as: calipers, sandpaper, tweezers, clippers, air guns, dremels, drills, soldering rods, and other appropriate tools.

  • Use of computer workstation to review order and part information, and to enter related information regarding the order.

  • Follow and complete all applicable checklists.

  • Maintain a clean and safe work area and individual workspace and assist in general cleanliness and maintenance of the facility.

  • Clean and assist in maintaining any machinery/tools.

  • Assist in the removal and disposal of contaminated materials.

  • Work in a self-guided manner within assigned area. Assignments may be given by the Lead, Supervisor, or Production Manager.

  • Identify Non-Conformance parts, and collaborate with Leads, Quality Inspector, and/or Supervisor regarding issues with orders or part quality.

  • Observe and follow all Protolabs Safety and Quality policies and procedures, including use of any required PPE (safety glasses, gloves, steel-toed footwear, etc.) and safety/compliance training

What You Bring:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to focus on one task for extended periods.

  • Excellent hand eye coordination.

  • Able to work in a fast paced, team-oriented environment.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Must be able to effectively collaborate with team members, leaders, and other departments.

  • Must have strong service and quality focus.

  • Able to work safely with sharp tools/objects including hobby knives, utility knives, files, abrasives, rotary tools, general cutters and more.

  • Able to comprehend and follow printed and computer-screen instructions, and direction from Supervisors and Leads.

  • Must be able to read, write and speak communicate English fluently.

  • Must be able to perform basic arithmetic skills.

  • Able to use measuring instruments such as scales and calipers.

  • Wear all required PPE (gloves, lab coats, etc.).

What Sets You Apart:

  • Manufacturing experience.

  • Craft-oriented experience (jewelry making, woodworking, etc.).

  • Experience with measuring tools and hand/power tools.

What's In It For You:

  • We offer a competitive salary and total rewards package
  • We offer amazing benefits including but not limited to:
  • Health Insurance: Traditional OR High Deductible plan
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Health Savings Account (including employer contributions)
  • Dental and Vision
  • Basic and Supplemental Life Insurance
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  • Paid caregiver leave
  • You will receive at least 3 weeks of PTO + Wellness + Holiday Pay + Volunteer Hours
  • 401k with company match and immediate vest
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program at a discounted rate
  • Matching grants through Protolabs foundation
  • And More!

title: Brow Waxing Expert
description:
OVERVIEW

Experience a perfect blend of deliberate purpose and clear-eyed vision. At Ulta Beauty, some of the industry’s most highly-esteemed beauty leaders share themselves, as well as their expertise. Building authentic community. Creating a real sense of belonging—even as they’re plotting a bold, strategic course of exciting innovations destined to revolutionize the industry.

Think robust organizational support. Ever-increasing levels of investment. And a healthy dose of personal empowerment and growth opportunity. All with a company of unwavering strength and stability.

We are the future of beauty services. Be part of the transformation.

GENERAL SUMMARY & SCOPE

The Arch Expert (AE) is responsible for maximizing sales in the Benefit brand by engaging guests to determine their individual needs, assisting guests in the selection and purchase of merchandise and performing short services, including eyebrow/facial waxing and tinting. They represent the image, products, and culture of the brand to the Ulta Beauty guest and support the Experience Manager (EM) through a focus on performance (service/retail sales and in-store events), people (guest service), and process (operating procedures and compliance standards). This position requires an active license in Esthetics or Cosmetology (as required by law), exceptional guest service, and the aptitude to learn and communicate product knowledge.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES (*Essential Job Functions)

The Brow Waxing Expert is a champion of Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision and values, and should demonstrate them skillfully and consistently by performing the following duties and responsibilities of the position (as well as all other projects/duties as assigned):

Performance

  • Meet or exceed Benefit brand sales and service goals,and contribute to meeting or exceeding the store’s goals related to retail and service sales, guest loyalty (including credit), omni-channel, and retail shrink as set by Ulta Beauty.
  • Ensure each guest receives exceptional service by greeting and engaging every guest, personalizing service to their needs, and recommending complementary products, samples, and services.
  • Perform makeup applications, skincare analysis, and product demonstrations with guests to drive sales and guest service experience.
  • Perform short services at the Brow Bar, including (but not limited to), eyebrow and facial waxing, tweezing, eyebrow tinting, strip lash applications, and threading in accordance with all of Ulta Beauty’s policies and procedures.
  • Use appointment book or system to book guests’ appointments for initial services, return services, and events.
  • Meet average sales per labor hour and sales to service ratio goal.
  • Take the initiative to stay informed regarding new and existing industry trends, products, and services during work time, and be knowledgeable about the ingredients and benefits of these trends, products, and services to better serve guests.
  • Maintain prompt, regular attendance.

People

  • Contribute to an inclusive environment that supports teammates, peers, and the internal and external guests served.
  • Regularly participate in ongoing Benefit and Ulta Beauty training, including training parties, team meetings, and brand and category education, to enable continuous professional development and drive sales performance.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships and an active clientele portfolio for Benefit brand services.
  • Maintain strong relationships with Benefit brand partners through participation in required trainings and the execution of in store events and promotions.
  • Create and maintain partnerships with Prestige consultants and salon professionals to promote teamwork and a high level of customer service.
  • Share the benefits of the guest loyalty program, including credit and the Ulta Beauty app, with guests on the salesfloor.
  • Collaborate with managers and associates throughout the store to help grow the business.

Process

  • Be knowledgeable of and ensure compliance with Ulta Beauty’s policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Follow all safety, sanitation, and hygienic procedures before, during and after services; always ensure compliance with state board guidelines.
  • Adhere to the Ulta Beauty and Benefit brand dress code, including wearing brand assets as directed.
  • Drive sales by keeping the Brow Bar area replenished, signed and faced, and ensuring testers are available and maintained in compliance with hygiene standards, as well as any additional assigned area.
  • Communicate supply needs to the store management team and brand representatives in a timely manner to ensure guest-readiness at all times.
  • Maintain outstanding store operational standards, including cleanliness of the Brow Bar, and any additional assigned area including, the salesfloor, restrooms, cashwrap, backroom, and break area.
  • Participate in completing merchandise resets, planograms, marketing displays, physical inventory procedures, and processing shipment using the Benefit brand’s and Ulta Beauty’s technology and best practices.
  • Protect company assets by following loss prevention best practices and providing exceptional guest service.
  • Execute other operational tasks as directed.

title: Recreation Assistant
description:
AgeMaine is committed to positive long-term outcomes for older adults and their caregivers. We empower older adults, adults with disabilities, and their caregivers to live to their fullest potential by providing services, resources, and information. At AgeMaine, we believe that a supportive and inclusive workplace, where everyone feels valued and heard, is key to shaping organizational culture and advancing our work with underrepresented and diverse communities.

AgeMaine is seeking at least a part-time (24 hours per week, Monday, Wednesday, and Friday Required) to full-time (40 hours) Recreation Assistants for our Adult Day Program. This position will be located in our Portland, Maine location but if full-time may need ability to travel to additional sites which are Biddeford or Springvale. We provide programs for adults living with dementia or other cognitive impairments in a warm, bright, and friendly atmosphere. Our program staff are energetic, creative, and compassionate as they facilitate a wide array of activities designed to maximize self-esteem and increase positive social interactions for our members. Recreation Assistants are an integral part of our interdisciplinary team, interacting with members throughout the day, leading small group activities, providing some personal care, communicating with caregivers, and maintaining accurate documentation.

Responsibilities

Reporting to the Program Coordinator, the Recreation Assistant will work closely with the program team, program members and caregivers. Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Assists in the development of quality programming (i.e. through the development and use of the monthly calendar).
  • Leads appropriate activities and is comfortable working with members living with cognitive
  • Initiates, conducts and prepares for group and individual activities and is able to perform these
    functions with minimal assistance.
  • Offers input for care plan development.
  • Implements each member's team-developed care plan, always striving towards reaching the goals and objectives.
  • Assists members with their activities of daily living, including bathroom and other care, while
    simultaneously encouraging their independence.
  • Assists with daily general housekeeping duties to clean and maintain the Center.
  • Assists with menu planning and serving meals and snacks.
  • Prepares and completes tracking forms monthly for daily tracking of activities and toileting
  • Works with other staff to ensure accurate and appropriate documentation in each member’s record.
  • Assists with special events, as needed.
  • Assists team and Program Coordinator with tracking referrals, recording service units and other
    reporting and admin tasks, as needed


Qualifications

We list our preferred qualifications and are open to candidates who can demonstrate their experience and/or education that supports their alignment with the skills we are seeking. Preference will be given to applicants with experience working with people living with dementia and/or other cognitive impairments.


High School Diploma or G.E.D.

  • At least one year of experience in an Adult Day Health Center, residential care or nursing home strongly preferred.
  • CRMA, with additional compensation for a valid certification.
  • Proven knowledge, experience and skill in working with the needs of older adults with memory
    loss and other disabilities in areas such as ADL skills and appropriate mental, social and physical
  • Capable of writing clearly and using a computer.
  • Ability to communicate accurately and professionally.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and works well with consumers, providers, co-workers and
    management alike.
  • Clean criminal background check and clean driving record.

Salary and Benefits

This is a part-time to full-time position with an hourly rate of $20.50. Benefits are prorated based on the number of hours worked per week.


Pro-rated benefits for a position that is 20 - 29 hours per week:

  • Vacation time
  • Sick time
  • 13 holidays per year
  • Dental and vision insurance
  • Medical (100% premium coverage for staff working 30+hours employee only plans)
  • Accident and critical illness insurance
  • 403B Retirement Plan
  • Life insurance, income protection plan, and long-term disability insurance.
  • Paid Birthday, Grandparent leave, parental leave, volunteer time, and more!

To Apply

Please submit your resume and a cover letter explaining why you are the right fit for this position.

The position is open until filled

Share this market intelligence information with district manager and respective team members, in order to achieve alignment, to anticipate environmental change and to optimize brand strategy and its execution.

Junior .NET Developer

️LE SKILL TECNICHE:

  • Conoscenza del framework .NET 8 e del linguaggio C#.
  • Familiarità con l’ambiente di sviluppo Visual Studio .
  • Minima esperienza con architetture Cloud e servizi backend.

COMPLETANO IL PROFILO:

Perseguiamo l’aggiornamento continuo rispetto all’ evoluzione tecnologica , collaborando con aziende Leader in diversi settori di mercato e realizzando soluzioni “chiavi in mano” presso i nostri laboratori.

Lavoriamo mantenendo al centro le persone e la sostenibilità ambientale.

Amiamo le occasioni di incontro, per questo supportiamo eventi in grado di generare nuove opportunità, non solo di business, ma anche di scambio culturale, intergenerazionale, internazionale, riducendo qualsiasi distanza. Scopri di più su tutti gli eventi Teoresi , che ogni anno ci portano a conoscerci e ritrovarci !

L’offerta è rivolta ad entrambi i sessi in ottemperanza al D.Lgs. 198⁄2006 ed è aperta anche a candidati appartenenti alle categorie protette e iscritti al collocamento mirato, in conformità con la Legge 68⁄99 (Art. 1 e Art.18). Crediamo nella valorizzazione della diversità e nell’inclusione di persone di ogni provenienza, genere, età, orientamento sessuale e abilità.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Golang/TypeScript/React) - Independent Contractor
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Golang/TypeScript/React) - Independent Contractor based in Netherlands.

This is a senior engineering opportunity focused on building and evolving a data-intensive platform used by major global organizations and financial institutions.
You will work across backend microservices and modern frontend applications, combining Golang, TypeScript, and React to deliver reliable and performant products.
The role offers meaningful ownership, with engineers expected to take features from initial ideas through production and ongoing improvement.
You will contribute to technical strategy, architectural decisions, engineering standards, and the modernization of existing systems.
The engineering environment emphasizes observability, automation, performance, clean code, and continuous improvement.
You will collaborate within a distributed technical organization while engaging with Product and stakeholders across the wider business.
The position is fully remote and requires working US Eastern Time hours to maintain strong collaboration with the broader team.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, develop, test, maintain, and enhance Golang microservices and frontend applications, ensuring they remain reliable, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with product needs.
  • Build polished, performant, component-based user interfaces in React and TypeScript, following established design system principles and delivering a strong customer experience.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of features, from ideation and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement in production.
  • Contribute to technical strategy by evaluating architectural options, balancing existing systems with new technologies, and clearly communicating technical decisions and trade-offs.
  • Improve the performance, reliability, and observability of services and applications through effective engineering practices and appropriate monitoring solutions.
  • Raise engineering quality standards through clean-code practices, thoughtful code reviews, automation, process improvements, and the adoption of technologies that improve team productivity.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, Product Managers, and stakeholders across the business to understand requirements, communicate complex technical topics, and deliver solutions that create meaningful business impact.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience developing backend services and web applications with Golang, including deploying services in Docker containers.
    • Strong experience building modern, componentized frontend applications using React and TypeScript, with a focus on performance, usability, and maintainability.
    • Ability to write performant SQL and work effectively with data-intensive applications and relational databases.
    • Strong understanding of clean-code principles and idiomatic TypeScript and Go, with the ability to apply these principles during development, code reviews, and engineering standards.
    • Ability to quickly understand a new business domain and product, learn independently, and apply that knowledge to technical and product decisions.
    • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and improving technical skills, engineering practices, and ways of working.
    • Experience with concurrent application logic, such as Go goroutines, is beneficial but not essential.
    • Experience building CI/CD pipelines, particularly with GitLab CI, is a plus.
    • Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, as well as experience with AI tools used to improve engineering productivity or productionized AI solutions, is advantageous.
    • Additional experience with MaterialUI, Airflow, Python, or Terraform is welcome.
    • Experience with technologies such as Golang, TypeScript, React, MaterialUI, MariaDB, ClickHouse, GitLab, AWS, and SQL is valuable.

      • Benefits:

      • Compensation of USD 5,000–6,500 per month as an independent contractor.
      • Fully remote working environment with location flexibility.
      • US Eastern Time working hours, typically aligned with approximately 2:00 PM–10:00 PM CET or 1:00 PM–9:00 PM BST.
      • Opportunity to work on a data-intensive platform serving major international organizations and financial institutions.
      • Significant ownership over features, technical decisions, architecture, and engineering improvements.
      • Exposure to large-scale financial data collection, processing, validation, analytics, and data-driven products.
      • Collaboration within a technical organization of approximately 30 technologists, working in small, cross-functional teams alongside Product Managers and business stakeholders.
      • Opportunity to contribute to engineering standards, automation, observability, performance, and adoption of modern technologies including AI-enabled tooling.
      • Fully remote collaboration within an international, technology-focused environment.

title: Above Country Clearance Lead and Medical Reviewer (m/f/d) Belgium
description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for a strategic, influential and innovative Above Country (Global) Content Clearance Lead (m/f/d) to join us in our ACE Content & Clearance team

About the role

You will help define and drive the global governance strategy for the review and approval of medical and product-related communications. You will ensure that content is scientifically robust, ethically sound, and compliant with global regulatory requirements. Acting as a trusted partner to Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Legal, and Commercial teams, you will help shape effective communication strategies while driving innovation, process excellence, and consistency across global and local markets.

Who you'll work with

You will work closely with colleagues across Global Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Legal, E&BI, Commercial, and affiliate teams worldwide. As a key leader within the content ecosystem, you will chair above country clearance committees, collaborate with senior stakeholders, and partner with reviewers, coordinators, vendors, and industry experts. Together, you will ensure the delivery of high-quality, compliant communications that support better outcomes for patients and healthcare professionals.

What you'll do

  • Execute the global communications governance strategy.
  • Chair global review committees and drive aligned decision-making.
  • Provide medical review for high-impact scientific and product communications.
  • Establish governance standards, performance metrics, and review processes.
  • Support digital innovation across content review and approval platforms.
  • Support training, mentoring, and capability-building programs globally.

Interested? For this role we're looking for the following education, experience and skills

  • Advanced scientific, medical, pharmacy, or healthcare-related degree.
  • Extensive pharmaceutical industry experience within Medical, Regulatory, or Compliance functions.
  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders across complex matrix organizations.
  • Knowledge of digital content platforms, artificial intelligence, modular content and Veeva PromoMats.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Fluent English is required. Fluency in at least one additional European language is desirable.

Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

About us
UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless expressly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Should you require any adjustments to our process to assist you in demonstrating your strengths and capabilities contact us on EMEA-Reasonable_Accommodation@ucb.com. Please note should your enquiry not relate to adjustments; we will not be able to support you through this channel.

  • Access Control: Verify identification, issue visitor passes and ensure only authorized individuals enter the premises.

  • Ability to remain calm and professional under pressure
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Commitment to ethical practices and safety protocols
  • Basic to intermediate computer skills
  • Valid Drivers License

  • Reliable transportation and communication
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States

Securitas is a global company that offers the most advanced and sustainable security solutions in the industry. We are located in 47 countries and have 355,000 employees worldwide and over 150,000 clients.

Securitas plays an essential role for our clients and in society. The Security Officer position helps maintain a safe and secure environment for our clients by actively monitoring the premises, including patrolling a variety of locations. They preserve order while enforcing regulations and directives for a client site pertaining to personnel, visitors, and the area. Frequently our Security Officers will provide customer service and information to a client’s employees and customers.

We are driven by a clear corporate culture and purpose, which helps us live according to our values of Integrity, Vigilance, and Helpfulness. These values are at the heart of our culture, help define who we are and guide our actions.

title: Specialty Artist - MAC
description:
OVERVIEW

Experience a place of energy, passion, and excitement. A place where the joy of discovery and uncommon artistry blend to create exhilarating buying experiences—for true beauty enthusiasts. At Ulta Beauty, we’re transforming the world one shade, one lash, one cut at a time. Because beauty is powerful.

If you seek greater purpose—a place of vision, mission, and lived values—where voices are heard, contributions valued and recognized and growth opportunities abound, consider Ulta Beauty. Nowhere else are the possibilities quite this beautiful.

GENERAL SUMMARY & SCOPE

The Specialty Artist – MAC is responsible for maximizing sales in the MAC brand (including color cosmetics, skincare, and fragrance) by engaging guests to determine their individual needs, assisting guests in the selection and purchase of merchandise, and maintaining overall store standards, including cleanliness and replenishment. They represent the image, products, and culture of Ulta Beauty and the MAC brand to the Ulta Beauty guest and support the Experience Manager (EM) through a focus on performance (service/retail sales and in-store events), people (guest service and associate culture), and process (operating procedures and compliance standards). This position requires professional caliber makeup artistry skills, exceptional guest service, and the aptitude to learn and communicate product knowledge.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES (*Essential Job Functions)

The Specialty Artist – MAC is a champion of Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision and values, and should demonstrate them skillfully and consistently by performing the following duties and responsibilities of the position (as well as all other projects/duties as assigned):

Performance

  • Meet or exceed MAC brand sales and service goals and contribute to meeting or exceeding the store’s goals related to retail and service sales, guest loyalty (including credit), omni-channel, and retail shrink as set by Ulta Beauty.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships by interfacing with existing guest base, maintaining active contact with a growing preferred guest list, and following up on guest inquiries.
  • Ensure that each guest receives exceptional service by greeting and engaging every guest, personalizing service to their needs, offering samples, and recommending complementary products and/or services.
  • Conduct personalized, professional caliber makeup demonstrations, applications, and lessons; skincare analyses; and product demonstrations with guests to MAC and Ulta Beauty brand standards.
  • Study and practice the Skill Certification requirements and complete as many skill sets as appropriate, within the specified time frame as set by Ulta Beauty and MAC brand.
  • Remain informed, participate in, and inform guests about promotions and marketing initiatives within the brand and throughout all categories/departments of the Ulta Beauty store.
  • Book appointments for and support the execution of services and in-store events that deliver an unrivaled guest experience while delivering on sales goals for the MAC brand and the store.
  • Take the initiative to stay informed regarding new and existing industry trends, products, and services during work time, and be knowledgeable about the ingredients and benefits of these trends, products, and services to better serve guests.
  • Maintain prompt, regular attendance.

People

  • Contribute to an inclusive environment that supports teammates, peers, and the internal and external guests served.
  • Share the benefits of the guest loyalty program, including credit and the Ulta Beauty app, with guests on the salesfloor.
  • Maintain and update an active clientele portfolio for MAC brand sales.
  • Serve as an Ulta Beauty and MAC brand ambassador with all store associates, brand partners, and guests by sharing product knowledge, makeup application techniques, information on makeup trends, and MAC consciousness programs and philosophies, including the “Back to MAC” program.
  • Maintain strong relationships with MAC brand partners through participation in required trainings and the execution of in-store events and promotions.
  • Regularly participate in ongoing training, including brand and category education, to enable continuous professional development and drive MAC brand sales performance.
  • Collaborate with managers and associates throughout the store to help grow the business.

Process

  • Be knowledgeable of and ensure adherence to Ulta Beauty’s policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Adhere to the Ulta Beauty and MAC brand dress code, including wearing brand assets as directed.
  • Drive sales by keeping assigned work area replenished, signed, and faced and ensuring testers are available and maintained in compliance with hygiene standards.
  • Maintain outstanding store and MAC operational standards, including participation in MAC recycling program and maintaining cleanliness of the MAC brand area and any additional assigned area, including the salesfloor, restrooms, cashwrap, backroom, and break area.
  • Participate in completing merchandise resets, planograms, marketing displays, physical inventory procedures, and processing shipment using Ulta Beauty and MAC brand provided technology and best practices.
  • Protect company assets by following loss prevention best practices and providing exceptional guest service.
  • Execute other operational tasks as directed.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • High school diploma is preferred
  • Cosmetology or demonstrator license where required by state law

Experience

  • Cosmetics artistry experience preferred

Skills

  • Demonstrates significant competency in sales, products, and service.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to positively and proactively handle guest concerns and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills

SPECIAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Work a flexible schedule to include days, evenings, weekends, and holidays
  • Attend brand sponsored trainings

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Frequent mobility during shift
  • Frequent standing, bending, reaching, pulling, pushing, and twisting during shift
  • Continuous lifting and/or moving up to 10 lbs. during shift
  • Continuous coordination and manipulation of objects during shift

If an associate has a disability that prevents them from performing an essential function of the job, the Company will engage in the interactive process with the associate to determine whether there is a reasonable accommodation that will enable the associate to perform the essential functions of the job.

Ulta Beauty is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer, and we encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate based upon race (including traits associated with race, such as hair texture and protective hairstyles like braids, locks, and twists), color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding), sex stereotyping (including assumptions about a person’s appearance or behavior, gender roles, gender expression, or gender identity), gender, gender identity, gender expression, status as a transgender or transsexual individual, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, ancestry, medical condition, marital status, military or veteran status (including honorable discharge from military service), reproductive health decisions, familial status, refugee status, citizenship status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other legally protected status of an individual.




The pay range for this position is $18.00 - $28.00 / Hour. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, shift, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Eligible associates may also earn overtime pay as required by applicable law. Full-time positions are eligible for paid time off, health, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. Part-time positions are eligible for dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. For additional information concerning our benefits, visit our Benefits and Career Development page: https://learn.bswift.com/ulta

ABOUT

At Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ: ULTA), the possibilities are beautiful. Ulta Beauty is the largest North American beauty retailer and the premier beauty destination for cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products and salon services. We bring possibilities to life through the power of beauty each and every day in our stores and online with more than 25,000 products from approximately 500 well-established and emerging beauty brands across all categories and price points, including Ulta Beauty’s own private label. Ulta Beauty also offers a full-service salon in every store featuring—hair, skin, brow, and make-up services.

We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest records, conviction records, or other criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of any applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the New York City Fair Chance Act.

title: SENIOR DEVELOPER & DATA ENGINEERING
description:
Building on more than 30 years of business expertise, Objectway is an international wealth, banking and asset management software provider empowering clients to embrace their future challenges while providing great performance today. The Group is a future-proof technology player with a well-established track record in the financial services industry and over €120 million of consolidated revenue. The Group is a global Top 100 fintech provider (IDC ranking), whose clients include 250+ leading Wealth Managers, Banks, Asset Managers, Fund Managers, Insurers and Outsourcers in more than 15 countries. With over 800 professionals operating from Italy, UK, Belgium, Germany, Switzerland and Canada, the Group serves clients in 4 continents, supporting approximately 100,000 investment professionals to manage more than €1 trillion in assets.

To strengthen our team in Milan we are currently looking for a:

Senior BE Developer (Java)

We are looking for a Senior Back-End Developer to join our Engineering team and contribute to the design, development and evolution of our digital wealth management platform.

In this role, you will build secure, scalable and high-performing back-end services, working closely with product managers, architects and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver enterprise-grade solutions for financial institutions.

Main Activities

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable back-end services using Java and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.
  • Develop clean, maintainable and well-tested code following engineering best practices and coding standards.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs and integrate with internal and external services.
  • Contribute to the evolution of cloud-native applications deployed on Kubernetes and AWS environments.
  • Collaborate with architects, product managers and fellow engineers to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
  • Ensure application performance, scalability, resilience and reliability.
  • Apply secure coding principles and contribute to the implementation of solutions compliant with security and regulatory requirements.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions and knowledge-sharing initiatives to continuously improve engineering practices.
  • Troubleshoot complex production and application issues, identifying root causes and implementing long-term solutions.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, CI/CD pipelines and software quality practices.

Candidate’s Experience and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in back-end software development using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience designing and developing microservices-based applications.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes and AWS in production environments.
  • Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture, secure coding principles and engineering best practices.
  • Experience working in Agile environments using Git and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Professional proficiency in English and Italian.
  • Background in fintech, banking or regulated software environments is a genuine advantage.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with messaging technologies (e.g. Kafka or RabbitMQ).
  • Familiarity with authentication and security standards (e.g. OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT).
  • Experience with automated testing, observability or Infrastructure as Code tools.

Candidate’s Personal Profile

  • Passionate about building secure, scalable and high-quality enterprise software.
  • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams.
  • Analytical and solution-oriented, with a structured approach to problem solving.
  • Comfortable working in complex distributed systems and cloud-native environments.
  • Curious and committed to continuous learning and technology evolution.
  • Team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and contributing to a collaborative engineering culture.

What We Offer

  • Direct collaboration with engineering leadership and cross-functional product teams.
  • The opportunity to contribute to software solutions supporting investment professionals and financial institutions across more than 15 countries.
  • An engineering team committed to evolving its architecture, engineering practices and software quality
  • Hybrid working arrangement, based in Milan.

title: Production Chemical Technician (6am-2:30pm)
description:
Atomic Machines is ushering in a new era of micromanufacturing with its Matter Compiler™ technology platform. This platform enables new classes of micromachines to be designed and built by providing manufacturing processes and a materials library that are inaccessible to semiconductor manufacturing methods. It unlocks MEMS manufacturing not only for device classes that could never be produced by semiconductor methods, but also for entirely new categories. Furthermore, this digital platform is fully programmable in the way 3D printing is digital—but whereas 3D printing produces parts of a single material using a single process, the Matter Compiler™ technology platform is a multi-process, multi-material system: bits and raw materials go in, and complete, functional micromachines come out. The Atomic Machines team has also created an exciting first device—made possible only through the Matter Compiler™ technology platform—that we will be unveiling to the world soon.
Our offices are in Emeryville and Santa Clara, California.

About The Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented, hands-on Chemical Technician contractor to support both production and process development activities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. In this role, you will execute high-precision chemical processes that are repetitive in nature. At the same time, you will follow established methods to ensure consistent and reliable production output. The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in chemistry, rigorous attention to safety, and practical experience in production operations.

What You’ll Do:

  • Follow established protocols and work instructions to safely and accurately carry out chemical tests, and material treatments.
  • Prepare chemical solutions and perform surface preparation using solvents, acids, bases and other reagents.
  • Execute electrochemical processing steps such as plating, etching, and other wet chemistry techniques.
  • Collect data; prepare reports and communicate results to team members.
  • Maintain organization and cleanliness in the work area while ensuring compliance with health, safety, and environmental standards.
  • Safely handle, store and dispose of hazardous chemicals and waste streams in accordance with company regulatory requirements.
  • Track and maintain inventory of chemicals and consumables at your station.
  • Train new team members in safe chemical handling, equipment operation, and production procedures.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives targeting process control, safety, efficiency and production quality.

What You’ll Need:

  • Associate degree, technical diploma, or equivalent experience in Laboratory Chemistry.
  • Proven experience in a production environment, with a strong foundation in chemistry principles and chemical safety.
  • Skilled in wet chemical processing, surface preparation, plating, etching, and material analysis.
  • Proficiency with standard measuring instruments used in chemical processes and metrology tools.
  • Ability to execute chemical processes from written SOPs and work instructions with accuracy and consistency.
  • Strong organizational skills, with precise data recording and reporting abilities.
  • Familiarity with data analysis and reporting tools (Excel, Google Sheets, JMP preferred).
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and troubleshooting mindset.
  • Knowledge of hazardous chemical handling, storage, disposal, and environmental compliance requirements.

Bonus Points For:

  • Prior experience in cleanroom and microfabrication environments.
  • Advanced certifications in laboratory safety (Chemical Hygiene, Hazardous Waste Handling).
  • Experience supporting process transfers from R&D to production.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to work in a cleanroom environment with PPE.
  • Standing for extended periods during lab work.
  • Handling of chemicals and laboratory equipment with attention to safety.
Hourly Rate Range
$45—$50 USD

title: Manufacturing & Assembly Specialist I
description:
At AltimateMedical, we improve quality of life for the individuals and clinicians who rely on our products every day. AltimateMedical designs and manufacture differentiated medical equipment across multiple sectors of the healthcare industry. Over the years, we have expanded our portfolio through both innovation and strategic growth, including the addition of respected healthcare brands through MedicalPositioning, ActiveAid, Therafin, and Leggero.

As a Granite Partners company, we believe in sharing success and investing in our people. We offer meaningful career growth opportunities, a collaborative and values-driven culture, and the chance to make a direct impact on the lives of those who depend on our products every day.

Our innovative, dynamic, and collaborative culture drives us to develop and deliver high-quality solutions that make a meaningful difference in people's lives.

About the Role

As a member of our assembly team, the Assembly Specialist I builds products in a safe and efficient manner, with strong attention to detail and a focus on delivering a quality product to the people who use it every day.

This is an entry-level, apprentice role designed for someone new to assembly work or with limited experience. You'll learn our processes, build your skills, and gain efficiency assembling units and sub-assemblies. Most full-time team members advance to Assembly Specialist II within one year, based on their ability to learn and perform tasks efficiently, meet quality and safety standards, and maintain attendance and productivity expectations.

What You’ll Do

  • Assemble quality sub-assemblies and finished products per training, work instructions, and prints using common hand and power tools (cordless drills, wrenches, Allen wrenches, bag sealers, label guns).
  • Review orders and prints to select the correct parts and components; inspect parts for defects and verify correct fit.
  • Complete inspections and the assembly checklist after building each unit and confirm all accessory items are included before releasing product to Quality and Packing/Shipping.
  • Package and label completed work orders and store finished product in its designated location.
  • Accurately record work, material usage, and other information in our ERP system using tablets.
  • Report inventory shortages early—before parts run out—and assist with cycle counts as needed.
  • Notify Quality Assurance immediately of any nonconforming product or material, and stop production if a process or defective part affects product quality.
  • Follow quality procedures that support FDA and ISO standards and regulations.
  • Maintain productivity throughout your shift and let your line lead know when work is complete and more is needed.
  • Follow safety procedures, use appropriate personal protective equipment, and keep your work area clean and safe.
  • May operate pallet jacks, electric pallet lifts, and adjustable tables.
  • Contribute to a positive, respectful team culture and look for ways to improve quality and productivity.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What You Bring

  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred.
  • Mechanical aptitude; experience in a manufacturing or assembly environment is a plus, but not required.
  • Ability to read and write in English and to interpret documents such as work instructions, safety rules, and quality procedures.
  • Ability to understand and follow prints, or willingness to learn.
  • Comfort using tablets, computers, and other technology, including email, Teams, timekeeping, and online learning tools.
  • Familiarity with common hand and power tools and the ability to operate equipment safely.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy; you take pride in checking your own work.
  • Reliable attendance and the ability to consistently work hours as scheduled.
  • A team-player attitude—willing to ask questions, follow instructions, and jump in to help where needed.

Physical Requirements & Work Environment

  • Ability to stand for long periods of time.
  • Ability to withstand moderate levels of noise.
  • Ability to twist, turn, bend, reach, push, and pull.
  • Ability to lift product and other items up to 60 pounds, requesting assistance as needed.
  • Repetitive use of hands; dexterity to grasp hand tools and work with small parts.

title: Head of Epi Product Unit
description:
Position Summary

The Head of Epi Product Unit serves as the senior technical and product leader responsible for the strategy, architecture, development, and commercialization of Eugenus' Epi products and solutions, with a particular focus on next-generation 3D DRAM multi-stack technologies.

This position is responsible for defining the technical direction and product architecture for the Epi Product Unit and leading products from concept and feasibility through prototype, customer evaluation, qualification, New Product Introduction (NPI), and High-Volume Manufacturing (HVM).

The Head of Epi Product Unit will serve as a recognized technical authority in epitaxy and semiconductor process equipment and will bring together the process, hardware, systems, applications, product marketing, manufacturing, and customer-facing capabilities necessary to successfully develop and commercialize new products.

The position will also serve as a trusted technical partner to key customers, identifying current and future technology requirements and translating customer needs into differentiated product and technology roadmaps.

Key Responsibilities

Technical & Strategic Leadership

  • Serve as the senior technical authority for the Epi Product Unit, with particular expertise in epitaxy processes supporting next-generation DRAM and 3D DRAM multi-stack technology.
  • Define and execute the Epi technology strategy and technical roadmap in alignment with company, customer, and market requirements.
  • Provide technical leadership and direction across the complete product development lifecycle.
  • Translate emerging semiconductor technology requirements into product architecture, equipment capabilities, and development priorities.
  • Identify emerging technologies, competitive developments, and market trends that may affect the Company's Epi technology and product strategy.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and other technical professionals across the organization.
  • Identify opportunities for differentiated technology and intellectual property and work with appropriate Company resources to protect strategically important innovations.

Epi Product & Process Development

  • Lead the development of next-generation Epi products and processes, including 3D DRAM multi-stack Epi products.
  • Lead products from concept and feasibility through prototype, demonstration, customer evaluation, qualification, NPI, product release, and successful transition to HVM.
  • Lead the design, optimization, characterization, and implementation of epitaxy processes for advanced semiconductor applications.
  • Establish appropriate process performance requirements.
  • Ensure that process development meets customer specifications, technology roadmap requirements, manufacturability objectives, and commercial product requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvement of process capability and equipment performance.

Equipment & Systems Integration

  • Lead the integration of process requirements with semiconductor equipment design and performance.
  • Partner with engineering teams to optimize the relationship between process performance and equipment architecture.
  • Provide technical leadership across relevant areas including:
    • Process chamber design
    • Gas delivery and process chemistry
    • Thermal management
    • Wafer handling
    • Vacuum systems
    • Controls and automation
    • Metrology and analytical techniques
    • Hardware/process interaction
    • Ensure equipment designs are capable of meeting performance, reliability, manufacturability, serviceability, and HVM requirements.
  • Support successful technology transfer from development into manufacturing and customer production environments.

Product Unit Strategy & Commercialization

  • Develop and execute the Epi Product Unit strategy in alignment with Eugenus' overall business objectives.
  • Establish annual product-unit objectives, technology priorities, and development plans.
  • Develop and maintain the Epi product and technology roadmap in partnership with Product Marketing, Sales, Engineering, and executive leadership.
  • Evaluate and prioritize new product opportunities based on customer requirements, market opportunity, technical feasibility, development investment, competitive differentiation, and potential financial return.
  • Develop or contribute to business cases for new Epi products and major development programs.
  • Provide input into product cost, COGS, pricing, margin, and commercial considerations in partnership with the appropriate functional organizations.
  • Support commercialization, customer adoption, design wins, and revenue opportunities associated with Epi products.
  • Manage the product lifecycle from early technology development through commercialization and ongoing product improvement.

Customer & Market Leadership

  • Serve as a senior technical interface and trusted partner to key semiconductor customers.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer technology roadmaps, process requirements, technical challenges, and future manufacturing needs.
  • Partner directly with customers to define product requirements and identify opportunities for new Epi products and applications.
  • Translate customer requirements into actionable product and technology development priorities.
  • Support customer evaluations, demonstrations, qualifications, technical reviews, and escalations.
  • Partner with customers to integrate Eugenus products into their production environments and rapidly resolve technical issues.
  • Maintain strong relationships with relevant industry partners, suppliers, research organizations, and other technology stakeholders.
  • Represent Eugenus as a senior Epi technical leader in appropriate customer, industry, and technical forums.

Product Development & Program Execution

  • Establish and manage development plans, schedules, milestones, resources, risks, and budgets for Epi product-development programs.
  • Ensure timely execution of product-development milestones and customer commitments.
  • Identify technical and execution risks early and establish appropriate mitigation plans.
  • Lead cross-functional teams through product-development reviews, technical reviews, NPI, customer qualification, and production release.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation, design controls, change management, and development processes are followed.
  • Balance competing customer, product, and resource priorities in partnership with Engineering and Company leadership.
  • Provide clear and timely status reporting to executive leadership regarding program progress, risks, resource requirements, and major decisions.

Organizational & Technical Leadership

  • Identify the engineering capabilities and resources required to execute the Epi product and technology roadmap.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams through both direct and matrixed organizational structures.
  • Effectively influence and drive results across Process Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Systems Engineering, Applications, Product Marketing, Manufacturing, Sales, and other functions.
  • Build the Epi organization and technical capabilities as business needs evolve.
  • Recruit, develop, mentor, and retain high-performing technical talent as the organization grows.
  • Establish clear expectations, accountability, technical rigor, and execution discipline across Epi development activities.
  • Promote collaboration, knowledge sharing, technical documentation, and continuous improvement.

Decision Authority & Accountability

The Head of Epi Product Unit will have responsibility for:

  • Establishing technical priorities for assigned Epi development programs.
  • Recommending Epi technology and product roadmap priorities.
  • Making technical decisions within approved development programs.
  • Recommending development investments, resources, equipment, and technical capabilities.
  • Recommending product-development continuation, modification, or termination based on technical and commercial results.
  • Escalating significant technical, customer, schedule, resource, and business risks to executive leadership.

Primary Deliverables

  • Competitive and executable Epi technology and product roadmaps.
  • Successful development of next-generation Epi products, including 3D DRAM multi-stack solutions.
  • Successful transition of products from concept through customer qualification and HVM.
  • Products that meet defined customer, technical, reliability, manufacturability, and commercial requirements.
  • Successful customer demonstrations, evaluations, and qualifications.
  • Achievement of agreed product-development schedules and milestones.
  • Identification and development of new applications and market opportunities for Eugenus Epi technology.
  • Development of a scalable Epi technical organization and capability.

Key Performance Metrics

Performance will be evaluated using measures including:

  • Achievement of agreed technology and product roadmap milestones.
  • On-time completion of critical development and NPI milestones.
  • Successful prototype and product demonstrations.
  • Successful customer evaluations and qualifications.
  • Achievement of defined process-performance specifications.
  • Product readiness for HVM.
  • Product reliability, repeatability, yield, throughput, and other applicable performance measures.
  • Customer adoption and design wins.
  • Successful execution against customer commitments.
  • Development of differentiated technology and intellectual property.
  • Product cost and margin improvement, where applicable.
  • Development and effectiveness of the Epi technical organization.

title: At Your Service Center Associate, Cherry Hill - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: Director of Engineering, Fulfillment Optimization (Global Operations Technology)
description:
Company Introduction

We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did we ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar e-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest-growing ecommerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.

We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurial surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Job Overview

Fulfillment Optimization (FO) owns the systems that decide how every Coupang order is planned, distributed, and fulfilled. Our Tier-1 services sit on the critical path of every purchase decision and order across Korea and Taiwan. The platform has scaled to support Coupang's growth and requires continued investment in architecture, operational excellence, and team development to meet the next order of magnitude in scale, accuracy, and configurability. The FO platform comprises interconnected services that together handle the full fulfillment lifecycle -- from real-time order planning and cost optimization, through inventory management and warehouse orchestration, to simulation and workflow automation -- across a polyglot stack (Kotlin, Python, Java) serving Korea and Taiwan.

The Role

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead Coupang's Fulfillment Optimization organization globally. You will own the technical vision, execution roadmap, and people leadership for the FO platform across Seoul and India. This role combines deep technical ownership of production-critical Tier-1 systems with the organizational leadership required to build, scale, and retain a high-performing engineering team across multiple geographies. You will partner closely with Product, Data Science, and Operations leadership to drive fulfillment optimization outcomes that directly impact customer experience, cost efficiency, and operational scalability across Korea and Taiwan.

Why This Role Matters

The leader in this role will directly influence how millions of orders are fulfilled every day. Every architectural decision — solver latency, pruning strategy, inventory consistency, network cost modeling — impacts customer trust, delivery speed, and operational cost across Coupang's entire ecommerce platform in Korea and Taiwan.

This is a rare opportunity to lead a platform organization at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, real-time optimization, and ecommerce fulfillment — with direct, measurable impact on Coupang's customer experience and bottom line. You will own both the technology and the team, with the autonomy to define the architecture, set the engineering culture, and build the organization that delivers it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and drive architecture design of FO systems for scale, future extensibility, and reliability — setting the technical direction for order planning, fulfillment optimization, inventory allocation, and network cost management across all FO platform components.
  • Envision and drive alignment with stakeholders on the appropriate roadmap and future direction of technology for Fulfillment Optimization — translating business objectives (PDD rationalization, CFCC consolidation, multi-market expansion, cost optimization) into technical execution plans.
  • Navigate and alleviate technical obstacles and blockers at the organizational level — driving cross-team alignment across FO, Promise, WMS, Supply Chain, and Operations teams.
  • Decompose complex problems into simple, straightforward solutions, providing mechanisms for the teams to prioritize ruthlessly and "move with urgency."
  • Own the architecture, development, testing, deployment, and delivery of large-scale global software applications, systems, platforms, services, and technologies powering Coupang's fulfillment optimization across Korea and Taiwan.

What Will Be Challenging
Please read this carefully - it’s here to help you self-select.

luxury goods sales.
