title: Senior Injection Process Technician – Robotics
description:
Senior Injection Process Technician – Robotics
GEST MEX 2022
El Marqués, Querétaro, México

About the position

GEST MEX 2022 is looking for an experienced Senior Injection Process Technician – Robotics to join our new plastic injection manufacturing operation in El Marqués, Querétaro.

This is a hands-on technical position for an experienced injection molding specialist with strong process troubleshooting capabilities and practical experience with industrial robots.

The successful candidate will work directly on injection molding machines, molds, peripherals and robotic cells, supporting production startup, process optimization and equipment reliability.

Main Responsibilities

  • Set up, start up and optimize plastic injection molding processes.
  • Perform mold changes and machine setup.
  • Define and adjust injection parameters to achieve stable and repeatable production.
  • Troubleshoot molding defects, cycle time deviations and process instability.
  • Support new mold and new product trials.
  • Perform root cause analysis for process and equipment-related problems.
  • Operate, teach and troubleshoot industrial robots used in injection molding cells.
  • Modify robot positions, trajectories, offsets and basic programs.
  • Troubleshoot robot alarms, I/O signals, EOAT and communication with injection molding machines.
  • Recover robotic cells following faults, collisions or production interruptions.
  • Support setup and troubleshooting of auxiliary equipment and peripherals.
  • Work closely with Quality, Production and Maintenance teams.
  • Participate in continuous improvement activities focused on cycle time, scrap reduction, OEE and process reliability.
  • Train operators and junior technicians in injection molding and robotic cell operation.
  • Support preventive and corrective maintenance activities when required.
  • Maintain process parameters and technical documentation.

Required Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in plastic injection molding.
  • Strong practical knowledge of injection molding process setup and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with hydraulic and/or electric injection molding machines.
  • Experience with industrial robotic systems in injection molding applications.
  • Ability to perform robot teaching, position adjustment, recovery and basic programming.
  • Experience troubleshooting EOAT, sensors, safety circuits and machine/robot interfaces.
  • Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to work directly on the production floor and independently resolve technical issues.
  • Availability to work in a manufacturing environment and support different production shifts when required.

Preferred Experience

Experience with one or more of the following will be highly valued:

  • FANUC 6-axis robots
  • FANUC M-series robots
  • Netstal injection molding machines
  • SEPRO, Wittmann, Yushin or KUKA robots
  • Scientific Molding / Decoupled Molding
  • RJG Master Molder methodology
  • Hot runner systems
  • IML – In-Mold Labeling
  • Vision systems
  • Servo-driven automation
  • PLC and industrial I/O troubleshooting
  • High-speed injection molding applications
  • Food packaging or high-volume manufacturing

Profile

We are looking for a strong hands-on technician, not only a theoretical process engineer.

The ideal candidate is someone who can independently diagnose a molding problem, adjust the process, troubleshoot the robot and bring the production cell back into stable operation.

Technical degree (TSU), engineering degree or equivalent practical experience will be considered.

What We Offer

  • Permanent position in a new manufacturing operation.
  • Opportunity to participate directly in the startup and development of the El Marqués plant.
  • Modern injection molding and robotic equipment.
  • Competitive salary according to experience.
  • Benefits above Mexican legal requirements.
  • Grocery vouchers.
  • Mobility support.
  • Performance incentives.
  • Opportunities for technical development and increasing responsibility as the operation grows.

Location: El Marqués, Querétaro, México
Company: GEST MEX 2022
Department: Production / Injection Molding
Position type: Full-time

title: Director of Security Engineering
description:
About the Role

Abnormal AI protects organizations from the most sophisticated email and collaboration attacks using behavioral AI. Security is not a bolt-on at Abnormal; it is core to the product we sell and the trust our customers place in us. Our security organization operates a commercial cloud environment and a separate FedRAMP-authorized environment, and we are pursuing increasingly rigorous federal authorizations as we grow.

We are hiring a Director of Security reporting to the CISO and leading the Security Engineering organization. You will build and scale high-performing security teams, own major security programs end to end, and operate autonomously in the CISO's absence, including representing security to executive leadership, customers, and auditors.

This is a role for a deeply technical leader with a software engineering background who has grown into people leadership. You have built security teams from the ground up, you write and review code and architecture when it matters, and you believe the best security organizations earn their influence through partnership rather than policy enforcement.

Our Security Philosophy

We run security the way the best engineering-led companies do:

  • Security reduces toil. Our job is to make the rest of the company faster and safer at the same time. If a control adds friction without reducing risk, it is a defect.
  • Paved paths, safe by default. We invest in guardrails, golden paths, and secure-by-default infrastructure so the easy choice is the secure choice. We prefer preventing classes of problems over chasing individual findings.
  • Partnership over gatekeeping. Security succeeds only through deep collaboration with engineering, IT, and business teams. We embed with builders, we ship alongside them, and we take on their constraints as our own.
  • Engineering-grade rigor. We treat security problems as engineering problems: automated, measurable, code-reviewed, and continuously improved.

If the security cultures that value freedom and responsibility, context over control, and guardrails over gates resonate with you, you will feel at home here.

What You Will Do

  • Serve as deputy to the CISO: act with full authority in the CISO's absence and represent the security organization to executives, customers, and regulators.
  • Lead, coach, and grow managers and senior engineers across Security Engineering and Security Operations.
  • Own the security engineering roadmap: cloud security architecture (AWS-first), detection and response, identity, vulnerability management, and secure-by-default platform investments.
  • Drive cross-functional programs with Engineering, IT, and Product, from AI security governance to data perimeter controls to federal compliance initiatives.
  • Set and defend engineering standards for the security organization: everything as code, automated where possible, measured against outcomes rather than activity.
  • Build hiring pipelines and raise the bar on every hire; own performance management, promotion cases, and succession planning within your teams.
  • Translate technical risk into business terms for the executive team and board, and translate business priorities into a coherent security strategy.

Must Haves

  • 10+ years in security or software engineering, including 4+ years managing security teams, ideally including managers of managers or equivalent scope.
  • A genuine software engineering background: you have shipped production software, and you evaluate security solutions the way an engineer would.
  • A proven record of building and scaling high-performing security teams, with alumni who would work for you again.
  • Deep technical fluency in cloud-native environments: AWS organizations and multi-account governance, Kubernetes, identity and access, detection engineering, and modern SDLC security.
  • Demonstrated cross-functional leadership: you have earned the trust of engineering leaders and shipped security outcomes through their teams, not around them.
  • Strong written communication: you produce decision-ready documents and can drive alignment asynchronously.
  • Executive presence: comfortable presenting to C-level leadership, customers, and auditors without preparation from the CISO.

Strong Signals

  • You are currently a security engineering manager or senior manager at a fintech, high-growth startup, or forward-leaning enterprise, and you are ready for broader scope.
  • You have built paved-path or secure-by-default platforms that measurably reduced both risk and developer friction.
  • Experience with compliance-driven environments (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001) without letting compliance define the security program.
  • Experience securing AI/ML systems or governing AI adoption at scale.
  • You have operated in environments where security headcount was scarce and automation was the only way to scale.

Why This Role

You will inherit strong teams, an executive staff that treats security as a first-class function, and a CISO who wants a true partner rather than a lieutenant. The scope is broad, the autonomy is real, and the ceiling on this role is defined by what you take on.

title: IT Support Technician 1- Yale Law School
description:
Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Discover your opportunities at Yale!

Overview

Reporting to the Associate Director of User Support Services, the IT Support Technician I provides first-line technical support to the Law School community, including faculty, staff, and students. The position requires a strong commitment to exceptional customer service, a calm and reassuring approach when assisting others, and the ability to build and maintain positive professional relationships with members of the Law School community. Listening carefully, communicating clearly, and providing approachable, respectful, and dependable support are essential for building trust and rapport with the community. The technician monitors incoming support requests through the IT ticketing system(s), email, telephone, and walk-in requests, responding to, resolving, or escalating issues promptly and professionally while maintaining accurate service documentation.

The IT Support Technician I diagnoses and resolves hardware, software, printer, mobile device, connectivity, and application issues and supports the deployment and ongoing use of technology throughout the Law School. Responsibilities include imaging and deploying new computer systems, coordinating computer upgrades for faculty and staff, managing loaner laptops and iOS devices, setting up technology for new users, including visiting faculty and lecturers, maintaining accurate service documentation, and escalating issues when appropriate. The technician takes ownership of user issues and provides appropriate follow-through, whether through resolution or escalation, helping ensure reliable and effective technology services that support the Law School’s academic and administrative mission.

The successful candidate must be a collegial, flexible, and collaborative member of the YLS IT team who demonstrates patience, professionalism, initiative, and sound judgment. The technician must be able to communicate technical information clearly to users with varying levels of technical experience, organize and prioritize competing responsibilities, adapt to changing needs, and demonstrate accountability and follow-through. A willingness to learn new technologies and contribute to continuous improvement is essential.

  • Deliver exceptional customer service by responding to technical support requests in a professional, courteous, and timely manner.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues involving Windows, macOS, iOS, desktop and laptop computers, printers, mobile devices, peripherals, and standard business applications.
  • Monitor and manage support requests received through the ticketing system, email, telephone, and walk-in support.
  • Accurately document incidents, resolutions, and service requests in the IT service management system.
  • Deploy, configure, and replace computer equipment, including data migration and user profile configuration.
  • Support Microsoft O365 applications and cloud collaboration platforms, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Dropbox.
  • Escalate complex issues to senior technical staff while maintaining ownership and communication throughout the support process.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation and knowledge base articles.
  • Collaborate with members of the IT team on projects, technology rollouts, and continuous service improvements.
  • Prioritize multiple requests effectively while meeting established service expectations.
  • Other duties as assigned.



Required Skills and Abilities

1. Demonstrated ability to provide excellent customer service with strong interpersonal skills. Ability to listen carefully, understand user needs, and respond in a diplomatic, professional, and timely manner. Ability to organize and prioritize multiple requests effectively.

2. Excellent oral and written communication skills with strong attention to detail. Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information clearly to users with varying levels of technical experience and to work collaboratively and respectfully with colleagues.

3. Demonstrated hands-on experience troubleshooting computer hardware, software, mobile devices, peripherals, printers, and operating systems, including Windows, macOS, and iOS. Familiarity with Microsoft O365 applications, cloud-based file storage and collaboration platforms, and commonly used business applications.

4. Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and changing environment, prioritize competing responsibilities, meet deadlines accurately, and follow through on assigned work. Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

5. Demonstrated initiative, curiosity, and willingness to learn new technologies and maintain current technical skills as the needs of the Law School evolve.


Preferred Skills and Abilities
1.Experience with IT service management/ticketing systems, endpoint management tools, and enterprise technology support environments.

2.Familiarity with technologies such as Zendesk, JAMF, MS Endpoint Management/Intune, Zoom, Dell, Lenovo, and Apple hardware.

3.Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Microsoft, or Apple certifications are a plus.

Principal Responsibilities

1. Provides telephone based and email computer support at the ITS Help Desk. Provides assistance to end-users related to computer and or networking problems, and services and procedures within Yale University. 2. Troubleshoots computing related problems. title: Backend Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend Engineer based in France.

Join a small, ambitious product team building technology that helps hundreds of thousands of users better understand and manage their finances.
You’ll play a key role in developing the central API and backend services that power data, calculations, and core product experiences.
The role is primarily focused on Node.js and TypeScript, with a strong emphasis on API design, data modeling, performance, and developer experience.
You’ll take ownership of backend systems as products in their own right, ensuring they remain intuitive, reliable, scalable, and fast.
Your work will span both scaling established products and rapidly validating new ideas through MVPs and experiments.
You’ll collaborate closely with frontend, design, and product colleagues in a fully remote, asynchronous, and flexible environment.
This is an opportunity to have substantial technical ownership while helping shape both the engineering foundations and the future direction of a growing product.

Accountabilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain the central API and backend services, primarily using Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Build fast, efficient services that reliably deliver data and calculations while providing an excellent developer experience for client developers.

  • Design intuitive APIs and elegant data models that abstract complexity for internal developers and end users.

  • Scale backend systems and infrastructure supporting existing products while maintaining reliability, performance, and maintainability.

  • Help develop and validate new products, services, and ideas through rapid MVPs and technical experimentation.

  • Treat the internal API as a product, taking ownership of its stability, usability, performance, and continued evolution.

  • Debug and resolve production issues across the technology stack, staying close to the product and ensuring a robust technical foundation.

  • Continuously improve engineering standards, tooling, development processes, and technical practices.

  • Build scalable solutions that consistently meet or exceed customer expectations.

  • Work closely with frontend, design, and product teams to deliver projects ranging from focused improvements to large-scale initiatives.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of projects, coordinating across technologies, services, and stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.

    • Requirements:

    • Several years of professional experience developing large-scale, scalable APIs and backend systems.

    • Strong passion for API design, with the ability to think clearly about interfaces, architecture, and well-structured data models.

    • Deep expertise in Node.js and TypeScript.

    • Strong experience with databases and data technologies such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, or Kafka.

    • High standards for stability, developer experience, performance, and code quality.

    • Demonstrated ability to take end-to-end ownership of projects and deliver results across different technologies, services, and teams.

    • Strong proactive communication skills in both German and English, with the ability to communicate clearly and precisely in a remote and partially asynchronous environment.

    • Comfortable working in a small team where individual contributions have a significant impact on the product and its users.

    • Nice to have: Experience working with financial, stock market, or cryptocurrency data.

    • Nice to have: Experience with LLMs and AI agents, particularly when processing large volumes of data.

    • Nice to have: Experience building backend systems for complex data dashboards and visualization products.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive salary: €60,000–€90,000 fixed annual salary.

      • Equity participation: VSOP opportunity, allowing employees to participate in the company’s long-term value creation.

      • Profit sharing: Employee participation in company profits.

      • Fully remote: Work from anywhere in Europe.

      • Flexible working: A 100% remote, asynchronous, and flexible working environment designed to support different lifestyles and schedules.

      • Full-time employment: 40 hours per week.

      • Work-life balance: Flexibility to organize your working hours and location around your life while delivering high-quality work.

      • Meaningful impact: Contribute to a product used by hundreds of thousands of people and help create tools that support better financial decision-making.

      • Technical ownership: Significant autonomy and responsibility in shaping backend architecture, APIs, engineering standards, and processes.

      • Learning and experimentation: Opportunity to test ideas, build MVPs, learn from data, and continuously improve both products and engineering practices.

      • Collaborative environment: Work closely with colleagues across engineering, frontend, design, and product in a small, highly autonomous team.

      • Flexible start: Earliest possible start date.

title: Account Director
description:
About the role:

As an Account Director with Diligent, you'll be at the forefront of driving revenue growth, deepening customer engagement, and shaping the future of how businesses utilise our cutting-edge solutions. Success in this role means expanding product adoption among current customers and introducing new clients to our platform. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role that demands strategic vision, proactive relationship-building, and relentless pursuit of excellence. You’ll be responsible for everything from engaging prospects and managing a robust pipeline to delivering accurate forecasts and closing deals. Acting as a trusted advisor and strategist, you’ll lead account planning, orchestrate internal collaboration, and leverage expertise to elevate customer success and revenue growth.

We’re looking for a commercially sound sales professional with a track record of exceeding targets, driving business, a natural collaborator, and someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments. If you’re driven to create value, embody a customer-first ethos, and deliver innovative solutions, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Proactively build a deep knowledge of and expertise in Diligent’s products, solutions, strategy and business priorities.
  • Responsible for prospecting new and existing business within the designated vertical / territory for complex accounts with longer sales cycles.
  • Adopts a ‘solutions’ selling approach, understanding customer needs and developing solutions through the lens of the Diligent One Platform.
  • Build deep relationships with prospects and customers during interactions by being customer-focused and consistently honouring commitments and connecting the customer to internal commercial stakeholders to foster product growth.
  • Develop and execute on account plans to ensure revenue targets, quota and customer business needs are met and collaborates with key stakeholders to drive integrated joint account wins for mutual business growth.
  • Leads the coordination of Sales stakeholders to prioritise actions for multiple assigned accounts based on customer needs, sales generating importance, and account risks.
  • Develops specialised business plans for customers that drive business outcomes to generate new business and upsells. Presents business plans to customers to generate new non-qualified opportunities.
  • Create and lead feedback loop processes with product management and product marketing to communicate and relay customer pain points and feedback.
  • Demonstrate Sales excellence by managing the end-to-end sales cycle from opportunity to deal close using the Diligent approved sales methodology.
  • Effectively utilise sales tools to prospect new leads, schedule initial meetings, increase win rates and generate bookings.
  • Accurately maintain SFDC records, forecast and report out on projected bookings, deals closed etc. on a regular basis.
  • Demonstrates a deep understanding of the competitor landscape externally, including customers’ business strategy and the direction of the industry.

About you:

  • At least 7+ years of success in new business acquisition, account management and exceeding revenue targets, ideally within highly regulated industries, SaaS or GRC space.
  • The ability to build trust and influence senior leaders and stakeholders at all organisational levels.
  • A passion for continuous learning and a sharp understanding of both internal products and external industry trends.
  • Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills that inspire confidence and drive outcomes.
  • A knack for aligning technology solutions with business objectives to deliver measurable value.
  • Self-motivation, resilience, and a results-driven approach to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

If this sounds like you please apply now!

About Us

Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster.

At Diligent, we're building the future with people who think boldly and move fast. Whether you're designing systems that leverage large language models or part of a team reimaging workflows with AI, you'll help us unlock entirely new ways of working and thinking. Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly - those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. At Diligent, you’re not just building the future - you’re an agent of positive change, joining a global community on a mission to make an impact.

Learn more at diligent.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook

What Diligent Offers You

  • Creativity is ingrained in our culture. We are innovative collaborators by nature. We thrive in exploring how things can be differently both in our internal processes and to help our clients
  • We care about our people. Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs to name a few
  • We have teams all over the world. We may be headquartered in New York City, but we have office hubs in Washington D.C., Vancouver, London, Galway, Budapest, Munich, Bengaluru, Singapore, and Sydney.

We foster and encourage diversity through our Employee Resource Groups and provide access to resources and education to support the education of our team, facilitate dialogue, and foster understanding.

Diligent created the modern governance movement. Our world-changing idea is to empower leaders with the technology, insights and connections they need to drive greater impact and accountability – to lead with purpose. Our employees are passionate, smart, and creative people who not only want to help build the software company of the future, but who want to make the world a more sustainable, equitable and better place.

Headquartered in New York, Diligent has offices in Washington D.C., London, Galway, Budapest, Vancouver, Bengaluru, Munich, Singapore and Sydney. To foster strong collaboration and connection, this role will follow a hybrid work model. If you are within a commuting distance to one of our Diligent office locations, you will be expected to work onsite at least 50% of the time. Lead clinical excellence. Build strong teams. Drive meaningful outcomes.

title: Senior Product Manager, Amazon Freight, P&L Management
description:
Amazon Freight is building the planning system that connects how we sell to how we perform, and we are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own it. You will build the models that turn cost, pricing, and commercial inputs into a Finance-aligned view of revenue, cost, margin, and volume across our multi-modal freight business.

This is a builder's product role. You will own end-to-end multi-modal planning and P&L execution and attainment. You will build the models yourself, partner closely with Business Intelligence for the durable data layer, and work with planners who own models across our freight segments and modes. If you pair a planning or finance analyst's rigor with a product owner's instinct for what to build next, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the vision, roadmap, and priorities for Amazon Freight's end-to-end multi-modal planning system — the models and algorithms that produce the plan.
- Incorporate cost, pricing, commercial, and volume inputs into the models and produce reliable, explainable outputs at a Finance-aligned grain.
- Own P&L execution and attainment, explain variance, and drive Path-to-Green actions with business owners.
- Build and run the models directly; partner with Business Intelligence and the planning team on a durable, documented data and query layer others can run.
- Work across a multi-stakeholder input chain spanning Sales, Pricing, Cost/Supply, Finance, and business owners; validate inputs before they enter the plan.
- Own the annual and quarterly planning submissions; explain the plan, its variance, and attainment to leadership and partner teams.
- Reason from first principles and use data and judgment to decide what to build next.

About the team
Amazon Freight's P&L Management team owns the planning that connects commercial ambition to financial performance across our multi-modal freight business. We own the planning assumptions, consume and audit the inputs that feed the plan, and produce the Finance-aligned view of revenue, cost, margin, and volume. We also drive execution and attainment against the committed P&L. We are a small, high-ownership team that values plain speaking, first-principles thinking, and building things others can rely on.

title: Global Medical Excellence Lead - Germany
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

Job Description

About the Role

The Global Medical Excellence Lead is an Associate Director-level leader embedded within Germany, operating at the intersection of Global Medical Excellence direction and in-market execution. Germany is one of the Core Markets in the IBU. The six markets, UK, Germany, Canada, Brazil, China, and Japan, represent the majority of IBU business and are the most strategically important markets for Takeda’s portfolio and launch agenda. Carrying a global mandate and reporting directly to the Head, Global Medical Excellence, this role carries a high strategic weight, and the individual is expected to contribute not only to in-market execution but to the broader Global Medical Excellence agenda.

The role serves as the day-to-day capability partner for Germany, building the relationships, programmes, and capability foundations that enable the Medical team to perform at their best through trusted peer-level partnerships with the Country Medical Director and Country GM. Working closely with IBU Medical Excellence & Operations, Marketing & Commercial Excellence, and the Global Scientific Training team, this role ensures capability development, onboarding, field medical effectiveness, and launch readiness are coherent and additive for the country Medical team, while feeding local insight back to shape global programming.

Note on OBU markets: In markets where the Oncology Business Unit operates, including UK, Germany, and Japan, dual Medical teams exist in-country under separate reporting lines. The Global Medical Excellence Lead navigates this complexity by building relationships with both the IBU and OBU Medical teams in-country, ensuring capability development and Medical Excellence standards are consistent across both structures.

How you will contribute

1. Medical Excellence Capability Development

  • Serve as the primary Global Medical Excellence partner for Germany, bringing global direction, frameworks, and programmes to life in a way that works for the country context, working in partnership with the Country Medical Director and IBU Medical Excellence & Operations to prioritise and sequence capability interventions
  • Assess the capability landscape of the market using Global Medical Excellence frameworks and what good looks like descriptors, with particular attention to field medical capability maturity, feed local insight back to the global team to shape programming, and act as a credible capability partner with whom the country Medical team wants to engage
  • Contribute to the broader Global Medical Excellence agenda beyond the in-market role, bringing core market perspective and strategic insight to global programme design, LT discussions, and capability framework development

2. Onboarding Excellence

  • Own the Medical Excellence onboarding experience for new Medical Affairs colleagues joining the country, designing and coordinating bootcamps in partnership with the Global Scientific Training team and IBU Medical Excellence & Operations, ensuring onboarding reflects global standards and the specific country context

3. Field Medical Effectiveness

  • Lead the field medical effectiveness agenda within the country in partnership with the MSL Manager and Country Medical Director, defining what excellence looks like for field medical roles in the country context across four interconnected dimensions: performance measurement, certification, capability development, and scientific and stakeholder engagement quality
  • Drive the application of global field medical performance metrics and KPIs within the country, tracking MSL effectiveness against what good looks like standards, assessing capability maturity at individual and team level, identifying gaps systematically, and collaboration with the broader Global Medical Excellence team to close them
  • Manage the field medical certification agenda within the country, ensuring MSLs meet certification standards ahead of deployment and on an ongoing basis, maintaining certification records, and working with the Global Scientific Training team and IBU Medical Excellence & Operations to ensure certification programmes are fit for purpose and consistently applied
  • Partner with IBU Medical Excellence & Operations and Marketing & Commercial Excellence to align field medical effectiveness and MSL engagement approaches to launch priorities, building a shared understanding of how Medical and Commercial work together at country level

4. Launch Excellence & Readiness

  • Contribute to launch readiness within the country, ensuring Medical teams are capability-ready ahead of key launches, working with the Global Scientific Training team to sequence scientific training against local hiring timelines, and partnering with the Country Medical Director, IBU Medical Excellence & Operations, and Marketing & Commercial Excellence to monitor readiness indicators and escalate risks with proposed mitigations

5. Governance & Compliance Partnership

  • Maintain visibility of key Medical SOPs relevant to country operations, including Field Medical Interaction frameworks, and provide market-level input into process and governance discussions led by the Medical Governance Office
  • Act as a trusted thought partner for IBU Ethics & Compliance and, where relevant, local Ethics & Compliance teams, providing informed market-level perspective to support sound governance and compliant ways of working across the country

6. Stakeholder Partnership & Enterprise Engagement

  • Build trusted, peer-level partnerships with the Country Medical Director and Country GM, and a close collaborative working relationship with IBU Medical Excellence & Operations including Scientific Engagement Training Leads, ensuring complementary strengths are joined up and experienced by country Medical teams as seamless and additive
  • Represent the core market perspective within the Global Medical Excellence network, contributing to communities of practice, shaping global programming based on what is and is not working in market, and acting as a senior voice for core market realities

Dimensions & Aspects

  • Strong understanding of Medical Affairs operations, field medical roles, MSL effectiveness, field medical performance measurement, certification standards, capability development, pharmaceutical launch processes, and the Medical Affairs and Commercial interface, with awareness of Medical Affairs Vision 2030 and the capability evolution required to get there
  • Operates with enterprise mindset and global mandate, reporting directly into the VP and expected to contribute strategically beyond the in-market role, while remaining deeply connected to country-level realities and leading through influence and partnership rather than authority
  • Makes independent judgements on capability prioritisation, field medical performance assessment, and interventions in partnership with the Country Medical Director, operates with a high degree of autonomy within the global framework, and escalates concerns with clearly articulated context and proposed solutions directly to the Head, Global Medical Excellence
  • In OBU markets, navigates the dual medical team construct with confidence, building relationships across both IBU and OBU Medical organisations in-country and ensuring Medical Excellence standards are consistently applied across both structures
  • Primary: Country Medical Director, Country GM, MSL Manager, IBU Medical Excellence & Operations including Scientific Engagement Training Leads, Marketing & Commercial Excellence, Global Scientific Training team, Medical Governance Office, IBU Ethics & Compliance. Secondary: Head, Global Medical Excellence (line manager), Global Medical Excellence community of practice

Skills and Qualifications

  • A relevant healthcare, scientific, or medical degree is required; MD, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent advanced degree preferred
  • 10+ years of experience in the biopharmaceutical industry, with significant experience in Medical Affairs
  • Experience in field medical roles (MSL or equivalent) strongly preferred, bringing direct understanding of what field medical excellence looks like in practice including performance measurement, certification, and capability development
  • Demonstrated experience in capability development, Medical Excellence, or medical education roles
  • Experience working across LOC, regional, and global Medical structures in a matrix environment
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, proven ability to work peer-to-peer with senior Medical and commercial leaders
  • Comfortable operating with autonomy in a locally embedded role while reporting into and contributing to a VP-level global function
  • Experience working in or with OBU markets preferred for roles in UK, Germany, or Japan

title: Production Technician, 1st Shift
description:
About the role

As a Production Technician, you will support customer production by operating and monitoring established manufacturing processes for advanced magnetic materials, with a focus on safety, quality, and throughput. This role will operate assigned production processes, which may include powder handling, compaction, assembly, coating, inspection, and packaging, following approved work instructions. You will be matched to a subset of these processes based on fit to your skills and experience. The ideal candidate is mechanically inclined, comfortable in a dynamic production environment, and eager to contribute to continuous improvement and cross-functional collaboration.

What you'll do

Production Operations & Optimization

  • Operate equipment to fabricate magnets for customers
  • Perform process development and optimization tasks needed to scale-up experimental activity to volume production
  • Assist with equipment modification, set up, and qualification
  • Care for and clean process equipment and work areas
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering to improve processes and magnet properties.
  • Participate in root cause and corrective action (RCCA) activities to address product and process issues
  • Troubleshoot equipment
  • Execute production tasks according to standard operating procedures and production schedules.
  • Identify process deviations and equipment issues and escalate to Engineering or supervision as needed.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives through feedback, data collection, and participation in improvement activities.

Documentation & Training

  • Keep accurate and complete records of activities performed and assist the operations team with the generation process documentation needed for high volume manufacturing
  • Create and update process documentation such as SOPs, work instructions, and preventative maintenance procedures
  • Provide training and hands-on guidance to other team members as processes are developed and scaled
  • Accurately complete production records and logbooks.
  • Follow SOPs and work instructions; provide feedback to improve clarity and usability.
  • Support onboarding and peer training on standard production tasks.

Safety & Quality

  • Maintain a “safety first” mindset, promoting and performing in accordance with Niron’s safety policies and procedures
  • Maintain a high ownership, customer focused, commitment to providing high-quality product
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant work environment

You might be a great fit if you are:

  • Associate degree or technical certification in Engineering Technology, Electronics, Mechanical, or related field
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in a manufacturing or technical environment.
  • Ability to lift and carry heavy equipment, up to 50 lb.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, and manuals
  • Comfortable working with hand tools, diagnostic instruments, and software-based control systems.
  • Ability to work independently, self-direct and meet deadlines
  • Strong interpersonal, prioritization, and organizational skills
  • Experience maintaining and troubleshooting equipment and workspace cleanliness
  • Experience with Microsoft Office suite, including Excel, Word, Teams, and PowerPoint

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience working with nanoparticles or nanomaterials in a laboratory and volume manufacturing environment
  • Experience using process development and/or manufacturing equipment in one or more of the following areas:
  • powder metallurgy
  • liquid chemical processes such as etching, plating, precipitation
  • compaction, pressing
  • metal forming & finishing
  • Spray metal coating
  • product assembly & inspection
  • Plating or surface finishing experience
  • Pharmaceutical Powder Processing
  • Familiarity with materials and process analytical techniques.

Our pay and benefits:

  • Salary: $25 - $35 hourly, depending on education, experience and skills
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Mental healthcare benefits
  • 401k plan with 6% company match
  • Paid time off to take time for what you need in life
  • Experience in a fun, high-performing, manufacturing environment set to change the world

title: Product Manager - MN Market
description:
At UnitedHealthcare, we're simplifying the health care experience, creating healthier communities and removing barriers to quality care. The work you do here impacts the lives of millions of people for the better. Come build the health care system of tomorrow, making it more responsive, affordable and optimized. Ready to make a difference? Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.

The Product Manager supports a team of Product Analysts in the Medicare product bid filing, CMS-required materials, and other key deliverables of benefit and product content. Product Managers have an expert understanding of the MA Product portfolio across M&R and C&S. They define deliverables and manage the processes the Product Analyst team follows to complete their work. They provide direction and support to their team of analysts to achieve the goal of 100% accurate and on-time bid filing, materials, and content review.

Product Managers work with their leaders, business partners, and peers to align communication and expectations across the organization. They work with their leaders to support a common team operating model, through which all Product Analysts understand their role in the organization. They are accountable for continually evolving the team to meet business needs, given the constant changes required from the federal government and the broader organization. The deep relationships and capabilities they build with their direct reports helps them uncover opportunities to utilize and develop that talent in the best ways possible within and outside of the Product Analyst team.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Leverages skills and capabilities within a team of up to 8 direct reports to support common goals and deliverables of the Product & Experience organization including:
    • Medicare Product Development
    • Bid Submission to Federal Government/CMS
    • Manage CMS Tools (HPMS, Medicare Plan Finder, Medicare & You)
    • Required Materials Management (Annual Notice of Changes, Evidence of Coverage)
    • Content management and development
    • Product Infrastructure Support
  • Manages communication effectively both up with leaders and down to team, supporting alignment of work and goals
  • Relationship owner with key business partners such as Actuarial, Underwriting, Regional Market Leaders, and Operations
  • Takes collective accountability for team's individual contributions in the context of overall expectations for business deliverables
  • Fosters a team culture of psychological safety with openness to learning and conversations oriented on development
  • Targets key team success indices as measured by EXI surveys, taken twice a year
  • Hires and develops a diverse and talented team of Product Analysts that support the evolving needs of the MA Product business

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience with Medicare Advantage and Prescription Drug Plan products, or related experience leading a team or project with extensive Medicare Product knowledge
  • 3+ years experience with PBP filing, benefit planning, and/or member materials development processes
  • 2+ years experience with CMS required materials and content
  • Experience building a team that leverages individual capabilities to support all elements of workflow
  • Effective communication skills and ability to deliver information as a leader in individual and group settings
  • Able to work with and communicate with all levels of the organization
  • Able to manage a team of individuals, providing direction and coaching that flexes to different communication styles
  • Strong analytical skills, detail and accuracy orientation
  • Able to manage successfully in a change environment

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $91,700 to $163,700 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

UnitedHealth Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.

UnitedHealth Group is a drug - free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.

title: Financial Assistant, Yale College
description:
Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Discover your opportunities at Yale!

Overview

The Financial Assistant 4 provides comprehensive financial and administrative support in the Yale College Business Office. This position supports a high volume of financial and operational transactions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, transparency, and compliance with University policies and procedures. The role serves as a key resource for financial processes and policy guidance, prepares routine and ad hoc reports, and supports continuous improvement of business office procedures and controls.

1. Student employment support- Oversee student employment processes. Monitor student hire requests and departmental approvals to ensure timely processing. Approve student hire requests for designated Yale College offices and support offices that process their own student hiring. Monitor delinquent student timesheet reports and follow up with supervisors regarding outstanding timecards requiring approval.

2. Onboarding coordination- Oversee processing related to onboarding of new hires, transfers, promotions, and casual employees. Coordinate access, technology, and related setup with Business Office partners to ensure onboarding and required set-up are completed accurately and in a timely manner.

3. Offboarding coordination- Oversee offboarding for terminating or transferring employees. Ensure managers complete the required offboarding checklist and provide documentation to the Business Office.

4. P-Card administration- Manage the p-card process for Yale College. Request p-cards for eligible new employees; cancel cards for terminating employees; ensure appropriate limits are established. Monitor outstanding transactions and communicate processing deadlines to cardholders. Serve as the primary point of contact for p-card inquiries received by the Business Office.

5. Technology inventory coordination- Maintain an inventory of Yale College computers and coordinate with IT to replace devices according to established schedules.

6. Faculty appointment processing liaison- Serve as the Yale College liaison with the Provost’s Office and Faculty Administrative Services for processing faculty appointment forms. Work closely with the College Seminars coordinator to support faculty data collection forms for new and returning College Seminars instructors, as well as faculty appointments for First-Year Seminars, ROTC, and other Yale College faculty appointments.

7. Monthly reconciliations – Use excel, Workday and third party systems to reconcile credit card and electronic revenue, and follow up as necessary.

8. Student payments processing- Assist Yale College departments by processing student payments through the PandA batch system.

9. Financial transactions and reporting - Use Workday to retrieve information and prepare financial reports. Prepare and process journal entries, expense reports, supplier invoice requests, and labor adjustments as needed, ensuring adherence to University policies and procedures and maintaining appropriate documentation.

10. Cell phone usage review- Perform monthly review of Yale College cell phone usage for reasonableness and follow up as needed.

11. Support special projects for the Yale College Director of Finance and perform other duties as assigned.

The current hybrid work schedule for this position is 4 days on campus with 1 remote workday. You may be required occasionally to work on site more often in a given week due to operational needs. In the event, the university/department transitions to being on campus five days a week, either temporarily or permanently, the hybrid schedule will be suspended or subject to change at management discretion


Required Skills and Abilities

1. Demonstrated ability to take a proactive approach to identifying issues and supporting resolution.

2. Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to work effectively with diverse groups and provide high-level customer service.

3. Proficiency with computer applications, including Excel, and experience using financial reporting systems.

4. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities effectively in a high-volume environment.

5. Ability to exercise independent judgment, maintain confidentiality, and demonstrate initiative in problem-solving.


Preferred Skills and Abilities

1. Experience with Workday and advanced Excel skills.

2. Experience in a higher education environment providing administrative and financial support to faculty, staff, and students.

3. Knowledge of general accounting principles and financial management practices.

Principal Responsibilities

1. Drafts preliminary financial sections of proposals. 2. Reviews all proposals for accuracy, completeness, and compliance to grantor and University requirements and regulations. 3. Monitors, controls, and maintains financial activity of accounts. Ensures expenditures are posted to proper accounts. Identifies, researches, and corrects questionable expenditures. 4. Serves as the principal source of information on financial policies and procedures and financial activity. 5. Reconciles and analyzes financial statements. Prepares standardized and specialized financial reports and analyses. 6. Oversees and instructs support staff. 7. Oversees the maintenance of financial records and files. 8. Assists with the development and implementation of systems and procedures. 9. May calculate weekly payroll for department staff. 10. Performs clerical functions incidental to accounting activities. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on.

The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.

Tala is seeking a driven engineer to join our growing Product Development team. The ideal candidate is adept at problem-solving and debugging, and is committed to continuously improving existing systems and processes. You will work closely with fellow Tala engineers to build and extend Tala's backend architecture to support new country launches, new features, and a fast growing user base.

The Senior Backend Engineer owns systems and initiatives that span a domain. You set your own technical approach, need minimal technical guidance, and raise the domain's quality bar through design, review, and partnership with peers. As a technologist and a leader, you push the team toward a highly available, scalable, reliable, fault tolerant, and performant microservices platform. You follow and improve Tala's engineering processes and standards while advancing Tala's mission and business objectives.

This is a technical leadership role within Tala's technical track, set in a supportive team environment with significant opportunities for career advancement and professional development. You will collaborate cross-functionally with teams across the globe.

Key Responsibilities

Design and Engineering

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services, APIs, and data integration layers that power key product features.

  • Author design documents (EDDs) for services in the domain and defend them in review.

  • Design and optimize database schemas and queries for performance and system reliability.

  • Meet project goals without trading away quality, and pay down technical debt as part of delivery rather than as a separate request.

  • Serve as the go-to person for one or more technologies in the domain, following industry developments and explaining concretely how they would or would not apply at Tala.

    • Quality, Review, and Standards

    • Hold the domain's engineering bar in code and design reviews, including for work from other technical teams.

    • Write clean, maintainable code that follows established coding standards.

    • Contribute to the testing infrastructure to increase coverage for backend modules.

    • Verify AI-assisted changes to the same standard as hand-written code.

      • Reliability and Operations

      • Define alerting, SLIs, and SLOs, and advance monitoring of backend modules so availability and response times improve proactively.

      • Handle incidents that the runbook does not cover, fill runbook gaps found during a shift, lead the technical response for domain incidents, and write the RCA.

      • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues quickly across development and production environments.

        • Delivery and Collaboration

        • Own delivery of domain roadmap work and take part in quarterly and sprint planning with a view on feasibility.

        • Anticipate blockers before sprint commitment, and escalate with a problem statement, an impact assessment, and proposed options.

        • Work with Product and business stakeholders to remove ambiguity and to understand what success means for a feature.

        • Work with the team lead to deliver domain solutions, and own service design and implementation end to end, including regressions you introduce.

        • Keep the domain's tickets accurate and its documentation complete enough that it is the first place people look.

        • Work across multiple time zones using asynchronous communication.

          • Mentorship

          • Act as a dedicated mentor to junior and mid-level engineers, with a clear sense of what each is working to improve.

          • Technically lead and mentor a team of Backend Engineers building or extending complex modules.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Language: Fluency in English, including clear written communication, which is how most work happens across time zones.

  • Backend engineering: Hands-on experience designing, building, and operating applications in Java, Kotlin, and/or Scala, including a web framework such as Spring.

  • Track record: Has led and delivered multiple domain-significant projects, each validated in production over a meaningful period, including large scale consumer applications on cloud infrastructure (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) using microservices architecture.

  • Technical expertise: Subject-matter expert in their own domain and conversant in adjacent ones. Maintains a working mental model of the wider company architecture and where the seams are. Assesses code and design quality beyond their own area.

  • Solution building and system design: Designs services and their dependencies with security, maintainability, operability, and scale accounted for. Authors design documents (EDDs) and defend them in review. Designs for failure cases, not just the happy path.

  • API design: Expert knowledge of REST API design and development for mobile and web use.

  • Judgment and problem framing: Reframes poorly posed problems instead of answering them as asked. Decides with incomplete information and states the assumptions relied on. Distinguishes reversible from irreversible decisions and applies rigor accordingly. Choose the smallest solution that solves the problem.

  • Data stores: Strong relational database experience (MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MS SQL) and strong non-relational database experience (Cassandra, Redshift, DynamoDB, or HDFS).

  • Testing and observability: Defines alert thresholds, SLIs, and SLOs for the domain along with the telemetry that supports them. Designs for graceful degradation. Ships new features with monitoring already in place. Co-owns Acceptance Tests coverage decisions with SDET and flags testability gaps before release.

  • Security and compliance: Follows Tala's security and privacy practices in line with ISO-27001 and ISO-27701, follows OWASP secure coding practices, and remediates vulnerabilities within established SLAs.

  • AI fluency: Knows when not to delegate to AI and decomposes domain work into agent-sized units with explicit acceptance criteria. Builds reusable context assets, prompts, and skills that others in the domain adopt. Sets the verification bar for the domain's AI-assisted work. Is accountable for AI-generated code as if it were hand-written, and never puts PII, borrower or credit data, secrets, or production credentials into a prompt or agent context.

  • Delivery and impact: Owns delivery of domain roadmap work and balances feature velocity against technical debt deliberately. Owns an outcome rather than a task list, knows which metrics their systems move, and watches them after release.

  • Ways of working: Expert proficiency in the Agile development process. Prioritizes and communicates well in a fast-paced environment. Strong drive for independent learning and work.

title: Asset Protection Detective, Valencia Town Center - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an Asset Protection Detective, you will help protect company assets, reduce shortage, and support a safe, customer-focused shopping environment. Using surveillance, investigative tools, and strong partnerships with store teams and law enforcement, you will identify and respond to theft, recover merchandise, and help protect our customers, colleagues, and business.

Why This Role Matters

Asset Protection Detectives play an important role in reducing loss while maintaining a safe and welcoming store environment. Through training, observation, investigation, and de-escalation, this role helps protect company assets, support colleagues, and ensure customers can shop with confidence.

How Our Asset Protection Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They greet teammates with a warm hello. Before they get started, they review updates and department information so they're fully informed and ready to engage with confidence.

  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.

  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

What To Expect

  • Use surveillance techniques, investigative tools, and reporting systems to help identify theft, dishonest activity, and shortage trends.

  • Partner with Asset Protection leaders, store teams, and law enforcement to support investigations and protect company assets.

  • Apply de-escalation tools and sound judgment to help maintain a safe environment for customers and colleagues.

  • Prepare clear documentation, statements, and evidence to support investigations, audits, and legal proceedings.

  • Support team readiness by training colleagues on protocols that help protect company assets.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Help protect customers, colleagues, and company assets by identifying, investigating, and responding to theft and dishonest activity.

  • Use surveillance techniques to support the apprehension of shoplifters and dishonest employees, while following company policies and legal requirements.

  • Recover stolen merchandise and provide statements, evidence, and documentation to support investigations.

  • Prepare timely and accurate reports related to theft incidents, investigations, audits, and assigned activities.

  • Build strong partnerships with store colleagues, Asset Protection leaders, and law enforcement to support investigations and shortage reduction.

  • Maintain compliance with company policies and legal standards related to apprehensions, searches, and evidence preservation.

  • Testify in court for criminal and civil cases, as needed.

  • Respond to alarm calls, support special assignments, and facilitate first aid for customers and colleagues when needed.

  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Skills That Matter

Must Have

  • Ability to observe, identify, and respond to suspicious activity in a retail environment.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with customers, colleagues, leaders, and law enforcement.

  • Ability to use sound judgment, de-escalation tools, and company procedures to support a safe environment.

  • Ability to handle proprietary, sensitive, and confidential information with discretion and integrity.

  • For jobs in New York, a current New York State Security Guard License is required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in retail, customer service, asset protection, security, investigations, or law enforcement.

  • Ability to prepare accurate reports, statements, and documentation related to incidents and investigations.

  • Experience using surveillance systems, reporting tools, or investigative technology.

title: QA
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for validating software functionality, identifying defects, creating test strategies, and collaborating with development teams to deliver high-quality products that meet business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Test Planning & Design

  • Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories.
  • Develop test plans, test cases, test scenarios, and test data.
  • Define test strategies and quality assurance processes.
  • Estimate testing efforts and timelines.

Functional Testing

  • Perform Manual Testing, Functional Testing, Integration Testing, System Testing, Regression Testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Validate business workflows and application functionality.
  • Execute test cases and document results.
  • Identify, log, track, and verify defects through closure.

API & Database Testing

  • Test REST and SOAP APIs using tools such as Postman and SoapUI.
  • Validate backend services and integrations.
  • Perform database validation using SQL queries.
  • Ensure data integrity across applications.

Quality Management

  • Track defects using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
  • Conduct root cause analysis for recurring defects.
  • Monitor and report quality metrics.
  • Ensure compliance with defined quality standards and processes.

Agile Collaboration

  • Participate in Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Work closely with developers, business analysts, and product owners.
  • Support shift-left testing and continuous quality practices.
  • Contribute to continuous process improvement initiatives.

Required Skills

Testing Skills

  • Strong knowledge of SDLC and STLC.
  • Experience in Manual Testing and Defect Management.
  • Functional, Regression, Integration, System, and UAT Testing.
  • Test Case Preparation and Execution.
  • Root Cause Analysis and Defect Lifecycle Management.

API & Database Testing

  • Hands-on experience with Postman, SoapUI, or REST Assured.
  • Strong SQL skills for database validation.
  • Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, XML, and Microservices.

Tools

  • Jira, Azure DevOps, HP ALM, or equivalent test management tools.
  • Confluence for documentation.
  • Git for version control.

Automation Knowledge (Preferred)

  • Exposure to Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar automation tools.
  • Basic scripting knowledge in Java, Python, or JavaScript.
  • Understanding of test automation concepts and frameworks.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience in Retail, eCommerce, Banking, or Healthcare domains.
  • Understanding of Performance and Security Testing.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Attention to detail and quality-focused mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Defect Detection Efficiency
  • Defect Leakage Rate
  • Test Coverage Percentage
  • Requirement Coverage
  • On-Time Test Delivery
  • Reduction in Production Defects
  • Customer Satisfaction and Product Quality Metrics

Nice-to-Have Certifications

  • ISTQB Certified Tester
  • Certified Agile Tester
  • Scrum Certification
  • Selenium Certification
  • Azure/AWS Fundamentals
