title: Payment Integrity Analyst
description:
At Clover Health, we are committed to providing high-quality, affordable, and easy-to-understand healthcare plans for America’s seniors. We prioritize preventive care while leveraging data and technology through the Clover Assistant, a powerful tool that helps physicians make informed health recommendations. By giving doctors a holistic view of each member’s complete health history, we ensure better care at a lower cost—delivering the highest value to those who need it most.

Clover’s Payment Integrity team is responsible for ensuring claims are paid accurately, consistently, and in accordance with applicable requirements. We’re looking for a Payment Integrity Analyst who brings strong Medicare Advantage claims and reimbursement knowledge, investigative judgment, and the ability to translate claims data into defensible findings.

In this role, you’ll investigate potential payment inaccuracies, evaluate claims populations identified through SQL analysis, and determine whether the evidence supports a payment issue or a correctly adjudicated outcome. You’ll research applicable requirements, work through claim histories and exceptions, and help turn validated findings into actionable recommendations and repeatable audits.

You’ll work closely with the Senior Manager, who will lead complex SQL development, investigation priorities, and validation methodology. You should be comfortable independently running and adapting existing queries, using AI tools thoughtfully, and taking ownership of assigned investigations from initial review through a documented recommendation.

As a Payment Integrity Analyst, you will:

  • Investigate potential payment inaccuracies using Medicare Advantage adjudication and reimbursement knowledge to interpret claims data and explain payment outcomes.
  • Review claims populations identified through SQL analysis and distinguish supported payment discrepancies from valid exceptions, data issues, and correctly adjudicated claims.
  • Research applicable CMS/NCCI and other coding guidance, provider contract terms, benefit documents, and internal payment policies and configuration requirements. Identify effective dates, applicability, and unresolved source conflicts.
  • Analyze claim and line detail, payment components, adjustments, reversals, and related claim history to understand what occurred and assess the expected payment outcome.
  • Independently run SQL queries and make targeted changes to dates, filters, and claim selections.
  • Actively seek evidence that could disprove a suspected issue, including correctly paid comparison claims, exceptions, and alternative explanations.
  • Document the applicable sources, validation steps, exclusions, supported payment impact, and unresolved questions clearly enough for another reviewer to reproduce the conclusion.
  • Use approved AI tools to support research, query interpretation, and documentation while verifying sources, factual claims, and analytical outputs.
  • Review and audit outputs from audit tools, identifying false positives and refining rules to improve precision.
  • Prepare findings for review and support downstream recovery evaluation, operational resolution, and Compliance/Legal review as needed.
  • Contribute to recurring audits, monitor previously validated issues, and recommend improvements to investigation and testing processes.

Success in this role looks like:

  • Within the first 90 days, you’ve developed a working understanding of Clover’s claims data, payment integrity workflows, and validation approach. You’re independently running and making basic adaptations to existing queries, completing assigned claim reviews, and documenting findings and open questions clearly.
  • Within six months, you’re taking ownership of defined investigations with limited day-to-day direction, identifying exceptions and alternative explanations, and preparing source-supported recommendations for review. You’re also contributing to recurring audits and helping improve the team’s testing and documentation practices.
  • Over time, your work helps the team identify and validate payment inaccuracies more efficiently, reduce false positives, and translate supported findings into payment corrections and sustainable controls.

You should get in touch if:

  • You typically bring 3–5 years of relevant experience in payment integrity, reimbursement analysis, claims audit, complex claims research, claims examination, or related work, including direct Medicare Advantage experience.
  • You have strong practical knowledge of Medicare Advantage claims adjudication and reimbursement, including how benefit provisions, provider contracts, payment policies, and configuration can affect outcomes.
  • You can investigate payment discrepancies, test competing explanations, recognize exceptions, and distinguish a suspected issue from a supported finding.
  • You can independently work through defined investigations, identify missing information, and escalate complex or unresolved questions with a clear explanation of the evidence needed.
  • You have practical SQL proficiency and can navigate large relational database environments, recognizing unexpected duplication, exclusions, or changes in results.
  • You have strong Excel skills and experience reviewing, filtering, comparing, and reconciling claims-level datasets.
  • You have meaningful hands-on experience using AI tools in analytical, research, or claims-related work and exercise sound judgment about verification and appropriate data handling.
  • You communicate clearly in writing and verbally, and can explain complex findings to technical and operational partners.
  • You bring strong attention to detail and can manage multiple investigations while maintaining organized, traceable documentation.

We’d be especially interested if:

  • You have supported overpayment investigations, payment corrections, or recovery review.
  • You have tested claims payment rules or investigated configuration-related discrepancies.
  • You have developed or maintained recurring claims audits.
  • You hold coding or reimbursement credentials relevant to your experience, though certification is not required.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Company Introduction

We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did we ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar e-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest-growing ecommerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.

We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurial surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Job Overview

Fulfillment Optimization (FO) owns the systems that decide how every Coupang order is planned, distributed, and fulfilled. Our Tier-1 services sit on the critical path of every purchase decision and order across Korea and Taiwan. The platform has scaled to support Coupang's growth and requires continued investment in architecture, operational excellence, and team development to meet the next order of magnitude in scale, accuracy, and configurability. The FO platform comprises interconnected services that together handle the full fulfillment lifecycle -- from real-time order planning and cost optimization, through inventory management and warehouse orchestration, to simulation and workflow automation -- across a polyglot stack (Kotlin, Python, Java) serving Korea and Taiwan.

The Role

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead Coupang's Fulfillment Optimization organization globally. You will own the technical vision, execution roadmap, and people leadership for the FO platform across Seoul and India. This role combines deep technical ownership of production-critical Tier-1 systems with the organizational leadership required to build, scale, and retain a high-performing engineering team across multiple geographies. You will partner closely with Product, Data Science, and Operations leadership to drive fulfillment optimization outcomes that directly impact customer experience, cost efficiency, and operational scalability across Korea and Taiwan.

Why This Role Matters

The leader in this role will directly influence how millions of orders are fulfilled every day. Every architectural decision — solver latency, pruning strategy, inventory consistency, network cost modeling — impacts customer trust, delivery speed, and operational cost across Coupang's entire ecommerce platform in Korea and Taiwan.

This is a rare opportunity to lead a platform organization at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, real-time optimization, and ecommerce fulfillment — with direct, measurable impact on Coupang's customer experience and bottom line. You will own both the technology and the team, with the autonomy to define the architecture, set the engineering culture, and build the organization that delivers it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and drive architecture design of FO systems for scale, future extensibility, and reliability — setting the technical direction for order planning, fulfillment optimization, inventory allocation, and network cost management across all FO platform components.
  • Envision and drive alignment with stakeholders on the appropriate roadmap and future direction of technology for Fulfillment Optimization — translating business objectives (PDD rationalization, CFCC consolidation, multi-market expansion, cost optimization) into technical execution plans.
  • Navigate and alleviate technical obstacles and blockers at the organizational level — driving cross-team alignment across FO, Promise, WMS, Supply Chain, and Operations teams.
  • Decompose complex problems into simple, straightforward solutions, providing mechanisms for the teams to prioritize ruthlessly and "move with urgency."
  • Own the architecture, development, testing, deployment, and delivery of large-scale global software applications, systems, platforms, services, and technologies powering Coupang's fulfillment optimization across Korea and Taiwan.
  • Drive reliability and operational excellence for mission-critical Tier-1 services — circuit breakers, graceful degradation, observability, capacity planning, and incident prevention for systems with strict P99 latency SLAs.
  • Ensure high quality design reviews which meet business and architectural goals and drive critical feedback on architecture and design issues across distributed systems involving gRPC service meshes, Kafka event pipelines, CPLEX optimization solvers, and multi-layer caching.
  • Build, mentor, and retain a high-performing engineering team across Seoul and India — hiring senior engineers and managers, developing engineers through career stages, establishing engineering culture, and creating an environment where top talent wants to stay and grow.
  • Participate in strategic planning to achieve technical and business goals with team, leadership chain, and with customers — partnering with Product, Data Science, and Operations to translate fulfillment optimization goals into measurable outcomes.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience working directly within engineering teams in a fast-moving environment.
  • 10+ years of experience in developing and operating backend services and web applications.
  • 7+ years of experience architecting and designing (architecture, design patterns, reliability, and scaling) of new and current systems.
  • 5+ years of experience leading and managing engineering teams, including manager-of-managers experience, hiring, performance management, career development, and building team culture across multiple locations.
  • Experience building complex, high-performance, and highly available distributed software systems with strict latency and reliability requirements (sub-100ms P99, 99.95%+ availability) that have been successfully delivered to customers.
  • Strong technical depth in JVM backend systems (Java, Kotlin) — ability to review architecture, evaluate technical proposals, and make build-vs-buy-vs-migrate decisions.
  • Extensive experience in managing mission critical Tier-1 services with high throughput and low latency — including circuit breakers, graceful degradation, observability, capacity planning, and incident management.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures using Kafka at scale — stream processing, event sourcing, exactly-once semantics, consumer group management.
  • Experience in system design — API design, domain modeling, data modeling, caching strategies (Redis, in-memory, S3-backed), messaging patterns, service-to-service communication (gRPC, REST).
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams to define mission, vision, and roadmaps.
  • Experience partnering with product, data science, and program management teams.
  • Proven track record of managing distributed/remote engineering teams across time zones and geographies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in ecommerce fulfillment, supply chain, logistics, order management, inventory management, warehouse management, or planning/optimization systems.
  • Experience with optimization systems — solvers (CPLEX, Operations Research-Tools, Gurobi), decision engines, constraint programming, or data-science-integrated production systems.
  • Platform modernization experience — migrating legacy systems to microservices, event-driven architectures, or domain-driven designs in production environments.
  • Solid engineering skills as a technical leader to coach and lead high performing software engineers and keep them motivated.
  • Excellent communication and analytical skills to shepherd communication with end users, technical and business teams to collect requirements, describe product features, and develop technical designs to achieve business goals.
  • Knowledge of Agile software engineering practices and patterns for the full software development lifecycle including coding standards, code reviews, build processes, testing, and live site operations.
  • Demonstrated leadership in cross-functional, highly collaborative environment.
  • Track record of developing engineers through various career stages and building high-performance teams.
  • Demonstrated focus on continuous improvement of systems, software, and processes through data analysis and metrics.
  • Ability to independently operate and lead through ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with Agentic AI tools for development and code review — using AI-assisted coding agents (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, Devin, Claude Code) to accelerate development velocity, improve code review quality, and automate repetitive engineering tasks.
  • Experience with Spec-Driven Development — defining system behavior through specifications (OpenAPI/Swagger, Protocol Buffers, API-first design, contract-first development) before implementation, ensuring well-defined contracts between services.
  • Experience with multi-region systems — region-specific routing, data isolation, cross-border fulfillment, and per-market configuration management.

title: Asset Protection Detective, River Oaks Center - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an Asset Protection Detective, you will help protect company assets, reduce shortage, and support a safe, customer-focused shopping environment. Using surveillance, investigative tools, and strong partnerships with store teams and law enforcement, you will identify and respond to theft, recover merchandise, and help protect our customers, colleagues, and business.

Why This Role Matters

Asset Protection Detectives play an important role in reducing loss while maintaining a safe and welcoming store environment. Through training, observation, investigation, and de-escalation, this role helps protect company assets, support colleagues, and ensure customers can shop with confidence.

How Our Asset Protection Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They greet teammates with a warm hello. Before they get started, they review updates and department information so they're fully informed and ready to engage with confidence.

  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.

  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

What To Expect

  • Use surveillance techniques, investigative tools, and reporting systems to help identify theft, dishonest activity, and shortage trends.

  • Partner with Asset Protection leaders, store teams, and law enforcement to support investigations and protect company assets.

  • Apply de-escalation tools and sound judgment to help maintain a safe environment for customers and colleagues.

  • Prepare clear documentation, statements, and evidence to support investigations, audits, and legal proceedings.

  • Support team readiness by training colleagues on protocols that help protect company assets.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Help protect customers, colleagues, and company assets by identifying, investigating, and responding to theft and dishonest activity.

  • Use surveillance techniques to support the apprehension of shoplifters and dishonest employees, while following company policies and legal requirements.

  • Recover stolen merchandise and provide statements, evidence, and documentation to support investigations.

  • Prepare timely and accurate reports related to theft incidents, investigations, audits, and assigned activities.

  • Build strong partnerships with store colleagues, Asset Protection leaders, and law enforcement to support investigations and shortage reduction.

  • Maintain compliance with company policies and legal standards related to apprehensions, searches, and evidence preservation.

  • Testify in court for criminal and civil cases, as needed.

  • Respond to alarm calls, support special assignments, and facilitate first aid for customers and colleagues when needed.

  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Skills That Matter

Must Have

  • Ability to observe, identify, and respond to suspicious activity in a retail environment.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with customers, colleagues, leaders, and law enforcement.

  • Ability to use sound judgment, de-escalation tools, and company procedures to support a safe environment.

  • Ability to handle proprietary, sensitive, and confidential information with discretion and integrity.

  • For jobs in New York, a current New York State Security Guard License is required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in retail, customer service, asset protection, security, investigations, or law enforcement.

  • Ability to prepare accurate reports, statements, and documentation related to incidents and investigations.

  • Experience using surveillance systems, reporting tools, or investigative technology.

  • Ability to train or coach colleagues on asset protection protocols, shortage reduction, or safety practices.

Physical Activities You Will Perform

  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.

  • Position requires prolonged periods of standing/walking around store or department.

  • May occasionally involve reaching above eye level, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.

  • Must be able to apprehend shoplifters.

  • Ability to sustain long periods of time enclosed in surveillance areas.

  • Frequently lift/move up to 30lbs.

  • Requires close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

Licensed Social Worker Associate – Independent Clinical (LSWAIC)

As an Associate Mental Health Provider, you will provide brief, solution-focused therapy, group interventions, and psychological support to adults participating in industrial rehabilitation programs, under appropriate clinical supervision. This role emphasizes professional growth, cultural and linguistic sensitivity, interdisciplinary collaboration, and elements of case management while providing opportunities to develop clinical skills and experience toward independent licensure.

  • Collaborate with the rehabilitation team to ensure integrated, holistic care
  • Document patient progress thoroughly in compliance with program and regulatory standards
  • Participate in case conferences and team meetings to adjust care plans as needed
  • Identify and address psychological factors impacting rehabilitation within a short-term intervention framework


Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in counseling, Psychology, Social Work, Marriage and Family Therapy, or a related behavioral health field.
  • Active Washington State associate-level credential in good standing (LMHCA, LMFTA, or LSWAIC).
  • Relevant clinical experience through employment, internship, practicum, or supervised practice.
  • Ability to provide individual and group interventions within the scope of the applicable credential and under required clinical supervision.
  • Strong communication, documentation, and interdisciplinary collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with brief, solution-focused interventions, rehabilitation, chronic pain, or trauma-related care.
  • Familiarity with Washington State L&I programs and processes.
  • Experience with EMR documentation.


Benefits

title: Software Developer
description:
Who We Are

Progressive Building Society is a leading local financial institution with a proud reputation for customer service excellence. Our purpose is to encourage local people to save and become homeowners, through our personal, caring & common-sense approach, essentially nurturing financial well being for current and future generations.

The Society is continuing to modernise and improve through its operational resilience processes, strong customer experience including self-services capabilities, integration between platforms, automation of processes, supporting our community and caring about our environmental impact.

What you will be doing

Developing, supporting and continuously improving software solutions that enhance the Societys systems and business processes, working under supervision as part of the IT team and in line with Progressives development standards, security controls and regulatory requirements.

The role contributes to the Societys strategic plan by analysing requirements, building and integrating applications, and promoting best practices such as CI/CD and test-driven development to improve user experience, automation and operational efficiency.

About The Role

The Software Developer will be required to:

  • Analyse business needs with stakeholders to gather requirements for new and existing projects.
  • Work with the in-house subject matter experts and IT teams to support the business and improve automation of key processes.
  • Develop and maintain .NET solutions (e.g., C#, ASP.NET Core, APIs and background services) or SaaS platform changes, in line with agreed architecture and the Societys coding standards and to deliver improved customer experience.
  • Implement best practices such as continuous integration, continuous delivery and test-driven development.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (unit/integration) using appropriate .NET testing frameworks and support test execution within the CI pipeline.
  • Use source control and follow branching, pull request and code review practices; address review feedback and share learning with the team.
  • Support data-related development including SQL query writing, stored procedure changes where applicable, and safe use of ORM/data access patterns.
  • Assist with troubleshooting and resolution of defects and incidents across development, test and production environments, under supervision, including root-cause analysis and fix validation.
  • Produce clear technical documentation (e.g., configuration notes, support guides and release notes) to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.
  • Support build and release processes for .NET applications (e.g., Azure DevOps pipelines), including deployment steps, environment configuration and post-release verification.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools appropriately to support software design, coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation and knowledge discovery, while applying professional judgement, security requirements and coding standards.
  • Evaluate and validate outputs generated by AI tools to ensure accuracy, maintainability, security and compliance with the Society's policies and regulatory obligations.
  • Contribute to the adoption of emerging development practices, including responsible use of AI technologies to improve team productivity and software quality.

    Progressive Building Society is committed to providing equal opportunities for all. As part of our recruitment process, successful applicants will be subject to our pre-employment checks. These include credit checks and criminal record checks (Access NI basic check through a responsible body).

Required Criteria

  • Degree in Computer Science related discipline.
  • A minimum of one years experience developing applications in a professional work environment.
  • Experience of .NET ecosystem and C#.
  • Awareness of programming best practices and ability to apply them under guidance
  • Good understanding of current and emerging technologies and their potential to deliver business benefits.
  • Good analytical approach to problem solving.
  • API integration to core platforms (e.g. banking systems).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to adapt style and explanations to support others understanding.
  • Understanding of AI-assisted software development tools and the ability to apply them effectively to support coding, testing, debugging, documentation and problem solving.
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure solutions meet security, quality and business requirements.

Desired Criteria

  • A scripting language, such as Python or Powershell.
  • Development and design skills with MS SQL or Oracle.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT or similar technologies.

About The Company

Careers at Progressive

We know that looking for a career means so much more than just finding a job. At Progressive, we want to help you find your happy place to work.

We firmly believe in encouraging our employees to achieve the right balance between their work and personal lives, delivering access to and promoting family-friendly policies.

This not only increases employee satisfaction but also enables Progressive to meet the needs of our Members and supports the Society in being positioned as one of the most successful financial institutions in Northern Ireland.

Company Culture

To work for Progressive is to be part of something special. We strive to nurture and develop our employees in the evolving and fast paced financial services industry. Outlined below are a list of the reasons why we feel Progressive is a great place to work:

We aim to provide an inclusive and respectful working environment, where everyone recognises the importance and impact of teamwork.

We celebrate staff diversity and work hard to ensure that our staff members feel valued as individuals and respected for their contribution to our success.

We offer opportunities for our staff to work at the heart of our communities and make real differences to our Members lives.

We do not subscribe to a long-hours culture, instead valuing family life and supporting our staff to balance work and family commitments.

Company Benefits

We offer our staff competitive employment conditions and a range of benefits designed to achieve high levels of staff engagement and job satisfaction.

We understand that by taking steps to positively enhance the well-being of our staff, we can help them to achieve their goals and boost their motivation to deliver the best possible outcomes for our members.

description:
Do you want to be part of a growing team in the medical industry?

  • Have you been searching for an opportunity to be able to impact someone’s life?
  • Are you interested in working in a manufacturing environment that makes products that save lives?


If the answer is YES, then PMC SMART Solutions is the place for you!


Who is PMC SMART Solutions?

PMC, as a globally-recognized, award–winning contract manufacturer, provides life-saving medical devices and safety-enhancing automotive components to a broad base of international, market-leading OEMs and Tier One customers.


PMC offers services from design for manufacturability and program management through injection molding, full assembly, packaging and sterilization management, focusing on precise-tolerance, intricate devices and components. For its medical customers, PMC functions under ISO 13485 certification, FDA registration and operates state-of-the-art, certified Class 8 (100,000) clean rooms. PMC is a certified Women-Owned Business Enterprise, offering a comprehensive range of services while supporting global OEMs’ supplier diversity goals.


What would you look forward to in this role?

  • Become part of a team that works hard to ensure timely delivery of products that impact people’s lives!
  • Partner with talented long term Team Members

What key responsibilities would you assume in this role?

  • Ensure all products are shipped correctly and in a timely manner.
  • Schedule freight carriers and maintain accurate records.
  • Remain in compliance with shipping regulations
  • Distribute items received to the correct area/team members.
  • Responsible for maintaining the finished product area organized.

Who will you work side by side to achieve extraordinary results?

  • Talented Inventory Control Manager, Production Manager, Buyers, and Operations team.
  • Experienced Shipping and Receiving Clerks.
  • Many other PMC Team Members throughout the organization.

title: Marketing Designer
description:
MARKETING & DESIGN OPPORTUNITY


MARKETING DESIGNER - Life Science


About the Company
Sapho Bio is the developer of a rapid microbiology release platform for precision medicine. We are a multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers committed to transforming pharmaceutical release testing through innovation, speed, and accuracy. We are a team built on ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement, scaling rapidly following product validation and commercial traction. Our culture emphasizes agency, innovation, intellectual curiosity, and continual learning.



About the Role
We are seeking a Marketing Designer to rapidly create, curate, and scale the content that makes Sapho Bio's science understandable, credible, and compelling. This role sits at the intersection of marketing, visual design, and scientific communication. This position reports to the Head of Growth. Your work will span paid ad and marketing campaigns, email and newsletters, social and web content, flyers and sales collateral, and technical documentation. You will work in close partnership with our Growth Engineer.

This role is designed for someone who is equally comfortable in a design tool, an ad manager, and a scientific document. We care about evidence that you can produce polished, technically accurate content quickly and at scale, and that it drives qualified leads.



Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 2+ years creating marketing or technical content, pairing strong visual design and writing with real scientific or technical depth; experience in biotech, pharma, or other regulated industries is a strong plus.
  • A visual portfolio demonstrating your design and writing work and the results of campaigns you ran, such as ad campaigns, social content, video, flyers, or technical documents.
  • Daily, hands-on use of AI-native design tools and workflows (e.g., Claude Design, agentic design, AI image and video generation) to take assets from brief to polished, on-brand final in hours, not days. Canva or Adobe skills are a plus, but not sufficient on their own.
  • Track record of campaigns across email (e.g., HubSpot) and social channels (e.g., LinkedIn, X, TikTok, Meta), plus technical collateral (flyers, application notes, white papers), with measurable outcomes you can show, such as engagement, open and click through rates, leads, or pipeline influenced.
  • Hands-on experience setting up and managing paid ad campaigns (e.g., LinkedIn, Meta, Google, X), including audience targeting, creative testing, budget management, and optimizing for cost per qualified lead.
  • Experience creating short-form social video and product explainers, including AI-generated video, that earn attention and shares while staying technically and scientifically accurate.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, move quickly, and maintain strong attention to detail in a fast-paced startup environment, with a demonstrated ownership mentality and strong follow-through.
  • Must reside within a reasonable commuting distance of San Carlos, CA.


Responsibilities

  • Rapidly turn cold contacts into qualified leads with email and social campaigns, newsletters, and curated content that move prospects from first touch to a sales conversation.
  • Set up, run, and optimize paid ad campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Google, X, and other relevant channels, owning targeting, creative, A/B testing, and budget to lower cost per qualified lead.
  • Build self-serve website content, such as product pages, application notes, white papers, FAQs, and explainer videos, that lets prospects educate themselves and convert without waiting on sales.
  • Produce a high volume of polished, on-brand assets, including flyers, one-pagers, social graphics, short-form video, and conference materials, using AI-native design workflows to go from brief to final in hours, not days.
  • Write clear, technically accurate copy and documentation, partnering with scientists and leadership so every claim is correct.
  • Build reusable templates, brand guidelines, and an organized asset library so quality holds as output scales.
  • Track the performance of every asset and campaign, including engagement, conversion, and lead quality, and iterate quickly in partnership with the Growth Engineer.
  • Own projects end to end and perform other duties as assigned in support of company growth.



Schedule & Location

  • This position is full-time, exempt, and primarily onsite in San Carlos, California.
  • The standard schedule is Monday through Friday, with regular in-person collaboration across the team.
  • Occasional travel may be required for conferences, company events, customer research, training, or other business needs.



Compensation & Benefits
Salary Range: $100,000 - $115,000 annually

In addition to base compensation, this position is eligible for stock option participation, subject to
company equity plan terms.
Benefits:

  • Paid Time Off: Unlimited PTO, plus company-recognized holidays.
  • Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
  • DoorDash Credit: $25 credit for lunch and dinner while working in the office.
  • 401(k) Plan with company matching, subject to plan terms.
  • Company-paid life insurance.
  • Stock option package.



Ideal Candidate Profile
You are someone who:

  • Takes full ownership of outcomes, not just assigned tasks.
  • Has a strong work ethic and consistently follows through on commitments.
  • Is naturally organized and enjoys building systems that scale.
  • Has a strong eye for design and takes pride in polished, accurate work.
  • Is intellectually curious and committed to continuous learning.
  • Learns quickly and adapts well to changing priorities.
  • Maintains a high level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.
  • Enjoys working in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.
  • Uses AI-native tools to ship more, faster, without sacrificing quality.



Application Requirements
Please include a link to your portfolio. Your cover letter (one page) should include clear examples of:

  • A time you demonstrated exceptional work ethic.
  • A piece of content or design you created that explained a complex technical or scientific topic.
  • A campaign you ran, such as a paid ad, email, or social campaign, and the measurable results it produced.



Life at Sapho Bio

  • High-Impact Work: Help transform pharmaceutical testing and accelerate patient access to life-saving therapies.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Financial Security: 401(k) with company matching and company-paid life insurance.
  • Time to Recharge: Unlimited PTO and company-recognized holidays.
  • Connection & Community: Team lunches, office events, and offsite gatherings.
  • Competitive Compensation: Market-leading salary and meaningful equity participation.
  • Fast-Paced Environment: Join a team that moves quickly, learns continuously, and executes with purpose.
  • World-Class Team: Work alongside experienced scientists, engineers, and operators.
  • Prime Location: Sunny, collaborative workspace in San Carlos.


Sapho Bio is an equal employment opportunity employer. Employment is at-will, in accordance with California Law.

title: Servicing Ops Sr Specialist
description:
As the Servicing Ops Sr Specialist, you will be responsible for reviewing and fulfilling customer servicing requests throughout the life cycle of the customer’s loan or line of credit. These requests are often complex in nature and require strong judgment, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset.

You will play a key role in delivering an exceptional customer experience by ensuring requests are completed accurately, efficiently, and in a manner that consistently meets and exceeds customer expectations. While operating within established procedures, you will also identify opportunities to enhance processes, strengthen controls, and improve overall service delivery. This role requires regular customer communication as well as collaboration with internal business partners to ensure seamless execution and alignment across teams, while maintaining a well-controlled environment that effectively mitigates operational and regulatory risk.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Service Customer Requests:
    Process and fulfill a wide range of customer servicing requests with accuracy, timeliness, and a focus on first-time resolution. Demonstrate ownership of requests from intake through completion, ensuring a positive and seamless customer experience.
  • Deliver an Exceptional Customer Experience:
    Consistently exceed customer and business partner expectations by responding to inquiries within established service level agreements, proactively communicating updates, and identifying opportunities to enhance the customer journey.
  • Partner Across Teams:
    Collaborate regularly with internal stakeholders and business partners to resolve complex requests, remove obstacles, and ensure consistent, end-to-end servicing excellence.
  • Maintain a Strong Control Environment:
    Adhere to established procedures, policies, and SOPs while ensuring all activities are performed within a tightly controlled environment. Consistently meet quality and productivity standards and promptly escalate any potential risks or control gaps.
  • Ensure Compliance and Risk Mitigation:
    Maintain a strong understanding of applicable regulatory requirements and internal policies. Actively identify, escalate, and help remediate risk-related concerns to protect the organization and its customers.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement:
    Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and enhance the overall customer experience. Share recommendations and support the implementation of process improvements.

Qualifications

  • Customer service, mortgage and/or operations experience preferred
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Continuous improvement mindset
  • High School Diploma or GED required

Hours & Work Schedule

  • Hours per Week: 40
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM
  • Location: Fully on-site at Johnston, RI office

title: Senior Software Engineer (Golang/TypeScript/React) - Independent Contractor
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Golang/TypeScript/React) - Independent Contractor based in Portugal.

This is a senior engineering opportunity focused on building and evolving a data-intensive platform used by major global organizations and financial institutions.
You will work across backend microservices and modern frontend applications, combining Golang, TypeScript, and React to deliver reliable and performant products.
The role offers meaningful ownership, with engineers expected to take features from initial ideas through production and ongoing improvement.
You will contribute to technical strategy, architectural decisions, engineering standards, and the modernization of existing systems.
The engineering environment emphasizes observability, automation, performance, clean code, and continuous improvement.
You will collaborate within a distributed technical organization while engaging with Product and stakeholders across the wider business.
The position is fully remote and requires working US Eastern Time hours to maintain strong collaboration with the broader team.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, develop, test, maintain, and enhance Golang microservices and frontend applications, ensuring they remain reliable, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with product needs.
  • Build polished, performant, component-based user interfaces in React and TypeScript, following established design system principles and delivering a strong customer experience.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of features, from ideation and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement in production.
  • Contribute to technical strategy by evaluating architectural options, balancing existing systems with new technologies, and clearly communicating technical decisions and trade-offs.
  • Improve the performance, reliability, and observability of services and applications through effective engineering practices and appropriate monitoring solutions.
  • Raise engineering quality standards through clean-code practices, thoughtful code reviews, automation, process improvements, and the adoption of technologies that improve team productivity.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, Product Managers, and stakeholders across the business to understand requirements, communicate complex technical topics, and deliver solutions that create meaningful business impact.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong professional experience developing backend services and web applications with Golang, including deploying services in Docker containers.
    • Strong experience building modern, componentized frontend applications using React and TypeScript, with a focus on performance, usability, and maintainability.
    • Ability to write performant SQL and work effectively with data-intensive applications and relational databases.
    • Strong understanding of clean-code principles and idiomatic TypeScript and Go, with the ability to apply these principles during development, code reviews, and engineering standards.
    • Ability to quickly understand a new business domain and product, learn independently, and apply that knowledge to technical and product decisions.
    • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and improving technical skills, engineering practices, and ways of working.
    • Experience with concurrent application logic, such as Go goroutines, is beneficial but not essential.
    • Experience building CI/CD pipelines, particularly with GitLab CI, is a plus.
    • Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, as well as experience with AI tools used to improve engineering productivity or productionized AI solutions, is advantageous.
    • Additional experience with MaterialUI, Airflow, Python, or Terraform is welcome.
    • Experience with technologies such as Golang, TypeScript, React, MaterialUI, MariaDB, ClickHouse, GitLab, AWS, and SQL is valuable.

      • Benefits:

      • Compensation of USD 5,000–6,500 per month as an independent contractor.
      • Fully remote working environment with location flexibility.
      • US Eastern Time working hours, typically aligned with approximately 2:00 PM–10:00 PM CET or 1:00 PM–9:00 PM BST.
      • Opportunity to work on a data-intensive platform serving major international organizations and financial institutions.
      • Significant ownership over features, technical decisions, architecture, and engineering improvements.
      • Exposure to large-scale financial data collection, processing, validation, analytics, and data-driven products.
      • Collaboration within a technical organization of approximately 30 technologists, working in small, cross-functional teams alongside Product Managers and business stakeholders.
      • Opportunity to contribute to engineering standards, automation, observability, performance, and adoption of modern technologies including AI-enabled tooling.
      • Fully remote collaboration within an international, technology-focused environment.

title: Lead Product Manager - Applied AI
description:
Who is Quantium?

Quantium is a world leader in data science and artificial intelligence. Established in Australia in 2002, Quantium is a global team of more than 1,200 people across 14 locations with a unique blend of capabilities across product and consulting services to help businesses unlock value from data and analytics. Quantium partners with the world's largest corporations to forge a better, more intelligent world.

Our Product team sits at the centre of how we turn data science capability into market-ready solutions. As we scale our AI product portfolio, we are investing in rigorous, evidence-based validation to ensure we are building things that are genuinely worth building. This role sits at the very front of that process -- shaping what gets on the roadmap before a single line of code is committed.

How will you make an impact?

  • Operate at the front of the AI product funnel -- assessing incoming ideas and proofs of concept to determine whether they are worth building, using evidence and commercial rigour rather than gut feel
  • Build and present invest-or-stop recommendations to senior stakeholders, including market sizing, unit economics, and strategic fit analysis
  • Make credible build-or-kill calls based on evidence gathered during validation -- including the hard call to stop something that does not stack up
  • Work with engineering, legal, and operations at the right moments in the validation cycle -- pulling them in proactively rather than treating them as downstream functions
  • Help shape the validation framework itself -- there is no existing playbook, and this person will have a hand in building it
  • Where opportunities survive validation, contribute to shaping the product vision and route to market

The superpowers you’ll be bringing to the team:

  • Demonstrated experience doing real discovery, validation, and assumption testing ahead of any committed build -- not just executing against an agreed roadmap
  • Personally built commercial cases -- market sizing, unit economics, invest-or-stop recommendations -- that reached senior stakeholders and were stress-tested in practice
  • Has actually recommended stopping a product or opportunity based on evidence, and can articulate the reasoning, the evidence, and what happened next
  • Comfortable engaging engineering, legal, and ops during validation -- knows the right questions to ask without needing to be a developer or a lawyer
  • Self-directed and comfortable creating structure where none exists -- the validation methodology is still being built, so the right person builds the plane while flying it
  • Experienced enough to operate without an intermediary and make credible recommendations to senior leaders
  • Exposure to AI or agentic solutions; cross-industry experience in opportunity assessment; experience helping shape a product vision from a validated opportunity through to market.

Remember – you might not tick all the boxes, but don’t let that from stopping you applying. We’re more interested in how you work, your ability to solve problems and think big.

What could your Quantium Experience look like?

Working at Quantium will allow you to challenge your imagination. You will get to solve complex problems using rigor, precision and by asking great questions – but it also means you can think big, outside the box and push your problem-solving skills to the max.

By joining the Quantium team, you’ll get to:

  • Forge your path: So many of our team have moved around different teams or offices. You’ll be in the driver’s seat, and we empower you to make your career your own.
  • Find your kind: Embrace diversity and connect with your tribe (think foodies, dog lovers, readers, or runners).
  • Make an impact: Leave your mark. Your contributions resonate, regardless of your role or rank.

But wait, there’s more!

We’ve got some pretty sweet perks:

  • Flexible work arrangements: Achieve work life balance at your own pace with hybrid and flexible work arrangements.
  • Continuous learning: Our vision is empowering analytics talent to thrive. The Analytics Community fosters the development of individuals, thought leadership and technical excellence at Quantium through building strong connections, fostering collaboration, and co-creation of best practice.
  • Remote working: Embrace the opportunity to work outside of your assigned home location for up to 30 days every year.

Apply now and let's forge a better, more intelligent world together!

This provides information on how we collect, use & store your personal information, including potential disclosure to our majority shareholder, Woolworths Group Limited.

title: Sr. Director, Technology & Systems
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Director, Technology & Systems based in the United States.

This is a senior technology leadership opportunity to build the systems foundation supporting a growing, mission-driven organization.
The role owns technology strategy end-to-end, from multi-year roadmaps and infrastructure to data governance, cybersecurity, vendors, and technology investments.
You will serve as the organization’s trusted technology advisor, helping executive and departmental leaders make smart, scalable decisions.
A major focus will be identifying practical opportunities for AI to increase organizational capacity while ensuring responsible adoption, training, and appropriate safeguards.
The position combines strategic leadership with hands-on oversight of systems, vendors, projects, budgets, and organizational change.
You will lead and develop internal technology capabilities while working closely with external partners and cross-functional stakeholders.
For an experienced technology leader seeking meaningful scope, executive visibility, and the opportunity to build sustainable systems for a purpose-driven organization, this role offers significant impact.

Accountabilities

  • Own the multi-year technology strategy and roadmap, translating organizational growth objectives into a scalable systems and infrastructure plan.

  • Serve as the internal authority on technology investments, implementations, priorities, and trade-offs, providing clear recommendations to executive leadership.

  • Evaluate the technology environment end-to-end and sequence investments to support sustainable growth rather than fragmented or reactive solutions.

  • Manage the technology budget across vendors, licenses, staffing, infrastructure, and strategic projects with strong fiscal accountability.

  • Establish organization-wide standards for technology evaluation, procurement, implementation, and governance.

  • Report on technology performance, risks, priorities, and roadmap progress to senior leadership and the Board when appropriate.

title: Senior Backend Developer – (Golang, Data & Integrations)
description:
Senior Backend Developer - (Golang, Data & Integrations)

i3D.net ·Netherlands, Rotterdam HQ

Job Description

At i3D.net , we provide world-class global coverage with one of themost interconnected networksin the world. Our solutions focus on low latency, zero packet loss, and unmatched scalability, enabling seamless experiences for millions of users worldwide. With dedicated support, bespoke solutions, and cutting-edge technology, we deliver reliable, cost-efficient infrastructure that empowers game developers and businesses to scale effortlessly. Partnering with major names likeNvidia, DuckDuckGo, andUbisoft, we are shaping the future of gaming and network technology.

Why your role matters

You’ll own how business and customer data flows across the organization, with a focus on billing, product, and sales data. Working at the intersection of engineering, finance, and product, you’ll build the foundation that makes data reliable and auditable, removing manual reconciliation, stabilizing migrations, and ensuring billing flows and pricing models behave predictably at scale.

This is a backend engineering role, not a traditional data or ETL setup. Using Go, you’ll build services and APIs that expose billing logic and connect systems like HubSpot and NetSuite, shaping how data moves across the organization in production.

You’ll work on greenfield architecture and database design, defining customer data models, system relationships, and asset structures that determine what customers can buy and how it is invoiced, using SQL where needed for validation and reconciliation. You’ll be part of a team of five developers, working closely with a Business Analyst and owning these flows end to end.

What you’ll be doing

Own data migrations and pipelines:Design and implement ETL flows to move billing, contract, and asset data into target systems with full validation and rollback capability

Model and transform complex data structures:Analyze legacy databases, define transformation logic, and ensure consistent, idempotent data handling

Build scalable backend services in Go:Develop services and abstraction layers that expose billing logic and enforce business rules, while leveraging the right tools (e.g. SQL, Python) for data transformations and migrations

Standardize product and pricing models:Define reusable product and offer structures that work consistently across systems and integrations

Integrate external systems into billing flows:Connect ERP, CRM, payment, and inventory platforms with secure, reliable data exchange and reconciliation

Develop robust APIs and integrations:Build REST and gRPC APIs with strong validation, logging, retry logic, and monitoring

Automate migrations and operational processes:Create tooling, scripts, and runbooks that support repeatable migrations and controlled cutovers

Improve observability and incident response:Implement monitoring, dashboards, and alerting to quickly detect and resolve data or integration issues

Collaborate across teams:Work closely with Finance, Product, and Business Analysts to refine business rules and validate outputs

Mentor and contribute to architecture decisions:Share knowledge, review code, and help shape the long-term billing architecture

Databases:MariaDB

Practices:Test-Driven Development (TDD), CI/CD pipelines, Agile methodologies - we follow a "you build it, you deploy it, you support it" philosophy

IDE:Choose the development environment that you’re most comfortable with

What success looks like in the first year

You’ve delivered reliable migration plans and scripts with rollback strategies, automated validation, and clear verification reporting

You’ve defined and documented data mappings and transformation rules, including legacy schemas, business logic, and edge cases

Standardized product, pricing, and billing models are implemented and consistently used across systems and integrations

Core billing APIs, services, and integrations are live, including payment flows and inventory sync, with validation, logging, and auditability

Monitoring, dashboards, and runbooks are in place, giving clear insight into data quality, system health, migrations, and incident handling

Backend engineering:5+ years of building production systems in Go, .NET, or PHP and comfortable using Go as the main language

Data and SQL:Experience with SQL, MariaDB, or Postgres and working with complex schemas

Migrations and ETL:You’ve designed transformation pipelines, written idempotent scripts, and built validation tooling

APIs and integrations:Built and integrated REST or gRPC APIs with authentication patterns like OAuth2 or JWT

3rd party integrations:Connected systems such as ERP, CRM, payment providers, or inventory platforms

Infrastructure and automation:Comfortable with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and tools like Terraform or Ansible

Testing and quality:Write unit, integration, and contract tests to ensure reliability

Ownership and communication:Take end-to-end responsibility and work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Remote vs Onsite:This is a hybrid position with some onsite work required at our Rotterdam office. You are either already in the Netherlands or open to relocating here, and we provide relocation services to support your move (a valid EU work permit is necessary).

High ownership and real technical depth:You’ll design systems, not just implement them, and take full ownership from idea to production.

Make an Impact:Work on core projects that power global gaming and tech giants like Ubisoft.

Hybrid Work Setup:Enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid role with a work-from-home budget and top-tier tools.

Competitive Perks: Enjoy great pay, shift bonuses, an annual bonus, 25 vacation days (excluding national holidays), travel allowance, and a premium-free pension.

Skill Development: Level up with career guidance and education reimbursement.

Gaming Perks: Get lifetime access to Ubisoft’s game library

Stay Active: Use our in-house gym in Rotterdam or unwind in the game and music rooms.

title: Software Engineer, DevSecOps
description:
The Role


Joining Moderna means advancing mRNA science to transform medicine. Work with exceptional global teams on a broad pipeline and build a career that makes a real difference for patients.


Moderna is strengthening its international business services hub in Warsaw, supporting our growing global operations. We welcome professionals ready to help advance our mission and shape the future of mRNA medicines.


This is an opportunity to help shape the engineering foundations that power Moderna's software ecosystem. As a hands‑on DevSecOps Software Engineer, you'll partner directly with developers to build secure, scalable platform capabilities that simplify software delivery and accelerate innovation across the organization.


Working across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, automation, AI‑enabled developer tooling, and platform operations, you'll play a key role in improving developer experience while helping teams deliver modern applications faster, more securely, and with greater reliability.



Here’s What You’ll Do



  • Build and evolve automation that powers Moderna's internal developer platform using technologies including Python, TypeScript, GitHub Actions, Pulumi, Docker, AWS, JFrog, and a variety of vendor APIs.

  • Collaborate closely with application engineering teams (\"Builders\") to migrate workloads onto standardized, secure platform capabilities.

  • Support the migration and ongoing management of existing DevOps tooling by onboarding repositories and engineering teams, validating platform behaviour, improving developer workflows, and documenting remediation paths.

  • Design, build, and maintain developer remote workspace infrastructure, reusable templates, container configurations, base images, development tooling, and onboarding documentation that enable teams to become productive quickly.

  • Improve platform reliability and operational excellence through monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and automation that reduces operational toil.

  • Develop clear internal documentation, implementation examples, and \\"paved road\\" guidance that enables engineering teams to adopt platform capabilities consistently.

  • Identify recurring developer challenges and continuously improve shared frameworks, reusable templates, automation, and platform tooling that enhance engineering productivity.

  • Participate in operational support for owned platform services while continuously automating repetitive operational activities.

  • Help expand AI‑assisted software development by integrating MCP‑style capabilities, packaging internal engineering tools, supporting AI agents, and improving developer experience through modern AI‑powered workflows.

  • Contribute across the complete software lifecycle—design, implementation through cloud infrastructure, deployment, CI/CD, and production operations—as you continually expand your technical expertise.



The key Moderna Mindsets you'll need to succeed in the role:



  • We obsess over learning. We don’t have to be the smartest we have to learn the fastest.

  • We digitize everywhere possible using the power of code to maximize our impact on patients.



Here’s What You’ll Need (Minimum Qualifications)



  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering,DevOpsor a related role.

  • Strong programming skills in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python.

  • Hands‑on experience building and operating solutions in AWS.

  • Experience creating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for production systems.

  • Interest in developer tooling, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, and secure software delivery.

  • Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, code review, version control, and system design.

  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to changing team priorities and contribute across a range of platform engineering responsibilities, including areas outside immediate prior experience.



Here’s What You’ll Bring To The Table (Preferred Qualifications)



  • Familiar withinfrastructureascodetools.

  • Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms.

  • Experience with artifact repositories such asJFrogArtifactory, Nexus, GitHub Packages, or similar.

  • Experience with security scanning tools, dependency management, code scanning, or vulnerability remediation workflows.

  • Comfort partnering with multiple engineering teams and influencing adoption through strong technical execution.



Pay & Benefits


At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work.


That’s why our benefits and well‑being resources are designed to support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between.



  • Competitive healthcare, plus voluntary benefit programs to support your unique needs

  • A holistic approach to well‑being with access to fitness, mindfulness, and mental health support

  • Family building benefits, including fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support

Since our founding in 2010, we have aspired to build the leading mRNA technology platform, theinfrastructure to reimagine how medicines are created and delivered, and a world‑class team. We believe in giving our people a platform to change medicine and an opportunity to change the world.


By living our mission, values, and mindsets every day, our peopleare the driving force behind our scientific progress and our culture.Together, we are creating a culture of belonging and building an organization that cares deeply for our patients, our employees, the environment, and our communities.


We are proud to have been recognized as a Science Magazine Top Biopharma Employer, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in the U.S.


As we build our company, we have always believed an in‑person culture is critical to our success. Moderna champions the significant benefits of in‑office collaboration by embracing a 70/30 work model. This 70% in‑office structure helps to foster a culture rich in innovation, teamwork, and direct mentorship. Join us in shaping a world where every interaction is an opportunity to learn, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

title: Norton Yard Design & Sales Specialist
description:
Why Gallagher?

Know livestock. Know farmers. Know what works.

Norton is part of Gallagher and has been designing and manufacturing practical livestock handling solutions for Australian farmers for decades. Now we're looking for someone who can take that expertise into the field – building relationships, identifying opportunities and turning customer needs into smart yard solutions.

You'll have the autonomy to manage your region, spend time on farms and own opportunities from first conversation through to sale.

Alongside a competitive package, you'll get a company vehicle, 20% incentive, laptop, phone and iPad, plus the backing of an experienced agricultural team.

The Opportunity

This is a field-based sales role with a difference.

You'll work directly with livestock producers to understand how their yards operate, what they're trying to achieve and where things could work better. You'll assess sites, understand livestock flow, develop initial yard concepts and build proposals that our CAD team turns into detailed designs.

You'll own the customer relationship and the sales opportunity – from the first farm visit through to closing the deal and delivering a solution the customer is genuinely happy with.

There's plenty of variety: on-farm visits, customer conversations, yard design, quoting, dealer relationships and commercial sales.

What you’ll do

  • Build strong relationships with farmers, dealers and rural industry contacts

  • Visit farms to assess sites, understand requirements and identify opportunities

  • Develop practical yard concepts and project proposals

  • Manage sales opportunities from enquiry through to close

  • Grow sales and market share across your region

  • Support and train dealers and customers

  • Keep your pipeline, forecasting and CRM activity on track

  • Work with our sales, technical and CAD teams to deliver great customer outcomes

The Fit

We're looking for someone who understands agriculture and knows how to sell into it.

You might come from livestock or rural sales, farm infrastructure, animal handling equipment, rural consultancy, yard design – or have strong practical farming experience combined with commercial sales ability.

You'll bring:

  • A genuine understanding of livestock, cattle flow and on-farm operations

  • Experience selling to farmers or working in the agricultural sector

  • Strong commercial instincts and a proven ability to convert opportunities

  • Confidence building relationships and having practical conversations with customers

  • The ability to understand a customer's operation and recommend the right solution

  • Self-motivation, organisation and the independence to manage a regional territory

  • A practical, down-to-earth approach and a genuine connection with the agricultural industry

You’ll also be comfortable with travel of 2 – 3 days per fortnight depending on your location.

If you know livestock, understand farmers and have the commercial drive to turn opportunities into results, we'd like to hear from you.

Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and the role may be filled before the closing date.
