title: Ford Racing Activation Fleet Leader
description:
Racing is where our story began.

In 1901, Henry Ford climbed into a car he built himself—"Sweepstakes"—and beat America's most famous driver. He wasn't a racer, but he had to win. He did. Ford Motor Company was born from that victory.

That fighting spirit lives on in Ford Racing today. We're the engineers, strategists, and competitors who bring Ford's track-tested edge into every vehicle we build. Every track, every stage, every proving ground—that's where we prove ourselves.

The result: one of the world's most iconic brands, legendary nameplates, and a team unmatched in the industry.

Our mantra: Race to win, engineer to lead.

If you're a competitor, innovator, or performance obsessive, Ford Racing is where you belong. Help us write the next chapter.

In this position...

We are seeking an experienced individual to join the Business & Operations team in Ford Racing. Business & Operations supports the entire Ford Racing Organization including Engineering, Production programs, Competition programs, Brand and Marketing while working directly with Ford’s Vehicle Programs, Supply Chain, Finance/Accounting, Legal/Risk Analysis and other internal partners. The support for Motorsports Competition spans across all of the race series including NASCAR, NHRA, multiple Sportscar series, Australia Supercar, Formula 1 and numerous Off-Road Racing series. This is a very dynamic, fast-paced, and unique group that incorporates a broad range of responsibilities with exposure to cross-functional management. Currently, we have an opening in Business & Operations and look forward to welcoming the ideal candidate as soon as identified!

We are looking to establish a lead role for the management and operational needs of the Activation Fleet Program. The Activation Fleet Program supports various partners across NASCAR, NHRA, Sports Car, Off-Road, Formula 1, and other partners. The leader of the Activation Fleet will manage all business and operational elements of this vehicle program to ensure compliance to company policy, registering company assets and interface with assigned partners to as necessary to maintain program timelines.

To be successful, you will have perseverance, patience, be committed to improving processes, maintain detailed organization and able to ensure accuracy with timely execution under demanding timelines. Ultimately, a top-notch candidate should have excellent organizational, people management, and problem-solving skills.

This role is hybrid and requires at least 4 days per week onsite in Allen Park, MI.

What you'll do...

  • Manage the Ford Racing Activation vehicle fleet based upon program scheduled needs and new obligations.
  • Create and maintain the Order Guide that is associated with the Activation fleet needs and shall be used by partners of Ford Racing.
  • Maintain CVMS and local database to track all Activation vehicle information including orders, delivery, pick-up, returns and auctions.
  • Coordinate vehicles with Ford Racing partners, including the timing, logistics, etc.
  • Submit partner orders in CVMS, following up to ensure timely scheduling and delivery to end customers.
  • Coordinate shipping, delivery and logistics for scheduled events with partners and dealerships.
  • Author and deliver required documentation.
  • Follow-up with all partners regarding delivery, returns and vehicle turn-ins.
  • Log Tracklite work orders to scheduled transportation of returned vehicles to auction.
  • Ensure appropriate bailments are in place for all fleet vehicles.
  • Ensure partners have the appropriate insurance coverage (per bailment agreement).
  • Maintain fleet registration.
  • Audit invoices for reimbursement to ensure only our vehicles are being billed.
  • Resolve tax/tag issues for improperly returned vehicles.
  • Maintain long-term and short-term bailment agreements approved with OGC.
  • Maintain the bailment documentation, including “Attachment A” vehicle list for each partner.
  • Process plate renewals and plate orders as necessary.
  • Create dealer delivery packets as necessary for each delivery, ensuring timely delivery.
  • Maintain and update CVMS with out-of-service information and in-service information.
  • Process vehicle transfers as required.
  • File American Road reports and provide support for Vehicle Programs and OGC as required.
  • Create and ensure vehicle order/transfer PSR’s are processed.
  • Order vehicles through CVMS, follow-up through scheduling to delivery to ensure timely execution.
  • Maintain official records for vehicle orders including authorization documents.
  • Manage and administer sales and ownership agreements, processing the appropriate paperwork as required.
  • Coordinate with Ford Clearinghouse and Vehicle Programs to obtain required documents and registration as company assets.
  • Compete all compliance audits as required to ensure compliance to compliance requirements.

You'll have...

  • Associated Degree with an Automotive Technology major.
  • 5+ years of experience in automotive related discipline.
  • 1+ year of experience with fleet management, including vehicle ordering, delivery and logistics.

Even better, you may have...

  • Automotive experience preferred.
  • Program / Project Management experience is desirable.
  • High degree of self-motivation and willingness to commit extra effort to always "get the job done".
  • Candidate must be comfortable in speaking and working with a passionate management team and interfacing externally with Ford partners.
  • Prior experience in the motorsports industry and a passion for performance products.
  • Able to succeed in a fast-paced, passionate work environment.
  • Comfortable interfacing with internal and external partners including agency partners, vehicle programs, legal and insurance.
  • Detailed, Self-Organized and able to manage multiple assignments simultaneously.
  • Proficient using Excel, Outlook, Word and other software programs.
  • Well versed in problem-solving, time management skills and the ability to improve processes.
  • Strong people management skills, excellent communication, both written and verbal.
  • Flexibility of schedule to support the global team; willingness and ability to travel if necessary.
  • Able to lift at least 30lbs safely.

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

  • Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage.
  • Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more.
  • Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more.
  • Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases.
  • Tuition assistance.
  • Established and active employee resource groups.
  • Paid time off for individual and team community service.
  • A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day.
  • Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

This position is a salary grade 5 - 8 and ranges from $65,100 - $166,200.
Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.

description:

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. Applied AI Engineers, ML Infra at Mistral AI work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest challenges and design and implement AI solutions. In this role, you’ll apply your problem-solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use AI to drive real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the most important industries and institutions globally!

Applied AI Engineers, ML Infra responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams and own end-to-end execution of high-stakes projects.   • You're experienced with deploying and managing AI-based products in production environments

We deliver an interactive learning experience, curated by faculty highly regarded in their academic fields so that students graduate with confidence in what they know, how they think and who they are. Our community is part of an international network of Sacred Heart schools, where students and adults embrace the catholic charism of our Sacred Heart founders, which is spiritually inclusive and global in nature. Athletic participation and physical education have the ability to impact individuals, not just through competition, but through understanding the underlying values that sports have to offer. As the Convent & Stuart Hall Athletics and Physical Education Department, we have the great opportunity to shape the lives of the students that we work with everyday. The lessons learned through athletic participation and physical education have the ability to teach skills and values that go far beyond just a game. It is the goal of this department to assist students in character development by teaching the values of humility, accountability, teamwork, work ethic, competition and fair play, and commitment. Our goal is to help students develop life-long leadership skills, build respect & awareness for themselves and others, and to overcome adversity. It is our mission to help students identify these values learned through athletic and physical education and to be able to apply them to their lives as a whole.

You will design, implement, administer, and optimize MySQL database environments with a strong focus on reliability, performance, security, and recoverability.

title: Payment Analyst

You’ll investigate payment performance across more than a dozen payment service providers, identifying issues before they become business-critical.
Your analysis will help distinguish technical defects from user-behavior patterns and uncover the bottlenecks with the greatest impact on authorization and conversion.
You’ll turn complex payment and customer data into clear insights that can guide Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Fraud teams.

  • Analyze authorization rates, decline codes, payment performance, and other funnel metrics to identify the highest-impact bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.

  • Investigate performance across multiple payment service providers and identify differences, outages, or recurring issues requiring attention.

title: 2027 Food & Beverage Internship at Sand Valley
description:
Sand Valley is a golf resort and community settled gently upon 12,000 acres of rugged, prehistoric sand dunes in central Wisconsin. Here, residents and guests will find six world-class golf courses built in harmony with the land: Sand Valley, Mammoth Dunes, Sandbox, The Lido, Sedge Valley, and Commons. Founded in 2016 by brothers Michael and Chris Keiser, the resort is known for its friendly hospitality and a community of golf and outdoor enthusiasts who have been drawn to the raw beauty and serenity of the vast Wisconsin Wilderness.
Beyond premier golf, Sand Valley is a year-round celebration of all the outdoors from fat-tire biking, hiking, and kayaking to ice hockey, skating, or a guided cold plunge. The resort now features a 13,000-square-foot Tennis Center with 16 grass tennis courts and the twelfth Court Tennis facility in the United States. Alongside soul-stirring golf and outdoor exploration, Sand Valley offers a variety of savory dining venues showcasing globally inspired and rustic Wisconsin cuisine.
The Sand Valley team works together to create experiences of a lifetime by asking questions and sharing ideas. With authenticity and a hard-working attitude, Sand Valley helps guide guests through an immersive experience in Wisconsin's natural beauty and away from the demands of daily life.

The Internship

Gain hands on hospitality experience as part of Sand Valley’s Food & Beverage team. Our interns work alongside experienced team members and leaders while learning the day to day operations of a busy destination resort.

With a variety of dining concepts across the property, you will gain experience serving guests, supporting restaurant operations, working across teams, and seeing how Food & Beverage contributes to the overall Sand Valley experience.

This is a working internship. You will be part of the team, contribute to daily operations, and build practical skills throughout the season.

What You'll Experience

  • Hands on experience in resort food and beverage operations
  • Different dining concepts and styles of service
  • Guest service and hospitality standards
  • Daily restaurant operations and procedures
  • Collaboration between Food & Beverage, Culinary, and other resort teams
  • Opportunities to strengthen your communication, problem solving, and leadership skills

What We’re Looking For

  • We are looking for students who are dependable, curious, and excited to learn.
  • Currently pursuing a hospitality, food and beverage, business, or related program
  • Genuine interest in hospitality and guest service
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills
  • Ability to stay organized in a fast paced environment
  • Willingness to learn, receive feedback, and help wherever needed
  • Flexibility to work mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays based on business needs

The Sand Valley Experience

Sand Valley offers a variety of dining experiences across the resort, from full service restaurants to casual outdoor and on course concepts. Interns become part of a growing operation serving guests from around the world while developing practical experience they can carry into their future careers.

Our goal is for you to leave Sand Valley with stronger skills, greater confidence, and a better understanding of what it takes to create a great hospitality experience.

Benefits

By joining the Sand Valley team, you will become part of a growing, evolving, and dynamic operation. You will learn to thrive in all situations, embrace challenges, and succeed in a fast-paced environment.

title: DV Shelter Advocate
description:
Days / Shift: Monday-Friday; 12:00pm – 8:00pm with flexibility to meet program needs (one Saturday rotation each month)

Position Type/Classification: Full-Time, 40 hours per week; Non-Exempt


Position Summary:

The DV Shelter Advocate utilizes an empowerment-based, trauma-informed, survivor-centered service model to provide direct crisis intervention, comprehensive case management, risk assessment, safety planning, and individual and group advocacy to domestic violence survivors residing in the emergency shelter.


The DV Shelter Advocate provides emotional support, information and referrals, criminal and civil advocacy, assistance with victim’s compensation, and linkage to resources focused on individual and family safety and self-determination of program participants. The DV Shelter Advocate handles hotline calls to assess callers for eligibility and provides telephone advocacy services to callers. The DV Shelter Advocate assists with the daily operations of the emergency DV shelter and assists with health and safety tasks, inventory, distribution of supplies, and organizing.


Job Responsibilities:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain an all-inclusive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job.

  • Handle Hotline calls from survivors, law enforcement officers, emergency dispatchers, and/or community partners, contacting the SafeSpace, Inc. Domestic Violence Hotline in a calm, professional, and non-judgmental manner. Provide survivors/callers with the following: eligibility and risk assessments, safety planning, information and referrals, emotional support, crisis intervention, domestic violence education, resources, and confidentiality.
  • Facilitate shelter orientation with residents upon entry and communicate community living guidelines to survivors as outlined in the Resident Handbook and provide welcome kits. Complete shelter intakes within 24 hours with new survivors entering the shelter program and immediately enter all relevant client data / information into the SafeSpace client management database.
  • Schedule and facilitate ongoing case management appointments as needed and requested by the survivor and provide on-going safety planning, risk/lethality assessment, crisis counseling / advocacy, transportation, service plan coordination with outside agencies, case management, goal setting, assists with identifying and accessing safe housing, education on the dynamics of domestic violence, information and referrals, court accompaniment and exit meetings.
  • Enter, update and maintain current and appropriate participant information regarding all ongoing services provided to participants immediately into the agency’s client database system in accordance with SafeSpace standards. Must maintain confidentiality laws applied to survivors of domestic violence and offer Releases of Information in the best interest of the survivor.
  • As identified or requested, provide relevant referrals and follow up with the participants as appropriate and assist with accessing referrals, including, but not limited to injunctions, legal processes and options, financial, medical, mental health, educational, employment, local youth services, afterschool care, summer camps, and ELC. Coordinate parent/family support services with other agencies to address concerns expressed by parent / legal guardian. Accompany participant as needed.
  • Inform and assist survivors in filing victim compensation claims from the Office of the Attorney General and processing Address Confidentiality applications including gathering the needed documentation and informing survivors of their rights. Provide follow-up advocacy with the victim compensation agency on the survivor’s behalf.
  • Provide criminal and civil advocacy services including court accompaniment, assisting participants in registering for Florida Department of Corrections VINE (Victim Information Notification Everyday), complete referrals to SafeSpace’s IFP Program, review law enforcement reports and initiate contact with the victim to offer services.
  • Facilitate weekly house meetings and groups on diverse topics that support an understanding of the dynamics of power and control while fostering individual safety, choice, strength, and well-being.
  • Participate in case staffing, shift meetings, team meetings, and staff meetings. Engage in one-on-one supervision meetings with the DV Shelter Manager.
  • Conduct daily walk-throughs and take corrective action to meet compliance with SafeSpace policies, procedures, standards, regulations, to ensure health and safety standards are met.
  • Conduct routine inventory of supplies to include food items, basic needs, and shelter supplies; assist in ordering and distributing supplies and donations.
  • Attend and facilitate professional development trainings, community events and interagency meetings as directed by the Supervisor.
  • Participate in other projects and assist with additional duties as requested by the Supervisor, including supporting the emergency disaster team in the event of a national disaster or weather emergency.

title: Market Research and Insights Lead
description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for a strategic, collaborative, and analytically minded Market Research & Insights Lead to shape insight generation and launch readiness for an investigational regenerative cell therapy in drug-resistant mesial temporal lobe epilepsy (mTLE), based in our Atlanta, GA office.

About the role

You will define and prioritize critical business questions, select the right research and analytics approaches, and integrate primary research with claims, referral, real-world evidence, and secondary data. You will translate complex and evolving clinical, patient, caregiver, and operational evidence into clear recommendations that strengthen regional and global decisions without overstating the evidence.

Who you’ll work with

You will be part of the Integrated Insights team and work across UCB with Commercial, Medical, Advanced Analytics, RWE, Market Access, Patient Engagement, Competitive Intelligence, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance and Safety colleagues. You will partner with external agencies to generate actionable evidence and insights.

What you’ll do

  • Build an integrated insights plan for mTLE across development, market preparation and launch readiness
  • Develop insight into the mTLE care and referral pathway
  • Explore high-involvement treatment decisions across patients, caregivers, healthcare professionals, payers and patient advocacy groups
  • Triangulate primary research with claims, referral, RWE, competitive intelligence and other healthcare data to generate decision-ready recommendations
  • Advise and constructively challenge stakeholders, align priorities across UCB and create shared ownership without relying on formal authority
  • Apply agile, test-and-learn approaches and approved AI or automation tools while preserving confidentiality, compliance, methodological rigor and human oversight
  • Lead external partners and ensure research follows global SOPs, governance requirements and pharmacovigilance obligations

Interested? For this role we’re looking for the following

Minimum requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree and minimum of 7+ years experience in market research, analytics or business intelligence within the pharmaceutical industry, an agency or a consultancy
  • Strong quantitative, qualitative and interpretative skills, with the ability to integrate structured and unstructured evidence and communicate data limitations and uncertainty
  • Experience reading and using healthcare data and partnering with advanced analytics specialists on integrated insight projects
  • Proven project leadership across multiple complex initiatives, including vendor management and compliant research execution
  • Strong stakeholder advisory, critical-thinking and influencing skills across functions, geographies and organizational boundaries
  • Clear storytelling for technical and non-technical audiences, with the ability to translate scientific and operational complexity into actionable commercial insight

Preferred requirements

  • Direct experience in cell therapy, gene therapy, regenerative medicine or another advanced therapy modality
  • Knowledge of epilepsy, drug-resistant mTLE, epilepsy surgery, neurostimulation, specialist-center pathways and referral dynamics
  • Experience supporting pipeline or early-stage assets in a scientifically complex environment with incomplete evidence and changing assumptions
  • Experience researching complex patient and caregiver decisions, center readiness, and behavioral or operational barriers to adoption
  • Proficiency in leveraging approved AI and automation tools to accelerate research, synthesis, and knowledge management, while exercising sound judgment, critical thinking, and appropriate human oversight to ensure reliable and actionable outputs

This position’s reasonably anticipated base salary range is $148,000 - $195,000. The actual salary offered will take into account related knowledge, skills, experience and location among other factors and may fall outside the expected range.

At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. A Product Owner will see the big picture and the small detail at the same time. He or she will understand the broad needs of the business, scan the competitive landscape in which their product operates, spot trends and technical developments and update the product roadmap as needed. At the same time, he or she will understand every detail of the product from design to functionality to usability. They will need to understand various ecommerce metrics and concepts very well – conversion, repeat rates, ROI, site performance metrics, bounce rates, return on investment, etc.

In summary, an Agoda Product Owner can expect to work on the cutting edge of technology, data, digital marketing, algorithmic decision-making and consumer psychology – all at a scale that very few ecommerce companies in the world today can offer.

Responsibilities:

  • Study processes and systems to analyze effectiveness of our organization to maximize our growth in identified strategic markets
  • Establish performance benchmark for each business drivers that caters to the characteristics of the strategic market, according to the needs of inbound, outbound and domestic travel segments
  • Develop reports to illustrate the “health level” of each business drivers and how each of them is related to the business’s bottom line
  • Identify business needs through detail investigation into business practice of competition, local business practice, customer behavior
  • Identify gaps between business needs and business practice to provide recommendations on solutions that results in new or changed process, technology, human resources, business partners
  • Clearly illustrate the opportunity cost and upside in each initiative
  • Converting strategic goals into operational tasks
  • Working with graphic designers to create and maintain consistent, branded look and feel across all products
  • Defining navigational flow and user experience on the site, apps, etc.
  • Making proposals to senior management regarding implications of proposed plans
  • Developing and implementing administrative and operational matters ensuring achievement of objectives
  • Defining KPIs for all projects and evaluating the success of a project.
  • Evaluating risks and tradeoffs associated with each course of action
  • Working closely with users to ensure all projects meet business needs

Qualifications:

  • NATIVE Japanese Speaker
  • Proven ability to leverage analytics and quantitative methods to inform and influence decision-making
  • Experience with emerging data-mining technology
  • Experience working in a fast-paced and high growth environment
  • Experience and passion for web design, functionality and testing
  • Enthusiasm to develop engineered processes and technologies and to apply innovative solutions to make organizational improvements while encouraging creative thinking and innovation
  • Ability to motivate and inspire development teams to achieve beyond what they imagined possible
  • Entrepreneurial and analytical; effective at managing change in a fast-moving and constantly evolving business
  • Experience with the latest internet trends and technologies
  • MBA or advanced Math, Computer Science or Statistics degree preferred

This role is based at Bangkok, Thailand. Visa/Work Permit and Relocation will be offered to the eligible candidate.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
Summary

Do you understand the power of persistence? Are you ready to get better every day? We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our development team in Krakow. You’ll play a key role in building products that improve the experience of millions of Guidewire customers worldwide. Working in a team of specialists who have a shared commitment to push further and achieve more.

Job Description

Software Engineer (P2)

Driven by integrity and motivated by the collective challenge.

At Guidewire, we’re changing the face of insurance. Developing and delivering technology that’s crafting the future of the property and casualty industry. We’re a global team of more than 2,400 working at scale and speed across a 500-million-dollar platform that gives insurers the tools they need to take care of their customers. Individually mastering our craft, to collectively empower millions.

Guidewire Cloud Platform

We are part of the team responsible for building the Guidewire Cloud Platform, enabling our customers to develop and deploy Guidewire Insurance Platform solutions to the cloud - similar to deploying applications on AWS. Under the hood, the platform is built on AWS, utilizing Kubernetes and Terraform for scalability and efficiency.

InsuranceSuite Deployment Services

This role is part of the team responsible for InsuranceSuite deployment services within the Guidewire Cloud Platform. The team’s focus is on delivering a reliable and automated experience for deploying and managing applications.

These services support not only deploying and undeploying InsuranceSuite applications, but also selective and blue-green deployments, scaling and hibernating InsuranceSuite nodes, database restore operations, deployment rollbacks, and many more.

Tech Stack

Our teams develop components for the Cloud Platform as autonomous microservices, primarily using a Java stack (Java 17+ and Spring Boot) supported by AWS-native services. Our microservice architecture runs on Kubernetes within AWS and integrates with platform services to manage deployment workflows, application resources, and deployment state. We provide

reliable interfaces and automation that help customers deploy and operate Guidewire applications.

Engineering Culture

Our teams take ownership of all aspects of the software development lifecycle for their services, including architecture, coding, quality assurance, infrastructure, and deployment/upgrade strategies. We embrace agile methodologies to promote collaboration and efficiency across our projects.

At Guidewire, we encourage curiosity, innovation, and the responsible use of AI. We empower our teams to use emerging technologies and data-driven insights to improve productivity and outcomes.

This role requires in-office attendance for 10 days per month (specifically, the last week of the month, Monday through Thursday; and for the remaining weeks, Tuesday and Wednesday).

What You Will Do

  • Clarify requirements, break down user stories, and deliver features within Guidewire Cloud Platform.

  • Build and improve InsuranceSuite deployment workflows, including selective and blue-green deployments, scaling, rollback, and restore operations.

  • Write clean Java and Spring Boot code with appropriate unit, integration, and acceptance tests.

  • Work with Kubernetes and AWS-based platform services to manage application resources and deployment state.

  • Participate in code reviews, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting using logs, metrics, and runbooks.

  • Collaborate with the team, SRE, and other Guidewire Cloud Platform teams to improve reliability, observability, and release automation.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong foundation in algorithms and data structures, with a minimum of 2 years of relevant programming experience.

  • Proficiency in Java or another programming language, with a willingness to quickly learn Java.

  • Familiarity with object-oriented design patterns and best practices, including Clean Code, Test-Driven Development (TDD), code reviews, and pair programming. Experience in developing microservices architecture.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, combined with a sense of ownership and drive.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts in an English-speaking environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and apply it to your role as well as use data-driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using public cloud providers, preferably AWS (including EKS, DynamoDB, IAM, SQS, S3, etc.).

  • Experience in building platform software using Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native technologies.

  • Familiarity with the Spring ecosystem (Core, Boot, Data, etc.).

About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC.

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it’s applicable to the position.

title: Compliance Operations Expert
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Compliance Operations Expert based in Brazil.

This role will shape the compliance foundations behind global fiat on-ramp and off-ramp payment solutions.
You will bridge compliance, legal, product, and operations to create scalable and practical regulatory frameworks.
The position combines traditional payment infrastructures with crypto and stablecoin settlement models.
You will contribute to regulatory strategy, licensing initiatives, partner enablement, and cross-border payment solutions.
Your work will span complex regulatory environments across LATAM, Europe, and MENA.
The role offers significant influence over how compliant financial products are designed, launched, and operated globally.
You will join a fast-moving, international environment where strong judgment, collaboration, and regulatory expertise are highly valued.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and implement compliance frameworks for fiat on/off-ramp and payment products, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements across LATAM, the EU, and MENA.

  • Design compliance-ready payment and settlement models that integrate stablecoins with traditional banking and payment infrastructures.

  • Create and maintain policies, business models, SOPs, risk assessments, and other documentation required to support product launches and ongoing operations.

  • Support and coordinate regulatory license applications, including EMI, PSP, SVF, CASP, MiCAR, or equivalent frameworks, by preparing operational, compliance, and product documentation.

  • Work closely with legal and compliance advisors to ensure regulatory filings meet local jurisdictional standards and requirements.

  • Engage with regulators and external legal counsel to clarify requirements related to cross-border settlements, payment flows, and stablecoin integration.

  • Advise product, engineering, operations, and business development teams on compliance implications and help adapt product processes accordingly.

  • Identify and structure partnerships with banks, PSPs, stablecoin issuers, and payment networks that satisfy compliance and operational requirements.

  • Establish secure and auditable fund-flow models incorporating KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, reporting, and internal control processes.

  • Design region-specific compliance solutions that account for regulatory, banking, payment, and foreign-exchange environments.

  • Develop global policy templates and partner onboarding guidelines to support consistent compliance execution across jurisdictions.

    • Requirements:

    • 5–10 years of professional experience in compliance, legal, regulatory operations, payments, fintech, or crypto-related environments.

    • Proven experience building, implementing, or scaling compliance frameworks for global payment solutions or financial institutions.

    • Experience engaging with regulators and supporting license applications across multiple jurisdictions, including frameworks such as EMI, PSP, SVF, CASP, or MiCAR.

    • Strong understanding of fiat payment infrastructures, including card settlement, bank transfers, and e-money frameworks.

    • Familiarity with crypto compliance environments, including VASP models, stablecoins, and blockchain-based financial products.

    • Hands-on experience designing payment fund flows, operational policies, internal controls, and compliance processes.

    • Deep knowledge of AML/CFT, KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, risk management, and regulatory reporting requirements.

    • Regional exposure to LATAM payment ecosystems and crypto regulations, with familiarity with environments such as PIX and SPEI considered valuable.

    • Understanding of European frameworks such as MiCAR, PSD2, or MiFID is advantageous.

    • Awareness of MENA payment service, stored-value, and stablecoin regulatory frameworks is a plus.

    • Strong strategic and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to balance regulatory rigor with business agility.

    • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with product, legal, engineering, operations, and business development teams.

    • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into clear and actionable business and product recommendations.

    • High integrity, strong analytical capabilities, sound judgment, and a global perspective on compliance innovation.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote work opportunity based in Brazil.

      • Professional development support through a dedicated study and growth fund.

      • Access to internal events, workshops, and team-building activities that encourage collaboration and innovation.

      • Opportunity to work within a diverse and international environment alongside colleagues across global markets.

      • Career development and advancement opportunities within a rapidly expanding digital finance environment.

      • Internal mobility opportunities designed to support long-term career progression.

      • Exposure to innovative payment, fintech, crypto, stablecoin, and cross-border financial solutions.

      • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on global compliance frameworks and emerging financial products.

title: Quality Inspector - SLA
description:
Be yourself at Protolabs
Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a diverse team that feels they are valued in the workplace. So do you feel you do not meet every single requirement but still intrigued? We encourage you to still apply! You can help make our company even better. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, age, mental or physical ability, or any way you represent yourself. We strongly believe diversity makes for more successful teams.
Why Protolabs?
We are the leaders in digital manufacturing. We hire doers, makers, and creative thinkers who tackle our roles with an entrepreneurial spirit. Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds. We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do. It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home.

Join our team as a

Quality Inspector!

Shift: Wednesday - Friday (9 am - 7:30 pm), Saturday (8 am - 6:30 pm)

Help ensure every part that leaves Protolabs meets the highest standards of quality and precision. As a Quality Inspector, you'll play a critical role in validating the accuracy, performance, and appearance of innovative manufactured components before they reach our customers. Combining a keen eye for detail with strong technical understanding, you'll inspect complex parts, identify opportunities for improvement, collaborate with production teams to resolve issues, and help drive continuous quality excellence. If you take pride in problem-solving, precision, and being the final checkpoint in delivering exceptional products, this is an exciting opportunity to make a direct impact in a fast-paced advanced manufacturing environment.

What You Will Do:

  • Inspect all parts to ensure surfaces are finished to the required specifications and requirements, free of damage, warpage, distortion, or resin.

  • Conduct thorough build briefings for each geometry to ensure a comprehensive understanding of part specifications and effectively identify missing features and defects.

  • Ensure any errors are corrected before the lot proceeds to the next stage, collaborating with the appropriate Shift Leader or Finishing Supervisor as needed.

  • Review paperwork and MES entries to ensure all Post-build, Pre-Cure, and Finishing special instructions have been completed accurately, and ensure the overall accuracy of electronic records for each lot in MES.

  • Issue send backs to Model Finisher and log any issues to track errors, work quality issues, missed defects, and identify training needs, reviewing with the Lead or Supervisor as needed.

  • Understand and apply knowledge of how different materials and build and finishing processes impact part quality.

  • Prepare inspected lots for the Shipping department to take.

  • Back up the Model Finisher or Solvent Specialist team as needed.

  • Maintain a clean and safe work area and individual workspace and assist in general cleanliness and maintenance of the facility.

  • Observe and follow all Protolabs Safety and Quality policies and procedures, including use of any required PPE (safety glasses, gloves, steel-toed footwear, etc.) and safety/compliance training.

  • Identify any parts that have not been cleaned properly and review with the Lead or Supervisor (Solvent Lab Only)
  • Manage storage and disposal of extra parts (SLS Only)
  • Review all CoC's and inspect all parts returning from external vendors to ensure the requested work has been completed (DMLS Only)

What You Bring:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Minimum 6 months of Finishing or Solvents experience

  • Strong understanding of 3D geometries, materials used in the technology processes and the defects associated with them.

  • Demonstrated computer aptitude for working with complex database applications, including proficiency with Windows OS, Microsoft Office, and calculators.

  • Ability to follow detailed instructions in various formats and take directions effectively from Supervisors and Team Leads.

  • Proven ability to learn new techniques, adapt to a fast-paced environment, and solve problems efficiently.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to make precise, coordinated movements for manipulating small parts.

  • Excellent punctuality and reliability.

  • Demonstrated ability to work safely with sharp tools/objects (e.g., hobby knives, utility knives) and use measuring instruments like scales and calipers.

  • Ability to follow procedures for operating and maintaining a laboratory in a clean and safe manner, including wearing all required PPE (gloves, lab coats, etc.).

What Sets You Apart:

  • 1+ year experience in Finishing or Solvent department

What's In It For You:

  • We offer a competitive salary and total rewards package
  • We offer amazing benefits including but not limited to:
  • Health Insurance: Traditional OR High Deductible plan
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Health Savings Account (including employer contributions)
  • Dental and Vision
  • Basic and Supplemental Life Insurance
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  • Paid caregiver leave
  • You will receive at least 3 weeks of PTO + Wellness + Holiday Pay + Volunteer Hours
  • 401k with company match and immediate vest
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program at a discounted rate
  • Matching grants through Protolabs foundation
  • And More!
Proto Labs maintains ITAR-compliant operations in all of our United States based facilities. Due to ITAR regulations, this role is only open to U.S. Citizens, lawful permanent residents (green card holders) or foreign nationals granted refugee or asylee status. Individuals with temporary visas (e.g. E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, TN or OPT) are not eligible for hire in this role.
Proto Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer
Physical Demands:
While performing the essential duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use a computer keyboard, monitor and mouse, telephone and printer; reach with hands, and arms, talk, see and hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, stoop or kneel and must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
Work Environment:
Indoors (A/C); nonsmoking; the majority of this job function is performed in an office setting requiring normal safety precautions. However, there may be job duties that require the employee to spend time in the manufacturing areas exposed to machinery and noise; eye protection occasionally required. Occasionally works in outside weather conditions. Occasionally works near moving mechanical parts and in high, precarious places and is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic chemicals, risk of electrical shock and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet to moderate.

title: AI and Data Literacy Lead (UK)
description:
Make your mark for patients

We are looking for an Artificial Intelligence and Data Capability Lead who is practical, collaborative, and outcome-oriented to join our Transformation team, named Ruby, based in the United States or in Europe : Either in our headquarters in Belgium or in UK, Slough.

About the role

You will build the practical artificial intelligence and data literacy that enables teams to use data and emerging technologies confidently, responsibly, and effectively in their daily work. You will translate expectations into role-specific learning, practical guidance, and supported application within real business workflows. This business-facing role focuses on helping people understand, evaluate, and use data and artificial intelligence in practice. You will also challenge teams to rethink how their processes can evolve, while ensuring appropriate human judgment, verification, and measurable business value.

Who you’ll work with

You will be working in a team that operates across the Patient Evidence organisation, within Data Products Operations. You will collaborate with business leaders, portfolio and product leads, business analysts, subject matter experts, data and technology teams, and partners in learning, change, communications, privacy, and compliance. Together, you will connect learning to priority business questions, available data products, and technology-enabled capabilities, while building confidence and encouraging responsible, evidence-based use.

What you’ll do

  • Define and maintain an artificial intelligence and data literacy framework aligned with business roles, decisions, and workflows.
  • Assess capability needs, identify priority audiences, and address learning gaps and barriers to adoption.
  • Translate complex data, analytics, governance, and artificial intelligence concepts into clear, practical business language.
  • Design role-based learning paths, playbooks, examples, working sessions, and reusable learning resources.
  • Embed learning into real business questions, data products, and technology-enabled workflows.
  • Build understanding of data meaning, origin, quality, limitations, and suitability for purpose.
  • Promote responsible use through human oversight, output verification, and evidence-based decision-making.
  • Measure proficiency, application, confidence, adoption, and business impact, using feedback to continuously improve learning.

Interested? For this role we’re looking for the following education, experience and skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in data, analytics, artificial intelligence, business, learning, organisational development, life sciences, or a related field. An advanced degree or relevant professional qualification is preferred.
  • Experience in data, analytics, digital transformation, learning, change, or business enablement roles.
  • Experience translating complex data and artificial intelligence concepts into practical guidance for non-technical audiences.
  • Experience designing role-based learning, capability frameworks, learning resources, and applied learning experiences.
  • Experience supporting adoption and behaviour change within a complex, collaborative organisation.
  • Understanding of data quality, governance, semantics, analytics, and responsible artificial intelligence principles.
  • Strong facilitation, communication, coaching, and storytelling skills, with the ability to connect learning to measurable outcomes.
  • Experience in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or life sciences is preferred.

Are you ready to ‘go beyond’ to create value and make your mark for patients? If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

About us
UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless expressly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Should you require any adjustments to our process to assist you in demonstrating your strengths and capabilities contact us on EMEA-Reasonable_Accommodation@ucb.com. Please note should your enquiry not relate to adjustments; we will not be able to support you through this channel.

title: Senior Product Owner - BKYC
description:
Solaris is Europe’s leading embedded finance platform, pioneering Banking-as-a-Service to bridge the gap between financial technology and licensed banking. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Berlin, Solaris enables fintechs, digital ecosystems, and multinationals to embed accounts, cards, lending, and payments directly into their own products, creating seamless financial experiences for their users. As a fully licensed German bank, Solaris combines the highest standards of IT security and regulatory resilience with a modular, highly scalable infrastructure.

Today, Solaris is driving the next evolution of financial services by transitioning into an AI-native banking platform, ensuring European businesses can deploy secure, adaptable financial products at scale.

Why join Solaris?

  • 🚀 We are fundamentally redesigning banking processes around AI orchestration, standardized modular building blocks, and embedded regulatory compliance.
  • 🎯 We combine tech and banking in dedicated hubs - driving the technology infrastructure out of Berlin and banking operations out of Frankfurt.
  • 💡 Through our internal mobility, growth opportunities, and the Solaris Academy, we offer continuous learning tracks, AI ambassador mentorship, and upskilling to keep your skills ahead of the curve.
  • ⚖️ We foster a workplace rooted in integrity, proactive risk management, and equality actively driving initiatives like DEI initiatives.

About the role

Rapid growth, expanding fintech partnerships, and evolving EU regulatory frameworks (AMLR) make Business KYC one of the bank’s most strategic priorities. As Senior Product Owner for BKYC domain, you will lead the vision, strategy, and execution for our business onboarding and periodic review platforms. You will partner closely with engineering, compliance, and commercial stakeholders to automate manual workflows, reduce processing times, and build scalable systems that unlock business growth while ensuring strict regulatory compliance. You’ll serve as the dedicated leader for our BKYC engineering team, setting clear priorities and driving product excellence from day one.

While this role focuses on BKYC, strong product owners from adjacent domains - such as retail KYC, CDD, AML, or broader financial crime prevention - are highly encouraged to apply. What matters most is your ability to untangle complex business structures (like corporate hierarchies, cross-border entities, and screening workflows) and translate them into scalable product solutions.

Your Role

  • Take full ownership of a product sub-domain, from conceptualization to delivery, ensuring alignment with overall business goals. Together with the Engineering counterparts form the leadership team for the domain.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across the organization, clearly communicating product visions, strategies, and updates.
  • Contribute to the creation and execution of product roadmaps, setting clear priorities and milestones.
  • Implement and refine agile methodologies within the development team to enhance productivity and delivery quality.
  • Drive the development of solutions that meet market needs and user expectations, staying ahead of industry trends and applying creative thinking to solve problems.
  • You participate in the proactive identification, management, and mitigation of risks and findings within your product domain, aligning with Solaris' compliance and policy standards.

We'd love to see

Depending on your level of experience, your responsibilities and scope of role will range. We don’t care much about fancy titles, but rather about real personal and professional development, as laid out in our learning framework. Let’s figure together out how you can contribute to our team.

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in banking, business, engineering or any other related fields.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager/Owner or a similar profession - experience in a banking / fintech environment is a strong advantage.
  • Experience in creating new products, dealing with complex code base and maintaining services.
  • Experience in working with engineering teams and understand their mindset and language.
  • Exposure to B2B or BaaS environments - where business clients are onboarded through partner channels - is a plus.
  • Experience with BKYC processes - such as corporate entity verification, UBO identification, or business customer due diligence - is a strong advantage.
  • Awareness of the regulatory landscape affecting BKYC, including evolving EU AML regulations and their impact on business customer onboarding, is highly valued.
  • Collaboration with internal stakeholders, such as customer support, marketing and legal to ensure a seamless and compliant integration of customer facing features.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, critical for articulating product visions, strategies, and specific features to diverse stakeholders, including team members, executives, and external partners. For a Senior PO vital for negotiating with stakeholders, managing expectations, and leading strategic discussions.
  • Strong leadership skills to inspire, guide, and motivate team members and stakeholders, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment. For
    a Senior PO, this involves mentoring junior colleagues and leading by example, demonstrating a high level of professional maturity and the ability to handle complex product initiatives.
  • The capacity to quickly adapt to changing market conditions, user feedback, and project constraints. This includes a strong problem-solving orientation that enables the identification and implementation of effective solutions under ambiguity. For a Senior PO, adaptability also encompasses leading teams through high-pressure phases or changes, maintaining focus on outcomes and quality delivery.
  • Comfortable working with AI tools, thinking critically about AI outputs, and contributing to a culture of responsible AI use. We expect you to demonstrate comfort with AI-assisted workflows and a willingness to continuously develop their AI capabilities as the technology evolves.

Benefits

  • Home office budget.
  • Learning & development budget of €1000 per year and a transparent growth framework to support your career goals.
  • Competitive salary and a variable remuneration program.
  • Monthly meal allowance.
  • Deutschland ticket subsidy.
  • 28 vacation days, increasing by 2 days after 2 years and 3 days after 3 years with Solaris.
  • Opportunity to work abroad for up to 12 weeks per year.

title: Technical Supervisor
description:

title: Inventory Management Leader
description:
Inventory Leader – Job Description Position Summary

The Inventory Analyst supports Vertiv’s Materials and Inventory organization by providing hands-on analysis, reporting, and data governance that improves supply chain performance. The role focuses on the following core objectives: providing clear visibility into DIO drivers, managing MRP parameters related to inventory, improving our understanding of the connection between DIO performance and Promised Date Service Level (PDSL), and (3) strengthening Excess & Obsolete (E&O) reporting and alignment. The analyst partners with Regional Materials teams, Purchasing, Planning, and Finance to ensure accurate data, proactive shortage identification, and consistent, actionable reporting across sites.

Key Responsibilities Reporting, Data Preparation & Insights Development

• Build new and repeatable inventory reports to create visibility into DIO drivers, fast‑turning materials, shortages and stockouts, backlog/work order alignment, and delivery frequency.

• Pull, clean, and analyze large datasets to ensure data is usable and accurate despite imperfections.

• Prepare concise summaries and dashboards for weekly and monthly inventory reviews.

• Conduct first-pass analysis to validate trends or discrepancies before escalating to leadership.

DIO Support & Visibility into DIO Drivers

• Analyze what drives DIO up or down each period, including slow movers, PO/WO misalignment, supplier performance, and demand variability.

• Build datasets that allow leadership to understand key DIO drivers.

• Track recurring patterns influencing DIO and document findings for cross-functional follow-up.

• Provide insights that help plant teams understand the impact of planning and purchasing on DIO performance.

MRP Parameter Governance & Optimization

• Review and analyze MRP planning parameters including safety stock, reorder points, fixed lead times, order modifiers, lot sizing, and sourcing attributes to identify opportunities for inventory optimization.

• Develop reporting that highlights parameter settings contributing to excess inventory, stockouts, shortages, or service level risk.

• Partner with Planning, Purchasing, and Materials teams to monitor parameter accuracy and recommend updates based on demand patterns, lead time performance, and inventory objectives.

• Support periodic parameter reviews to ensure planning settings remain aligned with current business conditions, supplier performance, and manufacturing requirements.

• Identify and escalate inconsistent or outdated MRP parameters across sites and drive standardization where appropriate.

• Analyze the impact of parameter changes on DIO, PDSL, inventory levels, and material availability, providing data-driven recommendations to leadership.

• Maintain governance processes and reporting to track parameter compliance, changes, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

PDSL Improvement & Shortage Prevention

• Develop reporting that identifies materials at risk of missing promised delivery dates.

• Monitor fast‑turning materials to detect early signs of emerging shortages.

Excess & Obsolete (E&O) Reporting & Management

• Prepare and refresh E&O reports, consolidating plant and Finance data.

• Track plant-provided reasons and actions for E&O and identify inconsistencies.

• Support root-cause investigation for recurring E&O drivers.

• Create simple trackers and visuals to support leadership reviews.

Qualifications Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Analytics, Finance, Engineering, or related field.

•5+ years of post-college experience in analytics, supply chain, operations, or materials.

• Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, data structuring).

• Ability to analyze large, imperfect datasets.

• Strong communication, organization, and follow‑through.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or Smartsheet.

• Exposure to manufacturing, materials planning, purchasing, or inventory management.

• Experience supporting inventory health metrics such as DIO or shortage analysis.

Competencies

• Detail-oriented with strong data validation discipline.

• Analytical and curious—asks ‘why’ behind trends.

• Comfortable working through ambiguity and incomplete data.

• Strong follow-through and accountability.

• Ability to partner effectively with plant and cross-functional teams.

• Fast learner with system and process adaptability.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
About Akuna:

Akuna Capital is an innovative trading firm with a strong focus on collaboration, cutting-edge technology, data driven solutions and automation. We specialise in providing liquidity as an options market maker – meaning we are committed to providing competitive quotes that we are willing to both buy and sell. To do this successfully we design and implement our own low latency technologies, trading strategies and mathematical models. At Akuna we have a flat structure, where the best idea wins.

Our Founding Partners, including Andrew Killion, first conceptualized Akuna in their hometown of Sydney. They opened the firm’s first office in 2011 in the heart of the derivatives industry and the options capital of the world – Chicago. Today, Akuna is proud to operate from additional offices in Sydney, Shanghai, Singapore and London.

What you’ll do as a Platform Engineer at Akuna:

This is an exciting role where you will be given the opportunity to take ownership of projects and make them your own. At Akuna, we are constantly looking for ways to improve our efficiency as we continue to grow. As a Platform Engineer, you will work closely with our Trading, Development, Infrastructure, and Operations teams. You will design and implement cloud solutions, automate infrastructure as code, improve cloud governance and security, and monitor our hybrid-cloud environments. In this role, you will:

  • Ensure cloud services are leveraged to their full potential (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and best practices are being followed
  • Help manage our public cloud growth and continuously improve Akuna’s hybrid-cloud operating model
  • Evaluate proposed solution architectures and provide recommendations
  • Provision, configure, upgrade, and monitor technologies such as Kubernetes (EKS and on-premise), Spark, Kafka, and other large-scale distributed databases
  • Automate infrastructure management and development pipelines with tools like Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins and GitLab
  • Explore new technologies in the cloud-native/container ecosystem
  • Work with Infrastructure and Development teams to monitor systems, clusters and cloud deployments to detect errors and monitor performance
  • Adhere to the engineering mindset of creating and maintaining performant and reliable production systems

Qualities that make great candidates:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, SRE, DevOps, or related infrastructure roles
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification preferred
  • Deep experience deploying, operating, and scaling Kubernetes in production, including on-premise clusters and Amazon EKS
  • Strong expertise designing and managing cloud infrastructure on AWS; experience with GCP is a plus
  • Advanced proficiency with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including reusable module development, state management, and platform automation
  • Experience building and operating highly available, scalable, and secure cloud-native platforms
  • Strong knowledge of observability, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational troubleshooting
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices
  • Strong Linux systems administration and troubleshooting skills in distributed production environments
  • Proficiency in automation and scripting with Python, Bash, or similar languages
  • Experience with cloud-native data services, including Amazon RDS, Aurora, Redshift, and DynamoDB
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, influence architectural decisions, and mentor engineers
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience partnering across engineering, operations, and business teams
  • The ability to react quickly and accurately to rapidly changing market conditions, including the ability to quickly and accurately respond and/or solve math and coding problems are essential functions of the role

In addition to technical skillsets, Akuna values the unique perspectives people can bring to the table to collaboratively solve complex problems and drive Akuna forward. We want everyone to feel empowered to apply. We welcome your application and encourage you to take the first steps toward your future with us!

Please note that level/title will be determined upon the conclusion of the interview process. If you are a current student or recent graduate, please take a look at our Entry Level and Intern positions.

title: FA engineer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Electrical Failure Analysis Engineer to support failure analysis activities for customer returns, production fallout, and product reliability improvement. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to identify failure mechanisms, determine root causes, and implement effective corrective and preventive actions.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Perform detailed electrical failure analysis on RMA (Return Material Authorization) units and internal production fallout units to identify failure mechanisms and potential root causes.
  2. Conduct systematic root cause analysis using engineering and quality methodologies such as 5 Why, Fishbone Analysis, and 8D, and collaborate with relevant engineering teams to develop corrective and preventive solutions.
  3. Prepare comprehensive failure analysis (FA) reports documenting test results, findings, root cause, conclusions, and recommended corrective actions within the agreed turnaround time (TAT).
  4. Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Design, and other cross-functional teams to resolve product issues and drive continuous improvement in product quality and reliability.
  5. Participate in customer technical discussions related to product failures, failure mechanisms, corrective actions, and product reliability when required.
  6. Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot failure analysis equipment, ensuring all equipment is properly calibrated, functional, and maintained according to applicable procedures.
  7. Support the development and improvement of failure analysis methodologies, test procedures, and troubleshooting techniques to improve analysis efficiency and accuracy.
  8. Maintain proper documentation of failure analysis activities, test data, equipment conditions, and corrective actions.

Job Requirements

Education & Experience

  1. Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Optoelectronics, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  2. 2–5+ years of experience in technical support, applications engineering, failure analysis, product engineering, semiconductor, electronics, or a related field. Fresh graduates are also encouraged to apply.
  3. Basic knowledge of optical devices, optical components, and their operating principles will be an added advantage.

Technical Skills

  1. Strong understanding of electronic systems, embedded systems, semiconductor products, and electronic circuits.
  2. Hands-on experience with failure analysis and electronic test equipment, such as:
    • Digital Communication Analyzer (DCA)
    • Curve Tracer
    • Oscilloscope
    • Digital Multimeter (DMM)
    • LCR Meter
    • High- and low-magnification microscopes
    • Other electrical and optical failure analysis equipment
  3. Strong ability to read, interpret, and troubleshoot electrical circuit diagrams and schematics.
  4. Good understanding of electronics troubleshooting and failure analysis methodologies.
  5. Familiarity with quality and statistical tools such as SPC, FMEA, JMP, and 8D.

Soft Skills

  1. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills, with a structured approach to identifying root causes.
  2. Good communication, presentation, documentation, and technical report-writing skills.
  3. Able to work independently with minimal supervision while also collaborating effectively with cross-functional support teams.
  4. Proactive, detail-oriented, and willing to learn new technologies, tools, and failure analysis techniques.

title: Specialist Solutions Architect, Radar (APAC)
description:
Specialist Solutions Architect, Radar (Fraud)

Who We Are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We have in-depth knowledge of specific solution offerings and a deep understanding of customer challenges. We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.

Stripe Radar is Stripe's fully integrated fraud and risk management platform. The Radar team's mission is to evolve from a best-in-class payment fraud product into a unified risk intelligence platform that protects businesses from all forms of financial loss—from sophisticated payment fraud and account takeovers to first-party misuse and policy abuse. With Radar, businesses can confidently navigate the evolving fraud landscape, accept more good revenue, and focus on growth.

What You'll Do

You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap. You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities. You will serve as the domain and product expert to our users and GTM team for Stripe Radar globally.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe's Radar product suite to accelerate opportunities globally
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of trends in the fraud and risk management ecosystem, including AI-powered detection, processor-agnostic architectures, and the shift from payment fraud to holistic business risk (policy abuse, account takeover, first-party misuse)
  • Develop expertise with the functional and architectural patterns for deploying advanced fraud systems, including the lifecycle of rule management, ML model tuning, and manual review optimization
  • Understand the ecosystem of risk and identity integrations (device fingerprinting, identity verification, bot mitigation, case management) Stripe must support for users to be successful
  • Define, share, and learn best practices and reusable assets with the broader GTM organization to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team
  • Create reference architectures to uplevel the team and refine reference solutions based on product enhancements and customer feedback
  • Partner closely with the Radar product sales team on Stripe's largest and most complex Radar opportunities, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships
  • Partner closely with the Radar product team to get early exposure to new products and features
  • Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" internally to drive product and feature request prioritization, providing actionable insights on the competitive landscape and emerging fraud vectors
  • Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team
  • Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation
  • Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

Who You Are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in a pre-sales, technical consulting, product, or risk strategy role focused on e-commerce fraud prevention, risk management, or trust and safety
  • Deep working knowledge of the fraud and risk ecosystem, including payment fraud (CNP), account takeover (ATO), first-party misuse (friendly fraud), and policy/content abuse
  • Demonstrated knowledge of risk management architectures, including the role of rules engines, machine learning models, and manual review queues in fraud decisioning
  • Strong knowledge of the signals and data used in fraud detection: device/IP data, behavioral biometrics, identity verification, and graph-based analysis
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering and architecture patterns, with the ability to understand how a wide variety of technologies and systems interact
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners
  • Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment
  • Strong proficiency in English and Mandarin and the position would require you to communicate with native Mandarin speakers based in the Greater China region.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications
  • Experience with processor-agnostic fraud solutions and multi-processor payment environments
  • Experience with risk management for platforms/marketplaces, subscription services, and digital goods
  • Familiarity with liability shift programs (chargeback guarantees) and value-based pricing models for risk products
  • Understanding of how to extend fraud protection across the payment lifecycle—payouts (Issuing), in-person (Terminal), or recurring (Billing)
  • Experience as a subject matter expert in a relevant industry, vertical, or product
